Description:
Role & responsibilities

Translate business objectives into security architecture standards, reference architectures, and strategic roadmaps for clients across a variety of sectors.
Manage numerous engagements, primarily focused on helping organisations define and mature their cybersecurity strategy and architecture posture.
Lead security design reviews for new business and technology initiatives and assess control coverage against target-state requirements.
Mentor team members and align cross-domain stakeholders on target-state architecture and strategic security priorities.
Conduct security architecture maturity assessments against industry-leading frameworks (such as NIST CSF, SABSA, TOGAF, Zero Trust, etc.) to identify gaps and recommend improvements.
Collaborate with clients to understand their business priorities and risk landscape, ensuring all engagements are delivered to the highest quality and professional standards.
Stay informed about emerging security architecture patterns, technology trends, and industry best practices, and incorporate this knowledge into client recommendations.
Provide Subject Matter Expertise on cybersecurity strategy, architecture principles, and security programme governance to clients across various sectors.
Experience in delivering cybersecurity strategy and architecture projects, including roadmap development, design reviews, and framework assessments.
Proven track record of successfully executing complex projects within consulting or professional services environments.
In-depth understanding of security architecture principles and domains (such as network security, cloud security, identity, data protection, and Zero Trust).
Strong knowledge of architecture and security frameworks (such as NIST CSF, SABSA, TOGAF, ISO/IEC 27001) is advantageous.
Experience with security architecture tooling and modelling approaches is beneficial.
Demonstrated ability to mentor junior team members and lead stakeholder alignment across technical and business functions.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic and diverse team environment.
Demonstrated capability to manage multiple projects concurrently and adhere to deadlines.

Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization
Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.

1. Demand Planning & S&OP
Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.

Job Description
Cloud Automation Engineer
Location: Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.
Your Role
As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.
Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines.
Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions.
Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities.
Build automation for resource tagging, expiration policies, orphan-resource detection, and cloud cost management.
Troubleshoot infrastructure provisioning and configuration issues to improve reliability and repeatability.
Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code repositories, deployment documentation, runbooks, and operational guides.
Required Skills Experience
7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure design.
Expertise in Terraform and/or Azure Bicep for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Experience automating Azure networking, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services.
Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machine image management and environment provisioning.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

Azure Virtual Machines
Automation Scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)

Cloud Cost Optimization
Monitoring Operations

Job Description: MS Power Platform Developer

We are looking for an MS Power Platform Developer at B2 level with hands-on experience in building low-code business solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Copilot Studio. The resource should be able to translate business requirements into scalable apps, automated workflows, chatbot experiences, and Microsoft 365 integrated solutions.

Understand business requirements and convert them into Power Platform solution designs.
Develop Power Apps, Power Automate cloud flows and Dataverse-based solution components.
Configure Copilot Studio bots using approved knowledge sources, topics, and workflow actions.
Integrate solutions with SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, APIs, and business systems using connectors.
Perform testing, defect fixes, deployment support, UAT assistance and post-go-live stabilization.
Prepare concise configuration notes, test evidence, handover inputs, and support documentation.

Required Experience & Skills
46 years of IT experience with Power Platform delivery.
Hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 services.
Exposure to Copilot Studio, virtual agents, generative answers, or conversational AI use cases.
Ability to troubleshoot flow failures, connector issues, access restrictions, and deployment challenges.
Good communication skills to work with business users, technical teams, and project stakeholders.

Good to Have
Microsoft certifications such as PL-900, PL-100, PL-200, PL-400, or AI-900.
Exposure to AI Builder, Azure OpenAI, chatbot analytics, Power BI or enterprise reporting use cases.
Understanding of ALM, solution packaging, audit requirements, and Power Platform governance.

Description:
Job Title: Academic Counsellor / Sr. Academic Counsellor
Department: Business Development / Admissions
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Days: 6 Days (Mon-Sat), Work From Office
Note: 1 South Indian language is mandatory for Bangalore location(kannada/Telugu preferred)
Job Overview
We are looking for a target-oriented Counsellor to handle lead generation, student counselling, sales, and admissions. The role involves guiding students, parents, and working professionals on educational programs, study-abroad opportunities, and career-oriented training while ensuring smooth enrolment and achieving business targets.
Roles & Responsibilities
Generate leads through calls, digital platforms, referrals, and promotional activities.
Counsel students and parents on courses, eligibility, career opportunities, and study-abroad options.
Manage the admission process, including applications, documentation, follow-ups, and enrolment.
Guide study-abroad applicants on university selection, applications, and visa-related procedures in coordination with relevant teams.
Promote educational programs and training services to prospective customers.
Achieve counselling, admission, and sales targets through effective lead conversion.
Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and reports using CRM tools or Excel.
Coordinate with internal teams and institutional partners for smooth admissions and onboarding.
Required Skills
Excellent communication, counselling, and negotiation skills.
Strong sales orientation and target-achievement mindset.
Good relationship management and follow-up skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Qualification & Experience
Graduate in any discipline,postgraduate qualification preferred.
1+years of experience in counselling, admissions, sales, business development, or education consulting.
Study-abroad or Online Degree sales experience is an advantage.

Description:
Open Locations - Kolkata/Bangalore/Pune/Noida/Kochi
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Managed Services Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EYs global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
Key Requirements
As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on implementation experience (desirable)
Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the asset or liability cashflows
Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software such as Prophet / Axis / MG Alpha. Advanced level experience in one of these softwares will be valuable
Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
iduals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Title: Senior Associate / Project Leader Market Access
Job Location: -Gurgaon/Noida/Bangalore/Pune/Hyderabad
Job Summary: - This role will be responsible for market access/payer analytics, analyzing payer and patient-level data to deliver robust insights and solutions to client.
Job Responsibilities:-
Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-geographic teams to deliver high-impact Market Access, pricing, payer analytics, and contracting insights for global pharma clients
Work closely with project managers to define the analytical approach, break down complex access problems into structured execution steps, and ensure high-quality delivery
Contribute towards Axtria tools and capabilities as per the business requirements.
Build organization capabilities by participating in Hackathon, solution design, and process automation
Present analytical findings and strategic recommendations to onshore/client stakeholders through clear, compelling slide decks and discussions.

Job Requirements:-
34+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences Domain
We are looking for candidates with strong exposure to Market Access, Payer Analytics and commercial pharmaceutical analytics
Solid understanding of pharmaceutical contracting entities and landscape, including commercial, Medicaid, Medicare, formulary tiers, prior authorization, step edits, rebates, contracting and affordability programs
Hands-on experience working with payer-related datasets such as APLD, eLAAD, EMR, claims, formulary data, specialty data and prescription data.
Proven ability to structure ambiguous access-related problems, design analytical methodologies, and translate complex analyses into actionable Market Access insights
Ability to handle a variety of projects ranging from advanced analytics, ad-hoc analysis to reporting, collaborate effectively, and work in fast-paced, global client environments.
Technical requirements Excel, SQL, Python, PowerBI and knowledge of self-service analytics platforms like Dataiku will be an added advantage
Strong communication, project management, and storyboarding skills
Familiarity with advanced analytics, statistical modelling, or forecasting techniques is a plus.

Must-Have Skills:-
Strong expertise in Payer Analytics and hands-on work with patient and payer-level datasets
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, and dashboarding using Power BI

Skills that give you an edge: -
Experience using Dataiku for data preparation, automation, and analytics workflows
Good to have work experience in building statistical modelling and/or AI/ML models using Python/R

We will provide: -
An inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
A challenging and unique opportunity to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
Vast opportunities for self-development: online Axtria Institute, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
Possibility to relocate to any Axtria office for short and long-term projects
Benefit package:
-Health Insurance benefits
-Retirement benefits
-Paid time off
-Flexible Benefits
-Hybrid working

About Axtria:

Axtria is a global provider of award-winning cloud software and data analytics to the life sciences industry. Axtria enables life sciences organizations to transform the product commercialization journey and deliver much-improved healthcare outcomes for patients worldwide. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of people and are incredibly passionate about the improvement we can bring to patients lives. Our focus is on delivering solutions that help pharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostics companies complete the journey from data to insights to action and get superior returns from their investments. As a participant of the United Nations Global Compact, Axtria is committed to aligning strategies and operations with universal principles on human rights, labor, environment, and anti-corruption and taking actions that advance societal goals. Our people are our core strength, and they make us proud of our work; this has helped us grow exponentially and make tremendous strides toward developing great products. It is for the grit, thinking of an entrepreneur, and a family-like environment where each member is valued and treasured that we are growing rapidly. For more information.

Visit www.axtria.com

Job Title: Senior Associate / Project Leader Market Access
Job Location: -Gurgaon/Noida/Bangalore/Pune/Hyderabad
Job Summary: - This role will be responsible for market access/payer analytics, analyzing payer and patient-level data to deliver robust insights and solutions to client.
Job Responsibilities:-
Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-geographic teams to deliver high-impact Market Access, pricing, payer analytics, and contracting insights for global pharma clients
Work closely with project managers to define the analytical approach, break down complex access problems into structured execution steps, and ensure high-quality delivery
Contribute towards Axtria tools and capabilities as per the business requirements.
Build organization capabilities by participating in Hackathon, solution design, and process automation
Present analytical findings and strategic recommendations to onshore/client stakeholders through clear, compelling slide decks and discussions.

Job Requirements:-
34+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences Domain
We are looking for candidates with strong exposure to Market Access, Payer Analytics and commercial pharmaceutical analytics
Solid understanding of pharmaceutical contracting entities and landscape, including commercial, Medicaid, Medicare, formulary tiers, prior authorization, step edits, rebates, contracting and affordability programs
Hands-on experience working with payer-related datasets such as APLD, eLAAD, EMR, claims, formulary data, specialty data and prescription data.
Proven ability to structure ambiguous access-related problems, design analytical methodologies, and translate complex analyses into actionable Market Access insights
Ability to handle a variety of projects ranging from advanced analytics, ad-hoc analysis to reporting, collaborate effectively, and work in fast-paced, global client environments.
Technical requirements Excel, SQL, Python, PowerBI and knowledge of self-service analytics platforms like Dataiku will be an added advantage
Strong communication, project management, and storyboarding skills
Familiarity with advanced analytics, statistical modelling, or forecasting techniques is a plus.

Must-Have Skills:-
Strong expertise in Payer Analytics and hands-on work with patient and payer-level datasets
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, and dashboarding using Power BI

Skills that give you an edge: -
Experience using Dataiku for data preparation, automation, and analytics workflows
Good to have work experience in building statistical modelling and/or AI/ML models using Python/R

We will provide: -
An inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
A challenging and unique opportunity to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
Vast opportunities for self-development: online Axtria Institute, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
Possibility to relocate to any Axtria office for short and long-term projects
Benefit package:
-Health Insurance benefits
-Retirement benefits
-Paid time off
-Flexible Benefits
-Hybrid working

About Axtria:

Axtria is a global provider of award-winning cloud software and data analytics to the life sciences industry. Axtria enables life sciences organizations to transform the product commercialization journey and deliver much-improved healthcare outcomes for patients worldwide. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of people and are incredibly passionate about the improvement we can bring to patients lives. Our focus is on delivering solutions that help pharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostics companies complete the journey from data to insights to action and get superior returns from their investments. As a participant of the United Nations Global Compact, Axtria is committed to aligning strategies and operations with universal principles on human rights, labor, environment, and anti-corruption and taking actions that advance societal goals. Our people are our core strength, and they make us proud of our work; this has helped us grow exponentially and make tremendous strides toward developing great products. It is for the grit, thinking of an entrepreneur, and a family-like environment where each member is valued and treasured that we are growing rapidly. For more information.

Description:
The Role
We are looking for a marketing intelligence leader who combines marketing and pipeline expertise with data science and AI to proactively monitor and optimize performance. This role will lead the development of predictive models that identify emerging risks and opportunities, diagnose performance drivers, and translate insights into actions that improve campaign, pipeline, and business outcomes.
 Location- Bangalore/Noida
Role- Individual Contributor
Shift- 2.00pm-11.00pm IST

Key Responsibilities
Marketing & Pipeline Performance Intelligence
Analyze performance across campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, and ROI.
Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities across campaigns, channels, audiences, segments, and pipeline.
Diagnose what is driving performance and where intervention is needed.
Translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
Data Science & Proactive Monitoring
Lead the design and deployment of predictive, forecasting, pacing, and anomaly-detection models to proactively monitor marketing and pipeline performance.
Build scalable early-warning capabilities that detect meaningful changes and emerging performance risks and opportunities.
Use advanced analytics to understand what changed, why it changed, and what is likely to happen next.
Campaign Optimization & Partnership
Partner closely with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Campaign Strategy, and Digital Experience to translate insights into action.
Recommend opportunities to optimize campaign strategy, audiences, channels, investment, execution, and activation.
Measure the impact of optimization actions and incorporate learnings into future analyses and models.
AI & Analytics Automation
Apply AI and automation to accelerate monitoring, forecasting, diagnostics, and insight generation.
Automate recurring analytical processes and build scalable performance intelligence solutions.
Partner with Marketing Operations and technology teams to operationalize models and analytics.
Executive Insights
Translate complex analytics into clear, decision-ready business insights and recommendations.
Communicate what is happening, why it matters, and what action should be taken.
Provide leadership with a proactive view of the marketing and pipeline risks and opportunities that require attention.
Qualifications
8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, performance intelligence, or advanced analytics.
Hands-on data science experience designing, building, validating, and deploying predictive and proactive monitoring models, including forecasting and anomaly detection.
Deep understanding of B2B marketing and pipeline performance, including campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, attribution, and ROI.
Proven ability to diagnose performance drivers and translate model outputs and analytical insights into actionable marketing recommendations.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using AI, automation, and modern analytics platforms.
Strong business acumen, problem-solving, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership skills.
Success in This Role
Marketing identifies performance risks and opportunities earlier.
Teams understand where performance is changing, why, and what action to take.
Predictive monitoring reduces reliance on retrospective reporting.
Marketing gains greater visibility into campaign effectiveness and pipeline creation, progression, and conversion.
AI and automation enable faster, more scalable performance intelligence.
Leadership receives clear recommendations connecting marketing activity to pipeline and business outcomes.

These roles demand technical execution, not coordination—requiring strong engineering capabilities in infrastructure automation, FinOps, CI/CD, platform governance, environment management, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.
The ideal candidates will have proven experience managing enterprise-scale data platforms, ensuring secure, reliable, cost-efficient, and well-governed cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
1. Cloud Platform Operations
Manage and optimize Azure workloads—ADLS, VNets, Key Vault, ADF, Synapse, Fabric, Databricks.

Job Description: Cloud Data Platform Engineer / SRE (Azure | Databricks | Fabric | Unity Catalog)
Role Overview
Operationalize Fabric Lakehouses, Pipelines, Warehouses, and Semantic Models for production workloads.
Ensure robust platform governance across environments (DEV–QA–UAT–PROD).
2. InfrastructureasCode & CI/CD
Build and maintain Terraform/Bicep templates for environment provisioning and configuration.
Develop end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for Databricks, Fabric, and Azure components (ADO/GitHub).
Automate deployment of notebooks, workflows, access policies, networking components, and Fabric artifacts.
Enforce version control, release governance, and quality gates.
3. FinOps, Cost Management & Capacity Planning
Implement FinOps dashboards, alerts, budgets, and spend governance practices.
Perform Databricks and Fabric cost optimization—cluster sizing, autoscaling, idle management, job tuning.
Conduct capacity planning for compute, storage, Fabric engines, and Databricks workloads.
Develop cost-saving recommendations and automated consumption monitoring.
4. Environment Management, Security & Governance
Provision and manage Azure data environments with consistent policies and naming standards.
Configure RBAC, ACLs, Unity Catalog grants, service principals, network security, Managed Identities.
Implement governance standards for data access, lineage, audit logging, compliance, and risk mitigation.
Ensure secure connectivity using Private Endpoints, VNET integration, and enterprise IAM controls.
5. Monitoring, Observability & Platform Reliability (SRE)
Implement monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Databricks Metrics, Fabric Admin APIs.
Build runbooks, dashboards, and automated remediation workflows for platform reliability.
Conduct performance tuning of data workloads, Fabric pipelines, Databricks jobs, and storage layers.
Lead incident management, rootcause analysis, and environment stabilization efforts.
Required Skills & Experience
6–12 years in cloud data engineering, SRE, or platform engineering roles.
Strong hands-on expertise with:
Azure Data Services (ADLS, ADF, Synapse, Key Vault, VNets)
Azure Databricks (clusters, jobs, Delta Lake, DLT, Unity Catalog)
Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Pipelines, Warehouse, Dataflows)
Unity Catalog governance (catalogs, schemas, access policies, lineage)
Strong scripting and automation experience: Python, PowerShell, Bash, SQL, PySpark.
Experience with Terraform/Bicep for IaC.
Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
Proven FinOps experience with cost governance and optimization across cloud workloads.
Experience in SRE practices—SLIs, SLOs, operational readiness, automated recovery.
Preferred Qualifications
Certifications in Azure Data Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer, Databricks Data Engineer, FinOps Practitioner.
Experience in highly regulated environments (BFSI, Healthcare, Retail).
Understanding of zero-trust security models.

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

About Fractal
Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Learning and development opportunities with access to cloud certifications and trainings.

Risk Consulting EY Comply: Position: Senior Regulatory Reporting

Hands-on experience in From any of this form FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .

NOTE = 0 Days Notice or 1 Month Notice period
The Opportunity
We are looking for a skilled Senior Regulatory Reporting Professional to support the delivery of technology-enabled regulatory reporting services for digital asset clients. The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
Your Key Responsibilities
Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.
Broader Banking Regulatory Reporting Exposure: Apply relevant exposure to banking regulatory returns, including capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, ICAAP reporting, balance sheet reporting, and regulatory disclosures, where applicable to the clients operating model.
Regulatory Change, Awareness & Reporting Logic: Monitor relevant regulatory developments, interpret reporting instructions, assess data and process impacts, and coordinate timely updates to reporting logic, templates, procedures, controls, and technology workflows.
Data Sourcing & Analytical Reviews: Perform complex data extraction, validation, variance analysis, and root-cause exception investigations across large datasets to ensure data completeness and integrity.
Control Governance & Audit Readiness: Embed rigorous quality controlsincluding maker-checker reviews, clear audit trails, evidence retention, and sign-off protocols—across all reporting cycles.
Automation & Process Improvement: Identify reporting process inefficiencies and support automation initiatives using tools such as SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
Analytics & Responsible AI Awareness: Apply awareness of responsible AI and analytics use cases to support anomaly detection, exception analysis, reporting commentary, and workflow monitoring.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment: Provide technical coaching and review support to junior team members while coordinating seamlessly across cross-functional partners and U.S.-based stakeholders.
Time-Zone Flexibility: Willingness to operate during late/extended hours to ensure seamless hand-offs with U.S.-based stakeholders and meet strict global submission deadlines.
Al fluency - Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you’ll also have
4–6 years of relevant experience, including 2–6 years in a senior role within regulatory reporting or financial services.
Hands-on experience with U.S. regulatory filings, financial condition reporting, customer liability reporting, permissible investments, transaction reporting, and Money Transmitter License (MTL) submissions.
Hands-on experience in FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .
Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field is preferred; CA, CPA, CFA, MBA, or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
Strong end-to-end understanding of regulatory reporting production cycles, data validation, reconciliations, variance analysis, workpaper preparation, and review controls.
Solid working knowledge of financial statement analysis, regulatory capital concepts, ICAAP reporting, and applicable regulatory compliance frameworks.
Exposure to banking regulatory reporting frameworks, including capital adequacy, ICAAP reporting, liquidity risk reporting, balance sheet schedules, and regulatory disclosures, would be beneficial.
Proven ability to translate complex regulatory mandates into business requirements.
Knowledge of reporting platforms and data tools, along with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Snowflake, or Looker, would be an added advantage.
Awareness of Generative AI tools and workflow automation to support data extraction, exception analysis, and reporting efficiency would be an advantage.
Strong control mindset, including practical experience with maker-checker reviews, robust audit trails, evidence retention, issue management, and key risk/control testing.
Advanced data analytics skills, with the ability to query large datasets, perform root-cause analysis on exceptions, and communicate structured findings clearly.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effectively managing relationships across onshore/offshore teams, product managers, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating strong ownership, continuous improvement, and agility in adapting to evolving regulatory landscapes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required. U.S. visa readiness or international travel willingness is preferred but not mandatory.

Description:
Role Purpose
Provide on-site leadership for critical business-impacting incidents and act as the primary customer-facing Major Incident Manager.
Key Responsibilities
• Own mission-critical incidents impacting business operations.
• Lead executive communication with client leadership and stakeholders.
• Coordinate global resolver teams across infrastructure, cloud, networks, applications, and workplace services.
• Drive rapid service restoration and business impact mitigation.
• Manage incident escalations and command-center activities.
• Conduct executive-level incident reviews and reporting.
• Identify operational improvement opportunities and drive remediation plans.
• Support customer governance and service review meetings.
Work Schedule & Shift Requirements
• Working an overnight night shift is a strict requirement for this role.
• Must be available to be on-call for weekends once a month.
Required Skills
• Advanced Major Incident Management experience.
• Strong customer-facing and executive presentation skills.
• Experience managing complex global incidents.
• ITIL certification preferred.
• ServiceNow expertise required.
Experience
• 3-7 years in IT Operations.
• Minimum 2-4 years in Major Incident Management leadership roles.
• Experience working with North American enterprise customers.

Job Description: SAP BTP Security Administrator
Position Overview:
We are looking for an experienced SAP BTP Security Administrator with 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in SAP BTP administration and security management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing administration, custom authentication, authorization, connectivity, and overall BTP administration while ensuring seamless integration with customer IDPs and SAP ID Service.
Key Responsibilities:
1. SAP BTP Security [Mandatory]
Manage authentication and authorization for SAP ID Service and custom IDPs.
Administer SAP BTP Identity Access Governance (IAG) for role and policy management.
Configure trust and federation between UAA and SAP Identity Authentication Service (IAS).
Hands-on experience & knowledge with Corporate Identity Provider (IDP) integration, authentication, user provisioning, and Single Sign-On (SSO) configurations.
Establish trust manually between UAA and any SAML-based IDP.
Configure custom identity provider login for Cloud Foundry environments.
Manage user provisioning from SAP ID Service for multi-environment subaccounts.
Shadow user management.
Hands-on experience in provisioning SAP S/4HANA roles to SAP BTP, ensuring secure user access, authorization mapping, and role synchronization.
Knowledge of integrating SAP BTP applications with IAS through application mapping, trust configuration, corporate IDP integration, and SAML/OIDC-based authentication.
2. SAP BTP Administration [Mandatory]
Perform BTP Basic Setup and manage global account/subaccounts.
Handle BTP service provisioning and administration.
Configure and manage BTP connectivity (Destinations, SAP Cloud Connector, and Authentication Mechanisms).
Perform BTP transport management and oversee application administration.
3. BTP Cloud Connector Administration [Good to have]
Manage SAP Cloud Connector configurations for secure on-premises connectivity.
Manager SCC certificates
5. Ticket Handling & Shift Support
Handle incident and service request tickets related to SAP BTP security and administration.
Should be ready to work in 24/7 shift support and on need basis.
Required Qualifications & Skills:
Education & Experience
Graduate in Information Technology / Computer Science or a related field.
5 to 7 years of relevant experience as an SAP BTP Administrator with a strong focus on security.
Technical Skills:
SAP BTP Security (Authentication, Authorization, Trust & Federation).
SAP Identity Authentication Service (IAS) & Identity Provisioning Service (IPS).
SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect for authentication.
SAP BTP IAG (Identity Access Governance) administration.
SAP Cloud Connector setup and management.
Cloud Foundry CLI (CF CLI) for identity and access management.
Soft Skills:
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a 24/7 environment.
Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Additional Information:
Location: Karadi, Pune / Remote.
Shift Timing: 24/7 Shift Support (also ready to stretch on need basis)
Employment Type: Full-time

Leadership Hiring
Manage end-to-end recruitment for leadership and critical positions across business functions.
Partner with senior business leaders to understand talent requirements, organizational priorities, and succession needs.
Develop and execute targeted search strategies to identify and engage high-caliber leadership talent.
Build and maintain strong leadership talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and talent intelligence research.
Stakeholder Management

Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.
Hiring Details

Why Join NoBroker?
Opportunity to build a career in a fast-paced PropTech environment.
Performance-driven growth opportunities.
Exposure to sales, customer management, negotiation, and business development.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Role summary
Managerial Responsibilities:
Overall Management of the laboratory
Consumption management
Quality management

Technical Responsibilities:
Up gradation of advanced technologies Quality of the results.
What the role entails - Key accountabilities/ responsibilities
1. Provide advice to those requesting information about the choice of tests, the use of the laboratory service and the interpretation of laboratory data.
2. Serve as an active member of the medical staff in main lab, collection center,
3. Relate and function effectively with NABL & other accrediting agencies, Appropriate administrative officials, healthcare community, the patient / clients.
4. Define, implement, and monitor standards of performance and quality improvement of the medical laboratory service orservices.
5. Monitor all processes in the laboratory to determine that reliable data is being generated.
6. Ensure availability of sufficiently qualified personnel with adequate training and experience to meet the needs of the laboratory.
7. Plan, set goals, develop, and allocate resources appropriate to the medical environment.
8. Provide effective and efficient administration of the medical laboratory service, including budget planning and control with responsible financial management, in accordance with institutional assignment of such responsibilities.
9. Provide educational programs for the medical and laboratory staff and participate in educational programs of the institution.
10. Implement a safe laboratory environment in compliance with good practice and applicable regulations.
11. Address any complaint, request, or suggestion from users of laboratory services. Ensure good staff morale.
12. Report authorization of Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and serology
13. Routine review of QC for all departments with review of reports including CBC, MP, PS, Reticulocyte count, Fluid routine, ICT/DCT, Blood group before approving
14. Formulate review and recheck policies for all tests and ensure compliance with the help of Lab supervisor and technicians.
15. Verification of critical, unusual, and abnormal test results before release
16. Interpret, Correlate, and generate medically significant laboratory data.
17. Attending all sorts of client queries related to test enquiries and interpretation of test results.
18. Approval of SOPs for use and ensure compliance with respect to accreditation requirements.
19. Ensure review of monthly MIS
20. Ensure results are reported within turnaround time with the help of section head.
21. Review and improvement of reports formats.
22. To identify new equipment, tests, technology, products and standardization of assays.
23. Identify needs for resources (human / equipment / infrastructure) and submit to senior management for approval.
24. Attending conferences/workshops to ensure updated knowledge about recent trends.
25. To spend time reviewing daily pendency status on reports not released as well as sample received cases to avoid patient dissatisfaction.
26. To keep a watchful eye on instrument maintenance and hygiene of lab and practice 0 tolerance in this area. Any instrument failure due to user s should be avoided totally as it affects our patient and business.
27. To ensure sample processing is not stopped due to KIT non availability.
28. To ensure that every PR is approved on time and any gaps are highlighted.
29. COL/ Lab Head should work with BU Heads in forecasting CAMP s and other seasonal activities and order KITs sufficiently.
30. To keep a close watch on technical complaints. Ensure analytical complaints get logged, DE flagging is minimized. For recorded complaints and initiate proper CAPA and must also discuss in weekly calls with the team on learning and preventive actionsand timely escalation of analytical complaints/ Legal threats
31. To spend quality time on understanding patient and customer VOC especially on cases we are not resolving on time. COL/Lab Head should guide the team to resolve issues on time andsupport them wherever technical input is required.
32. To participate in weekly meetings along with BU/SBU Heads to resolve issues as well as seek support wherever needs from nontechnical team.
33. To take responsibility to train the non-technical team for better business and customer engagement.

JOB SUMMARY
Responsible for proactively soliciting and managing large group/catering related opportunities with significant revenue potential. Achieves personal and team related revenue goals. Verifies business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Understanding Market Opportunities & Driving Revenue
- Targets group/catering accounts, markets, or segments with heavy emphasis on proactive solicitation and account saturation.
- Partners with group/catering counterpart to effectively manage the business opportunity.
- Responds to incoming group/catering opportunities for the property that are outside parameters of the .
- Handles all opportunities if property does not participate in an EBC.
- Identifies, qualifies and solicits new group/catering business to achieve personal and each property s revenue goals.
- Focuses efforts on group/catering accounts with significant potential sales revenue.
- Develops effective group/catering sales plans and actions.
- Designs, develops and sells creative catered events.
- Maximizes revenue by upselling packages and creative food and beverage.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for each property based on market conditions and individual property needs.
- Uses negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close on business and negotiate contracts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Handles complex business with significant revenue potential as well as significant customer expectations.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for group/catering sales opportunities.
- Supports brand s Service and Relationship Strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Provides excellent customer service in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes brand s Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Executes and supports the business Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.
- Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
- Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the property and brand.
- Gains understanding of the property s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.
Building Successful Relationships
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (e.g., , Market Sales, Strategic Accounts) to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Uses sales resources and administrative/support staff.
Additional Responsibilities
- Utilizes intranet for resources and information.
- Conducts site inspections.
- Creates contracts as required.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

Description:
Role Overview
The Area Sales Manager (ASM) will be responsible for driving B2B sales growth within the assigned territory by managing and mentoring a team of Business Development Executives (BDEs). The role focuses on retailer acquisition, retention, order growth, relationship management, and execution excellence on the Superstore by Nykaa platform.
Key Responsibilities
1. Sales & Revenue Growth
Drive territory-wise revenue targets and ensure achievement of monthly/quarterly sales goals.
Increase retailer onboarding and active buyer base on the Superstore platform.
Improve order frequency and average order value (AOV).
Identify high-potential markets and expansion opportunities.
2. Team Management & Development
Manage, train, and mentor the team of Business Development Executives (BDEs) within the assigned territory.
Set clear KPIs and performance expectations for BDEs.
Conduct regular field visits and joint sales calls to guide the team.
Motivate BDEs to meet and exceed targets.
3. Retailer Acquisition & Relationship Management
Travel within the assigned territory to onboard new retailers.
Support BDEs in acquiring and activating new retailers.
Build long-term relationships with key retailers to ensure retention and repeat business.
Address retailer concerns and coordinate with internal teams for resolution.
Collect market intelligence and competitor insights.
4. Sales Execution & Process Implementation
Implement structured sales processes to help BDEs identify and prioritize key accounts and prospects.
Monitor team performance metrics (coverage, productivity, conversion rates).
Ensure proper usage and adoption of the Superstore app among retailers.
Drive promotional campaigns and new product launches in the territory.
5. Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
Provide regular sales performance reports to senior management.
Share customer feedback, demand trends, and improvement suggestions.
Maintain accurate sales data and territory records.

Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Job Description
We are hiring enthusiastic MBA freshers for a Luxury Sales Consultant role in premium home appliances. This opportunity offers practical experience in showroom sales, customer engagement and relationship building with architects and interior designers.
Key Responsibilities
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable premium home appliances.
Conduct product demonstrations and explain features and benefits.
Convert showroom enquiries into sales and achieve assigned targets.
Meet architects and interior designers within the allotted territory to generate business.
Follow up on leads and maintain customer relationships.
Update sales activity reports and coordinate with the dedicated Team Leader.

MBA graduates with an interest in sales and luxury retail.
Strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
Customer-focused approach and willingness to work towards sales targets.
Willingness to travel locally within assigned areas.
Strong English communication skills for the Bangalore location.
Candidates from any industry may apply.

Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Logistics ManagerSupply Chain ManagementDispatch ManagementSteel IndustryTMT Steel., TransportationFreight ManagementSAPERPVendor Management, About company, We Are JK Lakshmi Steel
Description:
Role & Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end logistics operations, including dispatch planning, transportation, and delivery of finished steel products such as TMT bars.
Plan and monitor daily vehicle placement, loading, dispatch schedules, and timely delivery to dealers, distributors, and customers.
Coordinate with Sales, Production, Warehouse, and Finance teams to ensure smooth dispatch operations.
Manage transporters and logistics vendors, negotiate freight rates, and optimize transportation costs.
Monitor vehicle utilization, freight expenses, transit time, and delivery performance.
Ensure proper documentation for dispatches, including invoices, e-way bills, delivery challans, and transport documents.
Track shipments and resolve delivery delays, transit issues, and customer complaints.
Ensure compliance with applicable transportation regulations, safety standards, and company policies.
Monitor logistics budgets, transport bills, freight reconciliation, and cost-control initiatives.
Maintain MIS reports on dispatches, freight costs, vehicle availability, and delivery performance.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, reduce logistics costs, and enhance customer satisfaction.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or Operations will be an added advantage.
Relevant experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, or supply chain management, preferably in the steel, cement, manufacturing, or infrastructure industry.
Experience in managing bulk material transportation, heavy vehicles, transporter networks, and dealer/customer deliveries.
Strong knowledge of dispatch planning, freight negotiation, vehicle utilization, and logistics cost optimization.
Working knowledge of GST-related transport documentation, e-way bills, invoicing, and compliance requirements.
Proficiency in MS Excel and experience with ERP/SAP systems will be preferred.
Strong vendor management, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple dispatches and operational priorities.
Willingness to travel and work at plant or logistics locations as per business requirements.
AboutCompany:
We Are JK Lakshmi Steel

From the foundation to the frame.

For over 40 years, JK Lakshmi has held India's buildings together from the ground up. Our cement is in homes, schools, hospitals, bridges and roads across the country, trusted by the families who live in them and the engineers who design them.

Now we're adding the part that holds them up.

Steel is what keeps a structure standing. It carries the weight of every floor, every wall and every life inside. That's too important to leave to chance, so we're bringing the same discipline that built the JK Lakshmi name in cement to everything we make in steel: TMT bars, wires, structural channels and pipes.

We're not new to building India. We're simply taking the next step. What we did for cement, we're now doing for steel: raising the standard, checking every stage, and making sure the name on the product means something.

We're in your cement. Now we're in your steel.

Description:
Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accountant to manage daily accounting operations, GST compliance, ledger reconciliation, financial reporting, and documentation. Candidates with experience in steel, manufacturing, or trading industries will be preferred.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day accounting entries, journal vouchers, and general ledger maintenance.
Handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, and vendor/customer reconciliations.
Prepare bank reconciliation statements (BRS) and monitor outstanding balances.
Assist in GST returns, TDS compliance, and input tax credit reconciliation.
Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and payment documents.
Maintain inventory and stock reconciliation records related to steel purchases and sales.
Monitor freight, transportation, and other operational expenses.
Prepare monthly MIS reports, expense statements, and account summaries.
Support internal audits, statutory audits, and month-end closing activities.
Work on accounting software/ERP such as SAP, Tally, and MS Excel.
Candidate Requirements
Graduate in Commerce (B.Com); M.Com or MBA Finance preferred.
25 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance.
Good knowledge of GST, TDS, accounting principles, and reconciliations.
Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software/ERP.
Experience in steel, manufacturing, or trading companies will be an advantage.
Strong analytical skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.

Key Skills:
Accounting | GST | TDS | Accounts Payable | Accounts Receivable | Bank Reconciliation | Ledger Reconciliation | MIS Reporting | MS Excel | SAP | Tally | Inventory Accounting.

Preferred Industry: Steel / Iron & Steel / Manufacturing / Trading.
AboutCompany:
We Are JK Lakshmi Steel

From the foundation to the frame.

For over 40 years, JK Lakshmi has held India's buildings together from the ground up. Our cement is in homes, schools, hospitals, bridges and roads across the country, trusted by the families who live in them and the engineers who design them.

Now we're adding the part that holds them up.

Steel is what keeps a structure standing. It carries the weight of every floor, every wall and every life inside. That's too important to leave to chance, so we're bringing the same discipline that built the JK Lakshmi name in cement to everything we make in steel: TMT bars, wires, structural channels and pipes.

We're not new to building India. We're simply taking the next step. What we did for cement, we're now doing for steel: raising the standard, checking every stage, and making sure the name on the product means something.

We're in your cement. Now we're in your steel.

The position is accountable for proactively soliciting and handling sales opportunities. Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives. CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.

- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.
Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.

- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
