Bachelor's Degree
3 year(s) of experience with Workday Human Capital Management with at least 1 Workday implementation
A Workday Core HCM certification and at least one additional module such as Core HR, Payroll, Absence, or Time
Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
Should be able to analyse business requirements and translate them into effective & efficient application configuration.
Knowledge on Custom fields, custom reports, matrix reports, calculated fields
Knowledge of Workday Security.
Knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them
Knowledge in creating and troubleshooting EIB (Enterprise Interface Builder)

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore

Job description

SAP MDG Consultant
Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Job Description:
To really stand out and make us fit for the future in a constantly changing world, each and every one of us at PwC needs to be a purpose-led and values-driven leader at every level. - At least a Bachelor's degree from Tier 1
- At least 7 years of experience

- Working knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience setting technical direction, reviewing code, resolving complex issues, and mentoring engineers.
- Experience with asynchronous APIs, messaging platforms, or event-streaming technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
- Exposure to agentic development using frameworks such as LangGraph, the OpenAI SDK, or Google ADK.
- Leveraging tools and methodologies to generate innovative solutions

Job Description: Java Spring Boot Microservices Developer

Job Title: Java Spring Boot Microservices Developer

Experience: 5 to 8 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated Java Spring Boot Microservices Developer to design, develop, and support scalable, high-performance enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Architecture, REST APIs, and cloud-native application development.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Build scalable Microservices-based applications following industry best practices.
Develop and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party systems.
Collaborate with architects, business analysts, QA teams, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
Implement secure, reliable, and reusable services with proper exception handling and logging.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, and deployment activities.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and availability.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Work in Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning and estimations.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Java 8/11/17.
Expertise in Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security.
Hands-on experience in Microservices Architecture.
Strong knowledge of RESTful Web Services and API development.
Experience with Hibernate/JPA and ORM frameworks.
Strong understanding of SQL databases such as Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
Experience with Git, Maven, Gradle, and version control practices.
Knowledge of Design Patterns, OOP Concepts, and SOLID Principles.
Familiarity with JUnit, Mockito, and automated testing frameworks.

specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high

Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Summary:
We are seeking dynamic and customer-focused professionals to join our Greenlight Hub team in Gurgaon as Customer Support Specialists. This role is central to empowering new driver partners by delivering exceptional in-person support, guiding them through onboarding, and equipping them with the tools and knowledge needed to succeed. Serve as a brand ambassador by promoting the company’s values and building enthusiasm among drivers.
Stay updated on company processes, tools, and policies to ensure accurate and consistent support.
Collaborate with the Driver Operations team to identify and implement process improvements.

Any graduation degree.
Freshers or up to 1 year of experience in voice-based customer support.
Proven ability to handle in-person interactions with empathy, patience, and professionalism.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a resourceful mindset when addressing challenges.
Highly organized, self-motivated, and team-oriented with a passion for empowering others.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Strong verbal communication skills in both English and Nepali.

Senior Manager – Human Resources (Corporate and Plant)
Lead end-to-end human resources, industrial/employee relations, statutory compliance, talent acquisition, and administration across both corporate offices and manufacturing/plant locations.
Reporting To: VP / Head of HR and Corporate Leadership
Key Focus: Aligning plant workforce productivity, blue-collar/white-collar management, and statutory laws with broader corporate goals.
Key Responsibilities
1. Plant & Blue-Collar / Staff HR Operations
F Manage end-to-end workforce planning, budgeting, recruitment, selection, onboarding, and deployment for both permanent and contractual/blue-collar labor.
F Monitor key plant metrics including absenteeism, attrition, overtime, workforce costs, and productivity.
F Oversee plant administration, security agencies, canteens, transport, and facility vendors.
2. Industrial Relations (IR) & Employee Relations
F Handle labor and industrial relations, worker grievances, disciplinary proceedings, domestic enquiries, and dispute resolution.
F Foster harmonious workplace relations, manage union/workmen interactions (where applicable), and support long-term settlement or negotiations.
F Act as an escalation point for employee relations and grievance handling across corporate and plant tiers.
3. Statutory Compliance & Legal Risk Management
F Ensure strict adherence to labor laws and statutory regulations (e.g., Factories Act, PF, ESI, Contract Labour Act, Payment of Wages Act, etc.).
F Coordinate labour inspections, statutory audits, and liaise with government and local regulatory authorities.
4. Talent Acquisition & Management (Corporate & Plant)
F Drive recruitment funnels from sourcing to joining for corporate roles and plant staff/shop-floor positions.
F Implement performance management systems (PMS), training and competency development plans, and succession planning.
F Support Corporate HR and L&D teams in rolling out organizational development and employee engagement initiatives.
5. Payroll Inputs & MIS Reporting
F Oversee monthly attendance, time-office data, and payroll inputs in coordination with Finance and Corporate HR.
F Prepare and present monthly HR Management Information Systems (MIS) dashboards, tracking KPIs, headcount budgets, and cost-reduction targets.

Preferred candidate profile
1. MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, Personnel Management, or Industrial Relations (specialization in Labour Welfare is a strong plus with 10–18 years of progressive HR experience, with a blend of corporate HR and manufacturing/plant HR exposure.
2. Strong mastery of local labor legislation and statutory compliance.
3. Proficiency in HRMS, payroll systems, and MS Excel/MIS reporting.
4. Knowledge of HR technology and systems
5. Hands-on experience with blue-collar/contractual workforce management and industrial dispute handling.
6. Negotiation, stakeholder management, analytical problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership.
7. Experience with applicant tracking systems and recruitment
8. Superb verbal and written communication abilities
9. Display proficiency in juggling multiple tasks and meeting multiple deadlines.
10. History of success in recruitment, problem-solving, and employee development
11. Ability to build strong relationships with all levels of management
12. Strong strategic thinking skills and the ability to drive change
13. Commitment to fostering employee engagement and satisfaction.

Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Description:
About the Job:

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) delivers strategic technical and architectural guidance along with hands-on technical support to key customers, enabling them to optimize their Red Hat infrastructure. This role cultivates strong relationships, develops deep technical expertise of customer environments and exercises good judgment to make informed decisions that impact customer success. The TAM is responsible for working independently with minimal instruction to resolve moderately complex technical issues. This role proactively coaches customers on best practices for utilizing Red Hat solutions, anticipates and mitigates potential customer challenges, serving as a trusted advisor and advocate for assigned accounts. The TAM demonstrates a solid understanding of customer business needs and technical environments, contributing significantly to customer success and retention.

Note: This role may come into contact with confidential or sensitive customer information requiring special treatment in accordance with Red Hat policies and applicable privacy laws.


What You Will Do:

Proactively identify and address potential technical risks within customer environments.
Develop and support the implementation of solutions for complex technical challenges.
Provide hands-on support to the assigned customer
Collaborate with engineering and product management teams on customer escalations.
Conduct regular technical reviews with customers to ensure optimal performance.
Develop and maintain deep technical expertise in assigned Red Hat products.
Serve as a technical mentor for junior team members.
Contribute to the development of best practices and internal training materials.
Conduct regular account reviews with customers and internal stakeholders.
May be required to work on customer site and connect to customer systems.

What You Will Bring:

6+ years of experience working in a support, development, engineering, IT, or quality assurance (QA) organization
Experience in Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP) or Kubernetes or Dockers cluster management
Understanding of RHOCP Architecture different types of RHOCP installations
Experience in RHOCP Troubleshooting and data/logs collection
Strong working knowledge of Prometheus and Grafana open source monitoring solutions will be considered a plus
Administration experience of Red Hat OpenShift v4.x will be considered a plus
Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with shifting priorities and timelines
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers both clearly and concisely
Ability to travel for customer visits and events within the region
Comprehension of continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) concepts

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Facilitate workshops to define and validate business rules and system configurations
Resolve conflicting requirements and provide expert recommendations
Document functional specifications and translate business needs into technical solutions

Description:
At Medtronic, we push the limits of what technology, therapies, and services can do to help alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. As a Senior Compliance Specialist, you will serve as a strategic compliance business partner responsible for supporting the development, implementation, and oversight of an effective compliance program that promotes ethical business conduct and mitigates compliance risks across commercial operations.
You will provide expert compliance guidance to business leaders and employees, support risk assessments and monitoring activities, oversee channel partner compliance programs, and help ensure adherence to company policies, industry codes, and applicable laws and regulations. The role requires the ability to influence stakeholders, balance business objectives with compliance requirements, and drive a strong culture of integrity throughout the organization.  
This is an individual-contributor role and the position will be in Mumbai in India and has responsibility mainly for India Subcontinent (subject to changes). The position will report directly to the India Subcontinent Compliance Officer.
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

Strategic Business Partnership
Serve as a trusted advisor to commercial and functional stakeholders on compliance and data privacy matters. Understand business strategies, operating models, commercial priorities, and emerging initiatives to provide timely and practical compliance guidance.
Advise on Global Business Conduct Standards/Compliance Policy such as HCP/HCO interactions, sponsorships, educational grants, consulting arrangements, and promotional activities, in adherence with applicable laws, codes, regulations, and company policies.
Clearly document compliance advice, risk assessments, approvals, exceptions, and agreed mitigation actions.
Monitor regulatory and industry developments and support the implementation of relevant changes in policies, processes, systems, training, and business practices.
Support the integration of privacy principles into business processes, digital initiatives, customer programs, vendor arrangements, and projects involving personal or sensitive data.
Promote privacy-by-design principles by encouraging teams to consider data minimization, purpose limitation, appropriate access, retention, security, transparency, consent, and individual rights at the beginning of an initiative.
Data Analytics and Risk Insights
Develop dashboards, metrics, and reports for management and compliance leadership to analyse trends.
Translate analytical findings into clear risk insights, recommendations, and action plans for business and compliance stakeholders, for continuous improvement of the compliance program.
Utilize data analytics to identify opportunities for process and control enhancements.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators supporting continuous improvement.
Track remediation activities and evaluate whether implemented actions have appropriately addressed identified risks.
Compliance Monitoring and Process Reviews
Support in developing and executing risk-based compliance monitoring plans aligned with country, business, and program priorities.
Conduct risk-based compliance reviews and assessments, analyse findings, root causes and risk trends.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve compliance concerns and track timely closure.
Identify opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen controls, improve documentation, and enhance the effectiveness of the Compliance Program.
Third-Party Compliance
Support the third party compliance program for India SubCon such as due diligence, training, monitoring, remediations and lifecycle-management processes.
Review third-party due-diligence / screening results, red flags, design appropriate remediations and supporting documentation.
Conduct or support audits/monitoring, remediations, process assessments, and other risk-based oversight activities.
Training
Support in design, develop, and deliver engaging compliance training for employees, managers, Business Units, functional teams, distributors, dealers, and other third parties.
Tailor training and communication to the specific risks and promote awareness of compliance requirements, culture of integrity and ethical decision-making.

Required Qualifications:
Requires advanced knowledge of job area combining breadth and depth, typically obtained through advanced education combined with experience. May have practical knowledge of project management.
Requires a Baccalaureate degree with minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years relevant experience.

Preferred:
Experience in the healthcare, medical-device, pharmaceutical, life-sciences, or another highly regulated industry.
Knowledge of Indian healthcare compliance requirements, UCMPMD, data-protection requirements, and applicable anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws.
Experience managing distributor, dealer, channel-partner, consultant, vendor, or other third-party compliance risks.
Experience conducting investigations, monitoring activities, and compliance risk assessments.
Proficiency in Excel and experience with Power BI, data visualization, dashboards, or other analytical tools.
Relevant professional qualification or certification in compliance such as CCEP, law, audit, privacy such as CIPM, fraud examination, risk management, accounting, or data analytics.

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

As a GenAI Full Stack Senior Associate you will support the design and development of full stack GenAI solutions, turning business needs into practical data and technology deliverables within our Data & Analytics Engineering practice. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build client relationships, and guide junior team members while navigating changing priorities and using critical thinking to shape solution delivery. Responsibilities
- Design and develop responsive, performant user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Vue.js), implementing reusable component libraries and ensuring design consistency.

What You Must Have
- Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Experience working with AI or Generative AI tools-based applications.
- Strong backend development skills using Node.js, Nest.js, Java Spring Boot, or Python frameworks, with solid understanding of RESTful APIs and GraphQL.
- Proficient in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks like React, Vue.js, or Next.js.
- Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB, along with authentication and authorization mechanisms.
- Knowledgeable in version control systems, preferably Git, to manage code and collaborate effectively.

Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.

Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.

Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes

Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Consultant in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Collaborate with the client team to understand the business problem, identify the solution approach and work through the design, development, and delivery phases.
Conduct Training Needs Analysis to develop the training curriculum.
Develop high-quality and detailed content outlines as per the curriculum.
Design standards, guidelines, templates, and checklists for the proposed learning solution.
Collaborate with internal and client stakeholders to design and develop relevant and effective training deliverables.
Review training deliverables to ensure that the deliverable quality is as per the project quality parameters and industry standards.
Identify and share the risks with the Project Leads/Functional Manager to discuss possible solutions/mitigations/alternatives.
Coach instructional designers and content developers to prepare materials for instructor development workshops.
Provide clear and effective feedback to team with the intent to develop their instructional design skills.
Identify opportunities to implement new and innovative learning strategies into the solution.
Leverage proficiency in instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, content design, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Apply your strong knowledge in industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:6+years of proven experience in content development and instructional designing
Extensive experience in developing, reviewing and delivering different training modalities like Instructor-Led Trainings, Web-Based Trainings, application simulations, job aids, and quick reference guides
Experience in leading and coaching small teams independently



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.

Description:
SAP RAR Consultant - Operations Support (Offshore)

Experience: 5-10 Years
Location: Pune / Chennai/Hyderabad/ Bangalore
Role Type: AMS / Production Support


Key Responsibilities
Provide L2/L3 production support for SAP Revenue Accounting & Reporting (RAR).
Handle incident management, problem resolution, and service requests.
Support end-to-end revenue recognition processes aligned with ASC 606 and IFRS 15.
Monitor and resolve issues related to:
Revenue Contracts
Performance Obligations (POBs)
SSP Allocation
Contract Modifications
Revenue Postings
Perform month-end, quarter-end, and year-end revenue close activities.
Reconcile and validate revenue accounting results.
Support integration between SAP RAR and SAP S/4HANA modules (FI, CO, AR, GL).
Troubleshoot data, posting, and reconciliation issues.
Maintain RAR configurations including business rules, account determination, and revenue recognition settings.
Collaborate with Finance, Revenue Accounting, Business, and IT teams.
Support SIT, UAT, enhancements, defect fixes, and release activities.
Prepare operational documents, RCA reports, and knowledge articles.
Drive process improvements and automation initiatives.

Must-Have Skills
SAP S/4HANA RAR (Revenue Accounting & Reporting)
SAP FI Integration (GL, AR)
Revenue Recognition & Revenue Reconciliation
AMS / Production Support experience
L2/L3 Support expertise
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
Stakeholder management and communication skills

Preferred Skills
ASC 606 and IFRS 15 knowledge
SAP BRIM integration experience
Subscription Billing / SaaS business exposure

Ideal Candidate Profile
5-10 years of SAP experience with strong SAP RAR support expertise.
Hands-on experience supporting revenue accounting processes in production environments.
Good understanding of finance accounting concepts and revenue recognition standards.
Experience working with global stakeholders and managing critical support incidents.
Ability to independently analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex RAR issues.

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP-BODS-Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data-driven decision-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, asking questions, and using these moments as opportunities to grow. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your experience in data migration and SAP BODS to provide advisory services, design data migration solutions, and support data cleansing activities.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client data migration requirements and legacy data structures to design effective migration solutions
- Collaborating with SAP functional and technical consultants to address data migration needs and challenges
- Designing and implementing data migration frameworks using SAP Data Services and Information Steward
- Managing data migration processes, including building, testing, and executing migrations with SAP SDS LSMW and SAP Migration Cockpit
- Conducting preload and post-load validation of migration results and advising on data cleansing requirements
- Performing migration dress rehearsals, cutover tasks, and providing post go-live support
- Developing data models and performing data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
- Creating technical specification documents for data services jobs based on migration experience and programming knowledge
- Supporting data cleansing and validation activities using tools like Information Steward, Excel, and SQL
- Providing advisory services to clients on data management strategies and techniques
- Utilizing Snaplogic for data migration from source systems to S/4 HANA
- Building and maintaining client relationships to understand and address their data management needs
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata

Description:
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. Navigating increasingly complex situations, you will grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and deliver quality work. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isnt clear, using these moments as opportunities to grow.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex concepts, interpret data to inform insights, and uphold professional standards, contributing to the firm's overall business strategies.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client requirements to design and implement SAP data management and analytics solutions
- Developing data models and performing complex data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
- Creating visualizations and reports using SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP BusinessObjects BI to enhance insights generation
- Collaborating with clients to understand their data needs and optimize data management processes
- Implementing data quality improvement plans to enhance data integrity and security
- Providing training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools
- Integrating SAP BW/4HANA and SAP Data Intelligence Cloud for seamless data migration and integration
- Utilizing analytical thinking and data analysis software to derive valuable insights from client data
- Navigating complex situations to build meaningful client connections and inspire team members
- Upholding professional and technical standards while interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
One or more SAP certifications in Analytics or Data Modeling — SAP Datasphere, SAP BW/4HANA, or related credentials
Deep hands-on expertise in data modeling within SAP Datasphere and BW/4HANA (InfoObjects, ADSOs, CompositeProviders, graphical/scripted views), with working knowledge of SAP Business Data Cloud
Working proficiency in SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) reporting — building stories, dashboards, and visualizations to validate and showcase modeled data
Strong experience designing semantic layers — dimensions, hierarchies, calculated/restricted key figures, currency conversions — that translate business requirements into robust analytic models
Functional exposure to one or more core workstreams — R2R, SD, P2P — enabling context-rich model and KPI design
Working knowledge of modeling across hybrid/multi-source landscapes (SAP and non-SAP), including federation or integration with Databricks and Snowflake-backed data
Excellence in complex data analysis and model performance optimization
Comfort embracing change and driving innovation in modeling-led analytics consulting, particularly around emerging capabilities like Joule and agentic AI for model design
Developed skills in semantic model governance, access control, and data quality validation at the modeling layer
Proven ability to mentor and upskill teams in modern SAP data modeling and analytics solutions

We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Senior Associate - Billing Platform - Finance Solutions, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize their operational efficiency by analyzing their needs and implementing tailored software solutions. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will focus on Oracle's suite of applications, managing the entire customer journey from lead generation to revenue realization. Your expertise will be crucial in configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, and customer experience solutions to meet organizational needs.
As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your problem-solving skills and critical thinking to navigate complex situations and build meaningful client relationships. You will guide and mentor junior team members, maintaining professional standards while developing a deeper understanding of the business context. Your role will involve anticipating client needs and delivering quality solutions, even when the path forward is not clear.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, conduct fit-gap analysis, and develop scalable Billing Platform solutions. Your ability to lead discussions, frame problem statements, and deliver technical solutions will be key to driving client satisfaction and project success.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing business requirements and conducting fit-gap analysis to develop functional and technical designs for Billing Platform solutions
- Configuring and customizing Billing Platform features including subscription management, pricing, invoicing, and revenue processes
- Developing integrations, workflows, and data migration solutions using APIs and scripting capabilities
- Collaborating with business stakeholders, solution architects, and technical teams to deliver scalable and secure solutions
- Supporting unit, system, and user acceptance testing, and resolving defects to validate solution quality
- Preparing technical and functional documentation and conducting knowledge transfer and user training sessions
- Troubleshooting production issues and performing root cause analysis to maintain solution performance
- Designing and developing integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle ERP
- Building and maintaining billing workflows, rating rules, and taxation processes
- Leading solution workshops and delivering technical solutions aligned with Quote-to-Cash business processes
- Utilizing SQL and reporting tools to support data analysis and reconciliation activities
- Engaging with client stakeholders to gather requirements and recommend solutions that align with industry best practices
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Marketing, Commerce, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Lead-to-Revenue or related Oracle Customer Experience (CX) Revenue Cloud applications
- Demonstrating proficiency in BillingPlatform scripting and configuration
- Utilizing experience with Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) transformation programs
- Developing integrations with enterprise applications like Salesforce and Oracle ERP
- Excelling in stakeholder management and communication skills
- Possessing hands-on experience with Zuora Billing and SAP BRIM applications

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist

Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.

AND/OR

Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities.

Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred.

We are looking for candidates for Customer Support (CS) and Service Desk (SD) roles who can provide excellent customer service, handle customer queries, and resolve technical and service-related issues. - Handle customer queries and resolve issues through calls, chat, and email.

- Understand customer concerns, analyse problems, and provide timely and effective resolutions.

- Rotational weekly offs and work from office are mandatory.

Job Title: Java Developer

Experience: 5 to 8 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Java Developer to design, develop, test, and maintain robust, scalable, and high-performance enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Core Java, object-oriented programming, database technologies, and web application development.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain Java-based applications and services.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Develop, test, and deploy high-quality, scalable, and secure applications.
Create and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with external systems.
Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
Troubleshoot and resolve application issues and performance bottlenecks.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, and Product Owners.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning and delivery.

Strong experience in Core Java (Java 8/11/17).
Good knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOPs) concepts and Design Patterns.
Experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and REST APIs.
Hands-on experience with Hibernate/JPA.
Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
Experience with Collections Framework, Multithreading, Exception Handling, and Java Streams.
Familiarity with Maven/Gradle build tools.
Experience with Git and version control systems.
Understanding of Agile development methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Microservices Architecture.
Knowledge of Spring Security, JWT, and OAuth.
Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or messaging systems.
Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization.
Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Nice to Have
Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
Knowledge of performance tuning and application monitoring.
Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Domain experience in Banking, Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, or Telecom.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Job Description: AEO / SEO / GEO Specialist, Trivitron Digital.ai

Location: Chennai / Mumbai / Bangalore (Onsite only)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 4-8 years

Reports to: Head of Growth / Digital Transformation

About Trivitron Digital.ai (TDAI):
Trivitron Digital.ai is an AI-powered health technology platform. It is a joint venture between Trivitron Healthcare and
ResoHealth. Our products include LIS, RIS, HIS, CRM, LIMS, Claims IQ, peri-operative AI and an AI Health Companion.
Hospitals, diagnostic labs and wellness providers across India, the GCC and emerging markets use them.

The Role:
People now look for information in two places: traditional search engines and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini,
Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. We want TDAI and our customers to be the trusted answer in both. In this role youll
own organic visibility for TDAIs brand and products. Youll also help our hospital, diagnostics and wellness customers grow
their own search and AI visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

1. SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
Own technical, on-page and off-page SEO for TDAI’s websites and product pages
Do keyword research for B2B healthtech terms (e.g., “LIS software India”, “hospital management system UAE”)
and for patient-facing searches made to our customers
Build high-quality backlinks from healthcare, health IT and industry publications in India and the GCC
Run local SEO (Google Business Profile, directories, citations) for multi-location hospital and diagnostic chains
2. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Structure content so it gets picked up for featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice search and AI Overviews
Implement schema markup (MedicalOrganization, Hospital, MedicalTest, FAQ, Product, Organization)
Build FAQ and Q&A content hubs that answer real buyer and patient questions
3. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Track and improve how TDAI and our customers are cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Claude
Build entity authority through Wikipedia/Wikidata, knowledge panels, authoritative mentions, PR and citationworthy
content (research, benchmarks, reports)
Set up prompt-level tracking for brand share-of-voice in AI answers and report on it
4. Customer Growth Services
Audit and improve search and AI visibility for hospital, diagnostics and wellness clients
Create playbooks for doctor profiles, test/package pages, location pages and review management
Connect visibility to business outcomes: appointments, test bookings, leads and footfall
5. Content, Compliance and Collaboration
Work with content, product, clinical and sales teams on content that is accurate and meets E-E-A-T standards
Follow healthcare content norms: medical review, no misleading claims, and data privacy (DPDP Act, UAE regulations)
Track and report on rankings, organic traffic, AI citations, DA/DR, leads and conversions

What You Bring:
4–8 years in SEO, with hands-on exposure to AEO/GEO or AI search visibility
Experience in healthcare, healthtech, diagnostics, hospitals or B2B SaaS (strongly preferred)
Strong command of Ahrefs/SEMrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and schema tools
Familiarity with AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, Otterly, Peec AI, or your own tracking methods)
Working knowledge of HTML, structured data, site architecture and CMS platforms (WordPress, headless CMS)
Excellent written English; regional languages or Arabic are a plus

Job Title: SAP S/4HANA Design Expert MM, Procurement and EWM
Experience: 12+ yrs.
Job Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad / Pune / Mumbai
Work Type: Hybrid
Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent
Qualification: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Role Purpose
The SAP S/4HANA Design Expert will act as ARSs internal design authority for Materials Management, Procurement and Extended Warehouse Management within the S/4HANA transformation programme.

The role will guide business stakeholders through S/4HANA process and design decisions, ensure alignment with fit-to-standard and clean-core principles, and independently review and challenge the System Integrators recommendations.

This is a senior, hands-on role requiring strong SAP MM and EWM consulting expertise, good knowledge of manufacturing operations, and the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders across Procurement, Manufacturing, Warehousing and Finance.

Key Responsibilities

Business Engagement and Guidance
Engage with BPOs, Domain Coordinators, process owners and key users to understand business objectives, operational constraints and improvement opportunities.
Guide the business through S/4HANA process changes and explain the operational impact in clear, non-technical language.
Facilitate design discussions and help stakeholders make informed decisions.
Challenge requests that replicate legacy processes without sufficient business justification.
Distinguish between mandatory requirements, business preferences and unnecessary customisation.
Manage difficult discussions constructively and build alignment across stakeholders with different priorities.
Support the Business Process Expert in resolving cross-domain dependencies and design conflicts.

S/4HANA Design Authority
Act as ARS’s internal design authority for SAP MM, Procurement, Inventory Management and EWM.
Review and validate end-to-end designs proposed by the SI.
Ensure designs follow fit-to-standard, clean-core, process-harmonisation and architectural principles.
Challenge SI assumptions, estimates, customisation proposals and solution recommendations.
Evaluate solution options and clearly communicate their benefits, limitations, risks and business impacts.
Verify that approved requirements are correctly translated into functional designs and configuration.
Review process flows, functional specifications, configuration documents and WRICEF requirements.
Assess deviations from the global template and recommend approval, redesign or escalation.
Ensure traceability between business requirements, design decisions, build and testing.

Functional Scope
The role requires strong hands-on expertise across:
Procure-to-pay processes
Direct and indirect procurement
Purchase requisitions, purchase orders and approvals
Contracts, scheduling agreements and source determination
Inventory management and physical inventory
Goods receipt, goods issue and stock transfers
Subcontracting, external processing and consignment
Invoice verification and Finance integration
Material valuation and automatic account determination
Material master and organisational structures
Batch, serial-number and traceability requirements
Embedded and decentralised EWM scenarios
Inbound, outbound and internal warehouse processes
Put-away, picking, packing, staging and replenishment
Handling-unit, warehouse-task and warehouse-order management
Production supply and receipt from production
RF and mobile warehouse operations
EWM integration with MM, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance
Assessment of basic and advanced EWM capabilities

Cross-Domain Integration and Delivery Assurance
Evaluate the impact of MM and EWM decisions on Finance, Manufacturing, Quality and other connected functions.
Work closely with the Finance, Procurement and Manufacturing Domain Coordinators.
Identify cross-domain dependencies before designs are approved.
Participate in fit-to-standard workshops, design reviews and solution playback sessions.
Review SI deliverables for completeness, quality and compliance with the agreed scope.
Support prioritisation of process gaps, developments and improvements.
Review end-to-end test scenarios and support business teams during testing.
Assist in determining whether defects originate from design, configuration, data or business processes.
Support cutover, deployment and post-go-live stabilisation when required.
Ensure key design decisions, risks, assumptions and exceptions are properly documented.

Required Experience and Competencies
Significant SAP consulting experience, including large-scale transformation programmes.
Strong hands-on expertise in SAP S/4HANA MM, Procurement, Inventory Management and EWM.
Experience in at least two full-cycle S/4HANA implementations, preferably within complex manufacturing organisations.
Strong understanding of integration across Procurement, Warehousing, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance.
Knowledge of S/4HANA simplifications, Fiori, fit-to-standard delivery and clean-core principles.
Ability to review configuration, functional specifications, integration designs and enhancement requirements.
Proven experience reviewing and challenging System Integrator deliverables.
Understanding of master data, migration, testing, cutover and deployment.
Experience with selective data transition or Bluefield programmes would be advantageous.
Knowledge of Ariba and other procurement or warehouse integrations would be beneficial.
Excellent stakeholder-management, facilitation and conflict-resolution skills.
Ability to translate technical topics into clear business language.
Confidence to constructively challenge both business stakeholders and the SI.
Pragmatic, independent and solution-oriented approach.
Need to liaise and collaborate with both Internal MM team and S4 Program. Advisory from Arabelle IT MM Team.

Description:
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.

1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements
Present customized logistics proposals including pricing, SLAs, and VAS offerings
Coordinate with operations and pricing teams to ensure commercially viable deal structures
Achieve monthly targets for new client activations and revenue from new accounts

Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction

3. Account Stabilization & Growth
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Description:
The Marketing and Communications Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers.
Under the leadership of the Director of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel.
This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness.
This role focuses on showcasing Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons.
As part of the Marketing and Communication team, this role is fully connected into resources in their region; Marketing and Communication Managers liaise and build deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization.
This role also gets to do a little bit of everything, from balancing traditional and digital marketing and eCommerce activities to contributing to public relations (PR) activities for the hotel.
Success is measured by how well they help drive the sales and revenue strategy of the property, social media engagement and also by how effectively leveraged the resources around them are to create truly compelling marketing and communications campaigns.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
Required:
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Hotel Marketing and Advertising
- Executes annual marketing plan to budget, in consultation with the GM, Food and Beverage leader, Operations leaders, Director of Marketing Communications, and cluster marketing and ecommerce teams.
- Partners with Operations, Food & Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel.
- Acts as the liaison between the marketing department and advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions.
- Manages F&B media schedules and verifies prompt settlement of accounts.
- Partners with property Revenue Management to verify correct offer loading, verifying advertisement targeting is correctly directed at relevant consumer groups
- Executes email marketing, and display advertising.
- Maintains frequent, active engagement with Cluster eCommerce manager to verify alignment, pull-through, and 2-way communication about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives.
- Verifies all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice.
Social Media Content Management
- Facilitates social media engagement and updating content in local digital channels (eg, hotel website, travel sites).
- Develops and executes promotions campaign in F&B, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels.
- Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly.
Public Relations and Visual Asset Management
- Develops a comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency and and executes post sign-off from GM.
- Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers.
- Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system.
- Writes and distributes all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets.
- Manages the execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities.
- Supports pull through of impactful PR strategy & activities to drive quality press coverage through media engagement, in alignment with communications objectives.
- Verifies the news clippings and other online, print, and social media mention report is completed on a monthly basis for property distribution.
- Manages external vendors and media agencies; works with agency partners and continent PR leader to identify strategic media buys for their hotel(s).
- Surfaces and vets PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel.
- Supports the co-ordination of photography for F&B advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams.
- Manages photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team.
- Acts as central point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery; coordinates with area or cluster marketing to verify all photography adheres to brand voice.
Direct Marketing and Collateral Development
- Coordinates and executes Hotel and F&B printed materials.
- Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner.
- Assists in the production of all property, F&B display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas.
- Promotes collection of competitors collateral and publicity on a monthly basis.
- Manages the execution of F&B direct marketing activities.
- Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA).
General
- Assists and manages the development, co-ordination and execution of all communications activities with a strong emphasis on property F&B promotions and campaigns.
- Helps with the publication of hotel s newsletter(s).
- Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary.
- Assists in the liaison and execution of joint F&B promotions.
- Works with eCommerce to verify the Hotel s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis.
- Partners with Director of Marketing to create marketing plan aligned to hotel sales and revenue strategy.
- Provides training and marketing leadership and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders.
- Coordinates with property and above property eCommerce and Revenue Management teams to report success of property marketing and eCommerce performance.
- Keeps abreast of competition and its collateral, advertising, and marketing efforts and constantly evolving digital and marketing trends.

Main Responsibilities / Job Summary

1. Product manufacture
Ensure the achievement of department objectives and monitor product cost, quality, and timeliness as per production / delivery plan.

Train the team on safety and environmental requirements and procedures.

7. Area of responsibility
a. Maintenance of filling & packing machines as core responsibility along with process machinery.

c. Spares parts management for the plant, Maintenance planning & scheduling

g. Exposure to primary packing (horizontal flow wrapper, vertical form fills sealing machine, can/Jar filling machines, product auto feeding system into the flow wrappers), secondary packing (auto case packing, top loading, or front loading, COBOT or Robo based auto pick & place machines into grey boxes or shippers)
h. Knowledge on various type coding: Contact, Inkjet, Laser coders from reputed vendors like DOMINO, IMAJE, VIDEOJET etc.
