Description:
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.
1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements
Present customized logistics proposals including pricing, SLAs, and VAS offerings
Coordinate with operations and pricing teams to ensure commercially viable deal structures
Achieve monthly targets for new client activations and revenue from new accounts
2. Client Onboarding
Lead end-to-end onboarding for newly signed clients including system setup, account configuration, and first-shipment coordination
Conduct a formal onboarding kick-off call within 48 hours of contract signing
Share onboarding documentation: SOPs, escalation matrices, rate cards, and tracking portals
Coordinate with operations, IT, and customer service teams to ensure smooth Day 1 experience
Monitor first 10 shipments closely flag TAT breaches, address NDR issues, and resolve any documentation gaps
Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction
3. Account Stabilization & Growth
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Description:
Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales Qualifications
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG food/beverage, or hotel industry)

Job description

About the Role

We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.

What Youll Do

Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What Were Looking For

0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?

Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.

If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
We don't just deliver packages. We deliver careers.
India's largest logistics company. 30,000+ customers. Billions in shipments. And we're hiring CLOSERS for our Goa HQ.

The Role:
You dial. You pitch. You close. Repeat
Own the entire sales cycle - Every deal you crack - plays a direct role in growing Delhivery's shipper base. Think of yourself as a growth partner, not just a sales representative
You'll work with businesses of all sizes, understand their logistics pain points, and show them why Delhivery is the answer. Every deal you close moves real products to real people across India

What You'll Own:
> Connect with inbound & outbound clients to identify sales opportunities
> Lead consultative sales conversations that uncover customer needs
> Conduct compelling dashboard demos that convert
> Drive deals from first touchpoint to signed contract
> Own your numbersmeet and exceed monthly and quarterly goals
> Coordinate with operations and support teams to deliver seamless experiences

Must-Have:
> 6 months to 2 years of experience in inside sales/ business development
> Track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets
> Excellent communication and presentation abilities
> Data-driven mindset-you analyze what's working and double down

Good-to-Have:
Experience in logistics, supply chain, or e-commerce
Familiarity with SMB and mid-market sales cycles
Based in Goa or ready to make the move

Why Join us:
Impact at scale - Your work directly fuels India's commerce engine
Uncapped growth - Clear career paths and performance-based advancement
Competitive compensation - Base + incentives that reward results
Location perks - Build your career in Goa (yes, really)
Ownership culture — We hire people who lead with initiative and act with accountability
Ready to deliver impact?
If you're someone who thrives on targets, loves the art of the pitch, and wants to be part of India's logistics revolution—we want to hear from you

Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.

Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.

Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc., amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Functional Competencies: Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Functional Competencies: Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Functional Competencies: Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
Qualifications
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Summary
Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 40-60 lacs GMV per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and co-ordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Rest Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month on month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each of the accounts being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation / Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commission and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from dashboard.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data etc.) and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST etc, amount not credited to partner accounts etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV). Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise / Month Wise / Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications

Desired Skill
Graduate with 3-5 years of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Main Purpose of Job:

To manage the Noodle or Chocolate Manufacturing lines of the factory with regard to Electrical & Automation Maintenance and ensuring No unplanned downtime. Supply (may include in-house generation) and distribution of electricity to ensure that it is at all times safe, reliable, secure and sustainable. It covers low, medium and high voltage installations. Provide factory/site engineering with the required competence on Factory Automation System (FAS), Process Control System and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to effectively support manufacturing operational activities and continuously improve manufacturing performance. The role has a shared responsibility of tasks together with production, warehouse, QA and auxiliary services etc to ensure full requirement and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Management responsibilities:
Define, propose and monitor the plans and objectives of the electrical team in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles and the Electricity & Automation Manufacturing Execution System (E&AMES) Activity as outlined in the Nestl Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
Propose and implement work processes, procedures and technical resources relating to the electrical & automation team.
Lead and coordinate the electrical & automation team and maintain competencies, motivation and performance to achieve the teams mission and objectives.
Propose and control the electrical & automation component of the site M&I budget and any capital projects.
Propose and monitor electricity in accordance with the key performance indicators.
Demonstrate and promote the company's values within the electrical & automation team.
Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.

2. Functional responsibilities:
Ensuring line availability / healtiness of high-speed manufacturing lines and ensuring highest level of efficiency and performance from the lines. Ensure that all personnel performing electrical & automation related activities are legally trained and certified. Question the impact on product safety/quality, people safety and environmental during execution of any activity.
Ensure at all times the technical integrity/performance of the electrical energy supply and distribution.
Ensure at all times safe installations and operations through proper design, protection systems, procedures and training.
Liase with the site Safety Officer on electrical & automation matters relating to safety, electricity distribution, energy conservation, legal compliance, complaints etc.
Coordinate with Production, Quality Management and Engineering to resolve any electrical & automation issues.
Supervise and coordinate electrical & automation maintenance and project work by electricians, automation technicians and contractors.
Ensure proper management of electrical & automation documents (manuals, diagrams, instrument data sheet, software packages/licenses) through efficient filing and archiving procedures. Manage the capturing of electrical energy related information and the distribution of this information to the required stakeholder.

3. Maintenance and Improvement of electrical & automation assets.
Execute the maintenance of the electrical & automation equipment in accordance with the Nestl Maintenance Strategy using Consequence Driven Maintenance (CDM) as the multi-disciplined approach to proactively maintain/improve the fixed assets and Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM) as the process to manage the asset lifecycle. Adopt the Maintenance Excellence vision by striving for the M&I "Proactive Domain".Monitor plant and equipment to ensure optimal operation and reduction of planned and unplanned downtime. Develop and implement maintenance and inspection plans to ensure reliability, sustainability and security of electrical distribution infrastructure. Ensure technical integrity and performance of automation equipment.

4. Installation of new electrical & automation assets
Ensure that the justification, request for approval and reporting are in line with the Guidelines for Capital Investment. Ensure that new installations are designed with a high degree of flexibility to better enable the operations to adjust to a changing environment keeping in mind safety and the issues relating to the environment. Facilitate the introduction and implementation of new technologies in coordination with local, market, central technical and PTC engineering.

5. Continuous Improvement
Initiate and drive Continuous Improvement (CI) in electricity supply and distribution with the aim of achieving optimised plant performance. Ensure that all members of the team play an active role in assisting the client in improving the energy usage and reducing waste across the site through continual improvement initiatives.

Supporting Property Operations and Guest Relations Needs

- Strives to improve service performance.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and executing purchasing strategies, including supplier selection, negotiation, and contract management, to ensure supply chain stability and cost-effectiveness. As a Purchasing Manager / Assistant Purchasing Manager, you re not just overseeing the purchasing process - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

Diploma or degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Hospitality, or related field
Minimum 5 years of purchasing or procurement experience, preferably in a hotel or hospitality environment
Proven ability to source, negotiate, and manage supplier relationships to ensure quality and cost-efficiency
Strong understanding of inventory management, stock control, and procurement systems
Experience in budgeting, cost analysis, and tracking purchasing performance
Familiarity with local procurement regulations, health and safety standards, and sustainability practices
Highly organized with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing operational needs
Ensure that purchasing activities comply with relevant laws, regulations and company policies and uphold the hotels ethical standards.

Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment
Risk Management: To identify and manage supply chain risks, including supply disruptions, price volatility, and compliance issues.
Market Analysis: A comprehensive grasp of market trends and the capacity to anticipate price shifts and supply dynamics to inform prudent purchasing decisions.

Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction

Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. OR

Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met for Restaurant
- Develops, designs, or creates new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions for restaurant.
- Supervises restaurant kitchen shift operations and ensures compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards and procedures.

- Communications production needs to key personnel.
- Assists in developing daily and seasonal menu items for the restaurant.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations regulations.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Estimates daily restaurant production needs.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
Leading Kitchen Team
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Leads shift teams while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Supervises and manages restaurant kitchen employees.
Managing all day-to-day operations.
Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensuring and maintaining the productivity level of employees.
- Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.

- Sets and supports achievement of kitchen goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc

- Effectively investigates, reports and follows-up on employee accidents.
- Knows and implements company safety standards.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.

- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with appropriate skills.

- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

Description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a reliable, experienced and well-organised General Administration & Accounts Executive to join our team in Goa. The role involves managing day-to-day accounting, bookkeeping, banking and general business administration, while providing support in HR, office administration and operational management.

Candidates with prior accounting or finance experience in the hotel, restaurant, hospitality or food industry will be preferred. The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, trustworthy, capable of working independently and interested in building a long-term career with the organisation.

On-site (Office-based) Margao, Goa, India

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounts & Bookkeeping

Maintain accurate day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping records.
Handle purchase and sales invoices, expenses, receipts and payments.
Perform bank, supplier and customer reconciliations.
Maintain cash, petty cash and expense records.
Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable.
Monitor outstanding payments and follow up with relevant parties.
Prepare financial information and reports for management, accountants and auditors.
Support budgeting, cost control and financial administration.
Maintain organised accounting records and supporting documentation.
Assist with accounting and cost management activities related to hotel, restaurant and food business operations.

2. Banking & Financial Administration

Assist with routine banking activities and payment processing.
Maintain payment records and supporting documents.
Coordinate with banks, accountants, suppliers and external service providers.
Ensure financial and administrative tasks are completed accurately and within deadlines.

3. HR & Office Administration

Maintain employee documentation, attendance, leave records and personnel files.
Assist with recruitment, onboarding and employee documentation.
Maintain employment contracts, company records and other confidential documents.
Coordinate office administration and routine operational requirements.
Support management with general HR and administrative activities.

4. General Business & Management Support

Provide administrative support across the company's food, hospitality and IT businesses.
Maintain organised records, schedules, reports and administrative systems.
Coordinate and follow up with employees, suppliers and external parties to ensure timely completion of tasks.
Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and work independently with minimal supervision.
Help develop and maintain efficient administrative processes and internal controls.
Handle confidential company, employee and financial information responsibly.
Take on additional responsibilities across administration, accounts and business operations as the role develops.

Candidate Requirements

Previous professional experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance administration or business administration is required.
Practical knowledge of accounting procedures, financial records and reconciliations.
Experience in hotel, restaurant, hospitality or food-sector accounting will be strongly preferred.
Relevant qualification in Accounting, Commerce, Finance or Business Administration is desirable.
Good working knowledge of accounting software, MS Excel, Google Sheets and standard office applications.
Excellent written and spoken English and Hindi.
Strong organisational, coordination and follow-up skills.
High attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when handling financial information.
Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
Trustworthy, disciplined, practical and resourceful, with a strong sense of responsibility.
Willingness to support multiple business functions and build a long-term career with the organisation.
Candidates residing in or around Margao, Goa, will be given preference.

What We Offer

Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
Stable, full-time, long-term employment.
Exposure to UK and Indian business operations.
Opportunity to work across food, hospitality and technology businesses.
Direct interaction with senior management.
Opportunities to take on greater responsibility and progress into senior accounts, administration or business management roles.

Joining: Immediate.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will be responsible for managing the daily operations of the front office, housekeeping, and guest services teams, and ensuring overall room division efficiency. As a Rooms Division Manager, you re not just overseeing day-to-day rooms division operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. As a Rooms Division Manager, you re not just overseeing day-to-day rooms division operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Proven experience in a senior hotel management role, ideally as a Room Division Manager or similar position.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire staff.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a guest-focused approach.
Strong knowledge of front office, housekeeping, and guest services operations.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and financial reporting.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Oversee front office operations: Manage front desk functions, including check-in/out, guest relations, and conflict resolution
Manage housekeeping operations: Oversee daily room assignments, monitor cleaning performance through inspections, and ensure readiness of guest rooms
Deliver guest service excellence: Ensure high-quality, consistent guest experiences by upholding brand standards and resolving issues with creativity, discretion, and sound judgment
Oversee service operations: Ensure Front Office and Housekeeping systems and procedures support exceptional service, smooth check-in/check-out, and room readiness
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Description:
Position responsible for all the food and beverage operations, which includes all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
Oversees guest and employee satisfaction, maintaining standards and meeting or exceeding ficial goals.
Demonstrates knowledge and proficiency of all applicable food and beverage laws and regulations.
Develops and implements business plan for food and beverage.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Developing and Maintaining Budgets
- Develops and manages all ficial, employee engagement and guest satisfaction plans and actions for Food and Beverage departments.
- Maintains a positive cost management index for kitchen and restaurant operations.
- Utilizes budgets to understand ficial objectives.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Manages the Food and Beverage departments (not catering sales).
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Oversees all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
- Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing service.
- Provides excellent customer service to all employees.
- Responds quickly and proactively to employees concerns.
- Provides a learning atmosphere with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Provides proactive coaching and counseling to team members.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Monitors and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Sets clear expectations with the employees and team leaders and verifies that appropriate rewards are given if expectations are exceeded.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides excellent customer service.
- Responds quickly and proactively to guests concerns.
- Understands the brands service culture.
- Drives alignment of all employees, team leaders and managers to the brands service culture.
- Sets service expectations for all guests internally and externally.
- Takes ownership of a guest complaint/problem until it is resolved or it has been addressed by the appropriate manager or employee.
- Verifies all banquet functions are up to standard and exceed guests expectations.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Manages day-to-day operations, drives quality, and verifies standards are meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Conducts performance reviews in a timely manner.
- Promotes both Guarantee of Fair Treatment and Open Door policies.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Develops an action plan to attack need areas and expand on strengths based on employee engagement and guest satisfaction results.
Additional Responsibilities
- Complies with all corporate accounting procedures.
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Drives effective departmental communication and information systems through logs, department meetings and property meetings.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Role & responsibilities

1. Maintenance and operation of plant utilities like Air compressor, Chillers, Heat pumps, Hot water system, Water system, HVAC systems, Nitrogen plant, HSD yard,Gensets, cooling towers, boilers, NG stations,Transformers, HT switchyards,Electrical systems,Mechanical systems and other utilities related systems.

5. Reporting of daily MIS, Incidents & Deviations and other observations.
6. Execute maintenance activities in a shift by managing available resources to achieve shift maintenance plan.
7. Upkeep the Equipment availability by analysing and reducing the breakdowns.
8. Keep the facility in good condition with proper building maintenance.

11. Support Engineers/technicians, Managers & contractors in carrying out, operation and maintenance planning, detailed scheduling and material ordering-delivery, project workflow and documentation.
12. Ensure all legal, health and safety regulations are being followed.
13. Working as per cGMP guideline and upkeep the facility and all time readiness for audit.
14. Implementing improvement programs and its changes.
15. Identifying the critical spares, consumables for the service floor area and keep them in stock.
16. Lead contractors/vendor/OEMs and non-payroll manpower. Also, define their tasks and required resources.
17. Assist Utility lead to achieve the Department goals and AOP.
18. Contractor onboarding as per site compliance and site timelines.
19. Lead procurements and invoicing of the assigned area and adhere the compliances. (Monitor invoices for accuracy and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.)
20. Track activities & deliverables, and prepare weekly and monthly reports.

Description:
Position has responsibility for supervising and coordinating activities of employees delivering spa services, including salon, skin care, program coordination, reservations, reception desk, massage and locker room areas.
Position focuses on ensuring guest and employee satisfaction and achieving the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the spa, guest services, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Spa Operations and Budgets
- Assumes the responsibilities of the Spa Director in his/her absence.

- Manages supplies and equipment inventories within budget.

- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensuring employees do the same within the team.
- Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
- Assists the Spa Director in managing the day-to-day operations of the spa as necessary.

Description:
Manages all engineering/maintece operations, including maintaining the building, grounds and physical plant with particular attention towards safety, security and asset protection.
Accountable for managing the budget, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintece and energy conservation.
Responsible for maintaining regulatory requirements.
Assists in leading the emergency response team for all facility issues.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the engineering and maintece or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; 1 year experience in the engineering and maintece or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Engineering Operations and Budgets
- Manages the physical plant including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment and electrical systems.
- Ensures regulatory compliance to facility regulations and safety standards.
- Manages and controls heat, light and power and recommends current best methods for energy conservation and economical facility operations.
- Develops specifications and requirements for service contracts and administers such contracts to support building needs.
- Distributes preventive maintece and repair work orders and monitors timeliness and quality of completion.
- Oversees and directs the maintece of grounds, guestrooms, public space, restaurants, property vehicles and recreational facilities.
- Develops a long term plan for preventative maintece and asset protection and overseeing execution of plan.
- Develops project plans in accordance with renovation or new construction needs.
- Contacts contractors for bids and supervising construction to ensure timely completion of projects within budgetary guidelines.
- Builds positive relationships with external customers such as city building/zoning department, fire prevention bureau and vendors.
- Ensures fire crew has complete understanding of all procedures, equipment and alarms.
- Performs monthly property inspection to ensure buildings and grounds are maintained in excellent condition.
- Conducts guest room and common area inspection to ensure guest satisfaction.
- Inspects and evaluates the physical condition of facilities in order to determine the type of work required.
- Recommends or arranges for additional services such as painting, repair work, renovations, and the replacement of furnishings and equipment.
- Selects and orders or purchasing new equipment, supplies, and furnishings.
- Manages parts and equipment inventory.
Maintaining Property Standards
- Ensures building and equipment licenses and certifications are current.
- Maintains property life safety systems (fire fighting equipment, sprinkler systems and alarm systems).
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifying excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Shares plans with property leadership and ensuring corrective action is taken to continuously improve guest satisfaction.
- Strives to improve service performance.

Description:
The Front Office Associate is responsible for delivering exceptional guest service by ensuring smooth check-in and check-out processes, handling guest requests efficiently, maintaining accurate records, and creating a welcoming experience in line with hotel brand standards.
Key Responsibilities
Welcome guests warmly and provide a professional first impression.
Perform check-in and check-out procedures accurately and efficiently.
Handle room reservations, modifications, and cancellations.
Respond promptly to guest inquiries, requests, and complaints, ensuring timely resolution.
Process payments, maintain guest accounts, and prepare accurate billing.
Coordinate with Housekeeping, Engineering, and other departments to ensure guest satisfaction.
Promote hotel facilities, services, loyalty programmes, and special offers.
Maintain the confidentiality of guest information and adhere to data security policies.
Ensure the front desk, lobby, and reception area remain clean and presentable.
Follow hotel SOPs, brand standards, and safety, security, and emergency procedures.
Prepare daily reports and complete shift handovers accurately.
Qualification Skills
Diploma or bachelors degree in Hotel Management or Hospitality.
0 2 years of experience in Front Office operations (freshers may also apply).
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong customer service orientation with a professional appearance.
Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with PMS (Opera/Fidelio or similar) is preferred.
Ability to work in shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
Good problem-solving, multitasking, and teamwork skills.
This role is responsible for ensuring every guest receives a warm welcome, personalized service, and a memorable stay while maintaining the highest standards of hospitality and operational excellence.

About the job
Role - Program Manager (Sales Strategy)
This is an IC role
This is a 6day working role (5days - WFO ; Saturdays - WFH)

Job Overview:
We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Program Manager with a strong focus on business development to drive growth within a Segment of our SME Express parcel division. This role involves strategizing, planning, and managing programs aimed at expanding our market share, strengthening customer relationships, and enhancing our service offerings. The Program Manager will play a key role in identifying new business opportunities, fostering partnerships, and coordinating cross-functional efforts to achieve revenue and growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities:
Business Development & Market Expansion
Develop and implement strategic programs to drive business growth in key logistics & SME markets.
Identify and assess new business opportunities, including partnerships, contracts, and expansion into new regions or service lines.
Conduct market research to stay current with industry trends, competitor activity, and customer needs.
Program Strategy & Execution:
Lead cross-functional initiatives to create, launch, and optimize programs that enhance customer acquisition and retention.
Define clear program goals, KPIs, and timelines to ensure successful execution of business development initiatives.
Manage programs from ideation to execution, ensuring alignment with the company's revenue and growth goals.
Client Relationship Management:
Collaborate closely with the sales and customer service teams to develop tailored solutions that meet client needs.
Conduct regular client meetings and business reviews to gather feedback and identify potential areas for additional services.
Collaboration & Cross-functional Coordination:
Partner with internal teams (operations, marketing, and finance) to design, promote, and deliver value-added solutions.
Data Analysis & Performance Tracking:
Use data and analytics to track program effectiveness, identify trends, and make data-driven recommendations.
Prepare reports on program outcomes, revenue impact, and market expansion, presenting insights to senior leadership.
Leverage CRM tools to maintain a detailed pipeline of business opportunities and track progress against revenue targets.
Budget Management & ROI Analysis:
Oversee program budgets, managing costs to ensure maximum return on investment.
Regularly assess the ROI of business development initiatives and recommend adjustments as needed to maximize profitability.
Identify cost-saving opportunities that do not compromise service quality or hinder growth objectives.
Skills:
Strong strategic planning and decision-making abilities.
Min 1-2yrs exp in program management, driving projects, cross-functional collaboration
Data-driven with strong analytical and reporting skills.
Proficiency with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and project management tools (e.g., MS Project, JIRA).
Highly organized, with strong multitasking skills and the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Description: AVP Commercial
Company Name: Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited

Plant Location: Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh

Corporate Head Office: New Delhi

Industry: Steel & Heavy Manufacturing (Stainless Steel Flats, Coils & Pipes)

Reporting To: Director Plant

Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site


Position Overview
Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited is seeking an experienced, proactive, and commercially astute AVP Commercial to head commercial operations at our manufacturing facility in Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh.

The GM Commercial will oversee plant accounting and financial controls, inventory and store operations, local procurement, logistics, and commercial statutory compliance. The role acts as the primary operational bridge between the manufacturing plant and the Corporate Head Office in New Delhi, ensuring cost efficiency, seamless supply chain execution, rigorous internal controls, and statutory compliance.


Key Responsibilities
1. Plant Accounts & Financial Controls
Direct and monitor day-to-day plant accounts, cost accounting, billing, invoicing, and petty cash management.

Oversee stainless steel manufacturing cost accounting (yield, conversion costs, scrap reconciliation, and power/fuel consumption).

Ensure strict internal financial controls, conduct regular internal audits, and coordinate with statutory auditors.

Manage plant-level GST, TDS, e-Way bills, TCS, and ensure timely filing in close coordination with the Corporate Finance team in New Delhi.

Monitor plant operational expenditures (OPEX) and capital expenditures (CAPEX), preparing monthly variance analyses against approved budgets.

2. Stores & Inventory Management
Oversee comprehensive store operations across raw materials (SS scrap, ingots, billets, flats, coils), consumables, spare parts, rolls, refractories, and finished goods (pipes, coils, flats).

Implement rigorous systems for material receipt (Gate Pass, Weighbridge, Inspection/GRN), issue, and bin card tracking.

Conduct periodic physical inventory audits, reconciliation against ERP/books, and minimize inventory shrinkage or carrying costs.

Identify and manage non-moving, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; establish scrap handling and disposal protocols.

3. Local Procurement & Vendor Management
Formulate and execute local procurement strategies for mechanical and electrical spares, refractories, consumables, oils/lubricants, packaging materials, and general site services.

Evaluate local vendor proposals, negotiate commercial terms, pricing, payment schedules, and delivery timelines to optimize working capital.

Implement vendor evaluation metrics, fostering reliable local supplier networks while enforcing vendor compliance.

Coordinate with Central Corporate Procurement (New Delhi) for high-value raw material intake, ensuring smooth site delivery schedules.

4. Logistics, Dispatch & Weighbridge Commercial Operations
Supervise inbound raw material arrivals and outbound dispatches of finished flats, coils, and pipes.

Exercise commercial control over weighbridge operations, tare/gross weight verifications, and freight audits.

Manage transporter contracts, freight negotiation for local movements, vehicle turnaround times, and transit compliance.

5. Head Office Coordination & Reporting
Act as the nodal contact at the Paonta Sahib unit for all commercial matters directed from the Corporate Office in New Delhi.

Prepare and submit regular Management Information System (MIS) reports, including daily fund requirements, monthly commercial MIS, inventory valuations, and cost-variance reports.

Align plant commercial targets and working capital requirements with corporate business goals.

6. Commercial Statutory Compliance
Ensure adherence to state and central commercial regulations, including GST compliance, e-Way billing rules, and tax documentation.

Monitor commercial documentation related to interstate dispatches, raw material transit permits, and statutory commercial records.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Education:


Bachelors Degree in Commerce (B.Com) / Inter CA / Inter ICWA / MBA in Finance or Operations / B.Tech with an MBA. Full CA / ICWA (CMA) qualification is an added advantage.

Experience:


1520+ years of proven commercial management experience in a manufacturing environment, with at least 57 years in a senior leadership role (DGM/GM).

Direct experience in Steel Manufacturing, Stainless Steel, Rolling Mills, Tube Mills, or Heavy Industrial Fabrication is highly preferred.

Technical Skills:


Hands-on proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, or TallyPrime).

Strong mastery of GST, indirect taxation, inventory accounting, and Excel-based financial reporting.

Competencies:


Strong commercial negotiation and contract management skills.

Strong leadership with the ability to manage commercial, accounts, and stores teams.

Clear, structured communication skills for multi-location reporting and commercial coordination.

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Job Description

Accounts Department
Industry: Tourism / Travel / Hospitality
Department: Accounts Finance
Designation: Accounts Executive / Accountant
Reporting To: Accounts Manager / Management


Job Summary
To manage the companys day-to-day accounting, financial transactions, billing, payments, collections, and financial records accurately and on time, while supporting the smooth financial operations of the tourism business.


Key Responsibilities

A. Daily Accounting
Maintain daily accounting entries in Tally/ERP/accounting software.
Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses, and journal entries.
Maintain cash and bank books.
Check and verify invoices, bills, receipts, and supporting documents.
Maintain proper records of company expenses.


B. Tour Travel Accounts
Prepare and verify invoices for tour packages, hotel bookings, transportation, and other travel services.
Maintain customer-wise and booking-wise payment records.
Track advance payments received from customers.
Monitor pending customer payments and outstanding balances.
Verify vendor bills for hotels, transporters, guides, agents, and other service providers.
Maintain vendor-wise outstanding statements.
Reconcile tour package costs with actual expenses.


C. Bank Cash Management
Prepare bank reconciliation statements.
Monitor daily bank transactions.
Maintain petty cash records.
Verify cash receipts and payments.
Ensure all cash and bank transactions are properly documented.


D. Receivables Payables
Follow up on outstanding customer payments.
Maintain accounts receivable and payable reports.
Process vendor payments after proper verification and approval.
Ensure payments are made according to company policy and agreed terms.


E. GST Taxation Support
Maintain GST-related sales and purchase records.
Assist in preparation of GST returns and other statutory reports.
Maintain proper tax invoices and supporting documents.
Coordinate with CA/tax consultants for taxation-related requirements.
Maintain TDS records and assist with TDS compliance wherever applicable.


F. Salary Employee Accounts
Assist in monthly salary preparation.
Maintain employee advances, deductions, incentives, and reimbursements.
Verify employee expense claims and supporting bills.
Maintain records related to full final settlement.


G. Financial Reporting
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly accounting reports.
Prepare outstanding reports for customers and vendors.
Provide management with revenue, expense, and payment reports.
Assist in monthly closing and preparation of financial statements.


Required Skills
Basic knowledge of accounting principles.
Knowledge of Tally/ERP/accounting software.
Good knowledge of MS Excel.
Basic knowledge of GST, TDS, and taxation.
Good calculation and analytical skills.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to maintain confidential financial information.
Ability to work under deadlines.


Qualification Experience
Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / Equivalent accounting qualification.
Experience: 1-4 years in accounts, any company.
Candidates having good accounting knowledge and computer skills, email drafting skills.

Description:
Job Summary
Position: Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment
Location: Shimla, Himachal Pardesh
Reporting To: National Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment
Based at: State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) State Programme Management Unit (SPMU) office
Project Duration: 3 Years (annual contract, renewable based on performance and availability of funds)
Background
HelpAge India, in partnership with DAY-NRLM and participating SRLMs, is implementing a multi-state pilot to integrate elderly care, active ageing, and community-based caregiving within the Food, Nutrition, Health, and Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (FNHW) framework. The initiative aims to build scalable, community-led elderly inclusion systems through SHG-VO-CLF platforms, strengthen government convergence, and develop caregiving cadres and care economy approaches. To support state-level implementation, a Project Manager- Elderly Inclusion Empowerment will be positioned within the respective SRLM SPMU.
Purpose
The State Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment will provide state-level technical, operational, and coordination support for implementing the Operational Framework under the MoU between HelpAge India and the respective SRLM. The role includes integrating elderly-focused interventions within SRLM systems, strengthening implementation across pilot districts and blocks, facilitating government convergence, and supporting institutionalisation within DAY-NRLM, while guiding district/block teams, community institutions, and caregiving cadres to deliver agreed programme outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Programme Coordination and Implementation: Lead coordination and implementation of the Operational Framework across pilot districts and blocks, ensuring alignment with state plans and the HelpAge India-SRLM MoU.
Coordination Engagement: Act as the key liaison between HelpAge India and SRLM, coordinating across state, district, and block levels, and driving convergence with relevant departments.
Technical Support Capacity Building: Develop and deliver guidelines, tools, and trainings; strengthen elderly inclusion, caregiving systems, and integration of ESHGs within NRLM platforms.
Monitoring Reporting: Track progress, conduct field visits, and lead reporting, evaluations, and documentation of programme outcomes.
Community Systems Convergence: Strengthen Elders Self Help Groups (ESHGs), community caregiving systems and enable elderly access to entitlements, health, social protection, and livelihoods through stakeholder convergence.
Disclaimer: The Job Description above is not an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, and responsibilities associated with the position.
Requirements
Desired Qualifications, Competencies Experience
Masters degree in Social Work, Rural Development, Development Studies, Public Health or related disciplines.
Minimum 4 - 6 years of relevant experience in rural livelihoods, SHG promotion, social inclusion, public health or community development programmes.
Prior experience of working with SRLMs, NRLM institutional platforms or large-scale government programmes will be preferred.
Experience in programme coordination, capacity building and stakeholder engagement.
Understanding of elderly inclusion, social protection, community caregiving or FNHW-related programmes will be an added advantage.
Strong communication, coordination and documentation skills.
Willingness to travel extensively within the state.
Strong programme coordination and facilitation skills.
Ability to work with government systems and community institutions.
Good training and mentoring abilities.
Strong analytical, reporting and documentation skills.
Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multi-stakeholder implementation processes.

Prepare battery layouts, assembly drawings, component drawings and detailed manufacturing drawings.
Support Design and develop flooded tubular lead-acid batteries for inverter, solar, industrial and other deep-cycle applications.
Design and optimize components such as containers, lids, terminal arrangements, handles, vent plugs, gauntlets, grids, spines, straps and associated parts.
Develop accurate 2D drawings and 3D models using AutoCAD and Creo.
Define critical dimensions, tolerances, materials and technical specifications.
Maintain drawing accuracy, revision control and standardization across product families.
Convert product requirement specifications into design concepts and engineering specifications.
Conduct design calculations covering battery capacity, plate configuration, acid volume, component fitment, terminal arrangement, weight and dimensional compliance.
Support prototype development, pilot builds and production trials.
Coordinate with testing teams to prepare DVPR and validation plans.
Support design verification, validation and release through the company stage-gate NPD process.
Ensure completion of design reviews, technical risk assessments and product-release documentation.

Conduct Design FMEA and participate in Process FMEA reviews.
Evaluate product failures and implement corrective design actions.
Apply design-for-manufacturing, design-for-assembly and mistake-proofing principles.
Support value-engineering and product-standardization initiatives.
Prepare technical inputs for moulds, dies, fixtures and inspection gauges.
Participate in mould trials, component trials and sample approval.
Work with suppliers to resolve dimensional, material, fitment and manufacturing concerns.
Support component qualification, pilot-lot evaluation and production approval.
Coordinate with Manufacturing, Quality, Testing, Purchase, Marketing, Service and Supplier Development teams.
Provide technical support during product industrialization and production ramp-up.
Support investigation of field complaints and warranty failures related to product or component design.
Provide technical inputs for product specifications, catalogues, manuals and regulatory submissions.
Prepare and maintain drawings, specifications, bills of materials, engineering change notes and technical reports.
Ensure proper document control and traceability of design changes.
Support internal, customer and certification audits relating to product design and development.
Follow applicable safety, quality and environmental management systems.


Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.
A diploma or advanced qualification in Tool and Die Making, CAD/CAM or Product Design will be an advantage.


Required Experience
Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in product or component design.
Practical experience in the design and development of flooded tubular lead-acid batteries is strongly preferred.
Experience in plastic components, lead-alloy components, tooling, mould development and manufacturing drawings will be valuable.
Exposure to battery manufacturing processes and new-product industrialization is required.

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales
