Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example
Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals
Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals
Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance
Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team
Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns
Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate
Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Job Description: Electrical Maintenance Technician
Department: Maintenance / Cinema / Entertainment

Location: Itanagar

Job Summary
Responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing electrical systems and equipment to ensure safe, uninterrupted, and efficient operations of the cinema premises.
Key Responsibilities
Perform routine inspection and preventive maintenance of electrical systems, wiring, lighting, and electrical panels.
Troubleshoot electrical faults and carry out repairs as required.
Maintain and monitor DG sets, UPS, power backup systems, and related electrical equipment.
Ensure proper functioning of cinema screens, projection-related electrical systems, HVAC electrical components, and other operational equipment.
Monitor electricity consumption and identify opportunities to improve energy efficiency.
Ensure compliance with electrical safety standards and company maintenance procedures.
Maintain maintenance logs, breakdown reports, and records of repairs.
Coordinate with external vendors and contractors for major electrical repairs.
Respond promptly to electrical breakdowns and emergency maintenance requirements.
Qualifications and Experience
ITI or Diploma in Electrical Engineering.
25 years of experience in electrical maintenance, preferably in cinemas, hotels, malls, or commercial establishments.
Practical knowledge of electrical wiring, panels, fault diagnosis, and preventive maintenance.
Knowledge of electrical safety procedures and the use of maintenance tools.

dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer
experience.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to
deliver the best shopping experience to the customers

Eye check-up & Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive

recommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences

right time to pitch the recommended solutions Achieving sales

adherence Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due
communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the
reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment Store upkeep & regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
maintenance Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the storePersonal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma in Optometry Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn

Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Education:
Degree/Diploma from accredited culinary college or university. Ability to effectively read, write and speak English

Experience:
3+ years experience in a 5 star + hotel, cruise ship or high-profile restaurant performing the functions of a similar position.

Certification from accredited advanced food safety program. Extensive knowledge in VSP preferred.

Knowledge, Skills Abilities:
Ability to deliver 5 star culinary products.
Experience in high volume operation of at least 500 meals per service.
Extensive kitchen machinery and knife safety knowledge.
Experience working in all major culinary brigade stations with extensive knowledge in designated station.

Responsible for directing, supervising and assisting in the preparation of all food in the assigned station in the kitchen in accordance with the established company menus and recipes.
Responsible for quality, quantity, attractiveness and correctness of all food items served from the station as per companys standard recipes and follow up with FIFO.
Responsible for the performance, appearance, dress and personal conduct of all employees assigned to his station. Reports on these subjects objectively and timely to his Executive Sous Chef.
Controls actual hours worked of the employees assigned to the station and report any discrepancies between these and the published work schedules to Executive Sous Chef supervising his station.
Responsible for checking that quantity and quality of items ordered from stores are received and stored in proper condition and thereafter used in the correct way. FIFO.
Prepares a daily mise en place list for the designated section in accordance with the planned menu and recipes for the day.
Works closely and cooperates with superiors, colleagues and subordinates in order to achieve the highest possible guest satisfaction from the products served.
Prepares a daily requisition for Executive Chef for all items ordered from stores for use in his station.
Execute all special orders and dietary requirements.
Responsible for helping to maintain a team atmosphere in the department.
Public Health:
Responsible to implement and execute proper maintenance and cleaning procedures in the station assigned to him in order to ensure good appearance and condition of these areas.
Reports any malfunctioning equipment or furnishings in need of repair or refurbishing to the Executive Sous Chef supervising his station.
Maintains a high level of productivity, cleanliness and sanitation throughout the entire station.
Responsible for ensuring that proper work and cleaning methods are being followed in order to produce and serve safe, wholesome, high quality and attractive food for guests and crew.
Responsible for the proper use of equipment and utensils to prevent damage or undue maintenance requirements. Report to have replaced.
Assigns all cleaning responsibilities within his station according to the cleaning schedule and report to the Executive Sous Chef regarding any problems, which have occurred. If station has GPA personnel assigned, he is responsible for his performance.
To be familiar with and execute the Seabourn HESS-MS appropriate to their position.
Assists the Sushi Chef de Cuisine in the preparation of various Sushi products in the speciality restaurant.

The Chef de Partie is required to adopt a pro-active approach in solving challenges that may arise in their station. Guest satisfaction is the ultimate goal and the Chef de Partie should ensure that all decisions made have the guest in mind. Assisting teammates plays an integral role in this position and they should therefor encourage and coach those that work with him.

Reporting Relationships:
The Chef de Partie reports directly to the Chef de Cuisine.

SAP controls design, integration and assurance
Lead pre- and post-implementation control design assessments, fit-gap reviews, configuration testing, and operating effectiveness support across R2R, O2C, P2P, P2M and related cross-functional processes.
Oversee development and review of control activity narratives (CANs), manual control procedures (MCPs), control test scripts (CTSs), risk and control matrices (RCMs), process flows and control ownership/RACI documentation.

Engagement and people leadership
Own engagement planning, budgets, resourcing, work allocation, milestones, quality review, issue resolution and senior stakeholder reporting across concurrent projects.
Coach and review multidisciplinary teams; set clear expectations for documentation, evidence sufficiency, technical accuracy, productivity, and timely delivery.
Build trusted relationships with overseas engagement teams, client process owners, SAP functional and technical leads, compliance teams, and program management offices.
Contribute to proposals, solution development, methodology improvement, knowledge assets, reusable testing accelerators and practice growth.

Job Description: Full Stack Java Developer (Java + Angular/React)
Position: Full Stack Developer (Java + Angular/React)
Experience: 511 Years
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer with 511 years of hands-on experience in Java backend development and modern frontend frameworks such as Angular or React. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications while collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications using Java and Angular/React.
Build robust backend services and RESTful APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.
Develop responsive and user-friendly frontend applications using Angular or React.
Participate in application architecture, design discussions, and technical reviews.
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third-party services.
Write clean, reusable, and testable code following coding standards and best practices.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and code reviews.
Troubleshoot production issues and optimize application performance.
Work closely with DevOps teams for CI/CD implementation and deployments.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, QA, and product teams.
Required Skills
5–11 years of software development experience.
Strong expertise in Java, J2EE, and Spring Boot.
Hands-on experience with Angular (8+) or React.js.
Experience in developing and consuming REST APIs.
Strong understanding of Microservices Architecture.
Experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern UI development.
Good knowledge of SQL databases such as Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
Experience with Git, Maven, Gradle, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills.

Description:
Job Title: Seller Business Development Associate (BDA)
Company: NoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Job Type: Full-time | Field Sales
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune
Experience: Minimum 1 year / Smart Freshers
Industry: Real Estate
Job Summary
We are looking for energetic and customer-focused Business Development Associates (BDA) to join our field sales team. You will interact with property owners and customers, conduct property/site visits, explain NoBroker services, and help drive successful property transactions.
Qualified leads will be provided by the company.
Key Responsibilities
Meet property owners and customers for property sales, rentals, and leases.
Conduct property visits and accompany buyers during site visits.
Explain property details, pricing, and NoBroker services.
Coordinate property photoshoots and ensure accurate property information.
Negotiate with buyers and sellers to support deal closure.
Onboard property owners and promote premium services where applicable.
Visit commercial properties and collect owner details.
Update property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
Eligibility
Diploma or Graduation is mandatory.
Smart Freshers or candidates with up to 2 years of field sales experience.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Comfortable with field sales and customer interaction.
Mandatory Requirements
Own bike and valid driving licence.
Smartphone.
Ability to communicate in at least one of these combinations:
English + Kannada
English + Telugu
English + Tamil
English + Hindi
English + Marathi

Job Summary
The Seller Business Development Associate (BDA) is responsible for acquiring and engaging property owners, conducting field visits, showcasing properties, assisting buyers, and driving successful property transactions. The company provides qualified leads.

Key Responsibilities
Meet property owners and customers to facilitate property sales, rentals, and leases.
Conduct property visits and accompany buyers during site visits.
Explain property features, pricing, and NoBroker services.
Coordinate property photoshoots and ensure accurate property information.
Negotiate pricing between buyers and sellers to close deals.
Onboard property owners and encourage premium service subscriptions where applicable.
Visit commercial properties to collect owner details and explain NoBroker services.
Upload property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets while ensuring excellent customer experience.

Eligibility
Minimum 1 year of field sales experience.
Real estate experience preferred for commercial property hiring.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Comfortable with extensive field travel and customer interaction.

Mandatory Requirements
Bike and valid Driving Licence are mandatory.
Smartphone for field operations.
Good English and regional language communication; manageable Hindi is acceptable in Bangalore.

Preferred Skills
Field Sales,
Business Development
Lead Generation
Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
Property Sales
Negotiation
Client Acquisition
Relationship Building
Sales Closing
Site Visits
Communication Skills
Target Achievement
Time Management.

Description:
Electrical Supervisor

Job Overview

We are seeking a results-driven Electrical Supervisor to join our Engineering & Projects Department at Phoenix Electricals. In this role, you will lead and manage on-site electrical infrastructure operations, ensuring high-quality field execution, technical compliance, and strict
adherence to safety standards across assigned project locations.
This position reports directly to the Project Head and plays a vital role in delivering our infrastructure projects on time and within specification across our Pan-India operational footprint.
Key Responsibilities
1. On-Site Field Execution & Operations

Direct and supervise daily on-site electrical works, including overhead transmission line installation, underground cabling, substation equipment setup, and distribution infrastructure.
Coordinate field labor, riggers, fitters, and specialized sub-contractors to maintain daily execution targets.
Ensure proper utilization, maintenance, and tracking of project materials, heavy machinery, and specialized field equipment on site.
2. Quality Assurance & Technical Compliance
Verify that all field installation work complies with approved single line diagrams (SLDs), route layouts, engineering drawings, and quality assurance plans.
Conduct stage-wise inspections, cable insulation testing (Megger), earth resistance testing, and pre-commissioning checks.
Maintain site quality records, track punch lists, and manage request-for-inspection (RFI) procedures with client or utility representatives.

3. Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) Compliance
Enforce strict compliance with site safety regulations, permit-to-work (PTW) protocols, and risk assessment procedures.
Conduct regular morning toolbox talks (TBT) covering site-specific hazards, high-voltage risks, and working-at-height safety.
Ensure 100% compliance with mandatory personal protective equipment (PPE) across all field personnel.

4. Progress Tracking & Site Coordination
Prepare and submit daily progress reports (DPR), material consumption logs, and site activity records to project management.
Assist in local site management, including Right-of-Way (RoW) clearances, utility coordination, and landowner interactions along project corridors.
Support senior engineers in measuring executed quantities for billing and subcontractor reconciliation.

Required Qualifications & Credentials
Education: ITI Or Diploma
Experience: Proven field execution experience in electrical infrastructure projects, transmission lines, cabling, or substations.

Licenses/Certifications: Valid Electrical Supervisor Competency Certificate / License issued by a State Electrical Licensing Board preferred.
Core Skills:
Strong technical understanding of high-voltage systems, earthing, stringing, and cable jointing procedures.
Ability to read and interpret complex electrical engineering drawings and site schematics.

Strong team leadership, local workforce management, and field problem-solving skills.
Physical fitness to manage active field operations under remote or outdoor site conditions.

Description:
Role Purpose
Own and drive the complete Water Purifier Service across the product lifecycle, ensuring superior customer experience, service excellence, operational efficiency, revenue growth, and profitability. The role will work closely with Product Management, R&D, Quality, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Service teams from product conception to end-of-life support.

Key Responsibilities

Service Operations Excellence
Ensure achievement of category service SLAs, TAT, FFR, productivity, and customer satisfaction targets.
Drive operational excellence through Daily Work Management (DWM), Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Monitor installation, complaints, warranty, and preventive maintenance performance across Direct Service Centers (DSC) and ASP networks.
Ensure effective CRM utilization, customer registration compliance, and consumer database management.

Category Ownership & Business Responsibility
Own the overall Water Purifier Service Category performance, including customer satisfaction, operational KPIs, revenue, cost management, and profitability.
Manage end-to-end service P&L, including warranty cost, spare parts profitability, AMC business, accessories sales, installation revenue, and finished goods referrals.
Develop and execute category service strategy aligned with business growth objectives.

Product Development & NPD Support
Represent Service as a key stakeholder in New Product Development (NPD) and stage-gate reviews.
Provide field insights, voice of customer, serviceability inputs, reliability requirements, and cost optimization recommendations during product design.
Drive service readiness activities before product launch, including service manuals, spare parts planning, troubleshooting tools, training modules, and SOPs.
Monitor post-launch performance and drive corrective actions through RCA and CAPA initiatives.

Product Quality & Process Improvement
Analyze field failures, recurring complaints, and service trends to identify improvement opportunities.
Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and collaborate with Quality, R&D, and Supplier Development teams for corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor product reliability, warranty performance, spare consumption trends, and service cost optimization.

Training & Capability Development
Develop and implement comprehensive training programs for Direct service technicians, Service managers, call center teams, and ASP partners.
Create technical training modules, e-learning content, SOPs, installation guides, service advisories, videos, and knowledge repositories.
Drive capability enhancement through field coaching, skill assessments, certification programs, and performance monitoring.

Service Content & Knowledge Management
Develop and maintain service documentation, troubleshooting guides, installation procedures, technical bulletins, warranty policies, and service advisories.
Ensure timely communication of product updates and service process changes to all stakeholders.

Spare Parts & Supply Chain Management
Own spare parts strategy, forecasting, inventory planning, availability, and lifecycle management.
Optimize spare parts cost, fill rate, inventory health, and service readiness across the network.
Drive standardization and cost-effective sourcing initiatives.

Customer Experience & Digital Service
Drive NPS, CSAT, customer retention, and service experience enhancement programs.
Monitor customer feedback from CRM, contact center, MTRSS customer and marketplaces.
Lead digital initiatives related to service automation, field mobility, self-service tools, customer communication, and analytics.

Revenue & Business Growth
Drive AMC, accessories, consumables, spare parts, upgrades, and installation revenue growth.
Develop service-led business opportunities and customer lifecycle monetization programs.
Enable referral generation and conversion for Water Purifier finished goods sales.
Monitor revenue realization, margins, and profitability across all service revenue streams.

Partner & Stakeholder Management
Manage relationships with DSC team, Branch CS team, ASP partners, Category Business lead, Digital marketing team, Ecom partners, and KAMs.
Ensure alignment between service operations and business objectives through regular reviews and governance mechanisms.
Drive marketplace ratings, reviews, and service performance metrics.

Performance Management & Reporting
Establish and monitor category KPIs, dashboards, and governance mechanisms.
Review business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions.
Prepare periodic MIS, management reviews, business forecasts, and performance reports for leadership.

Key KPIs
NPS / CSAT
Service SLA & TAT Achievement
First-Time Fix (FTFR)
Installation Success Rate
Warranty Cost % to Sales
Spare Parts Availability & Fill Rate
AMC Revenue Growth
Accessories & Consumables Sales
Service Revenue & Profitability
Field Productivity
Field Failure Rate (FFR)
Marketplace Ratings & Reviews
Product Reliability & Quality Metrics
Overall Category P&L Performance

Preferred Experience

10+ years of experience in Service Operations, Product Support, Consumer Durables, Water Purifiers, Appliances, or Similar Categories.
Strong exposure to Product Development, Service Operations, Quality, Spare Parts Management, Revenue Generation, and Business Management.
Proven experience in leading large field service networks and driving customer experience transformation.
Strong analytical, commercial, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities.

Education Qualification:
Bachelors degree, MBA with any specialization

Key Skills/Competencies:
Global mindset - Ability to understand different markets, competitor overview and set the differentiated trend for Vguard
Excellent domain knowledge
Problem Solving & Decision making
Influencing
Business Acumen
Strategic Thinking
Interpersonal Relationships
Effective Decision Making
Enabling Change Management and Developing People
Familiarity with MS office, CRM systems and other CRM related practices
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively

Description:
EY- Process & Controls Risk Consulting – Manager -IA Capital Projects
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the team in client engagements related to Risk Consulting, Internal Audit, GRC Consulting for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We’re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Real Estate and Construction sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The current role requires executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Responsible for leading and executing client engagements and meeting the expectations of the client and the onsite team within the MENA region.
Ability to interact with all levels of management, including C-Suite executives.
Perform end-to-end internal audits from planning to reporting including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrix / audit work program, control testing to assess their design and operating effectiveness, preparation of audit report and agreeing issues/ actions with management.
Have an in-depth understanding of the Real Estate, Capital Projects, and Construction industry risks/issues/trends and end-to-end business processes.
Demonstrate knowledge and experience of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, including understanding of governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
Assess business cases for capital projects, analyzing their structure, assumptions, and feasibility.
Lead audits with engineering, planning, or cost-related components, including review of master planning, engineering phases, stage gate methods, and design maturity.
Understand cost estimating principles, cost estimate classifications, LPM build-up techniques, and perform BoQ analysis and material take-offs.
Evaluate procurement, contract, and commercial practices, and apply project control principles (schedule, cost, risk, reporting).
Analyze integrity, completeness and accuracy of project plans, cost estimates, risk plans, and interpret project documentation such as contracts, reports, and dashboards.
Review and interpret resource plans and schedules to assess alignment with project objectives.
Deliver/manage engagements on time, within budget, and at high quality.
Identify key areas of improvement in the client's business processes and add value through insightful recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities such as proposal preparation and lead identification.
Always comply with the firm’s quality and risk management policies.
Manage multiple assignments and associated project teams.
Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with clients.
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet performance goals and grow their careers.
Manage engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, proposals, and new solutions/methodologies.
Skills and attributes for success
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice
Highly analytical, organised and meticulous consulting skills
Demonstrating and applying strong project management skills, inspiring teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members
Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadline
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and quality assurance
Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis & validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 8 years of relevant work experience in Internal Audit / Risk Management, with a focus on the Real Estate, Construction, or Capital Projects sector.
Experience leading or supporting audits involving cost estimation, engineering reviews, procurement, and project controls.
Ability to interpret and assess detailed project documentation, including project charters, schedules, cost plans, and risk assessments.
A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally.

Talent Aquisition
Learning Deployment Specialist - Associate
Team:Talent Development - Learning Development

The opportunity
As a Learning Deployment Specialist within the GDS Talent Services - LD Hub, you will coordinate the end-to-end deployment of learning programmes and projects for EY teams across regions and time zones. You will manage schedules, learning-system setup, logistics, budgets, compliance and stakeholder engagement, while producing virtual sessions as needed and delivering a consistent, high-quality learner experience in line with agreed service levels.
Your key responsibilities Learning and project deployment
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to schedule offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the end-to-end execution of Learning course deployment plans and budgets, including conference and event management including:
Arranging training material
Monitoring of participant nominations working alongside Deployment Administration Team
Management of learner cancellations, no shows and missed sessions, including coordinating training dates and nominations from different areas of the business
First point of contact for queries from the practice in relation to the courses assigned, in addition to ongoing management of learning mailboxes and referrals from Deployment Administration Team
Prepare facilitators for delivery of Learning courses (logistics) and support in the management of facilitators
Provide oversight of Learning Deployment administration activities, taking responsibility for the detailed review of work performed by the Deployment Administration Team assigned.

Support the hosting and production of online modules, webcasts and virtual learning projects. Advise on best practice, for example interactivity during virtual classroom sessions
Virtual Producer role where Virtual Producer team cant support
Realise operational excellence through maintaining thorough understanding of, and adherence to, the Learning Deployment Operating Model
Ideas generation and rollout of networking elements within virtual learning programmes
Venue booking, accommodation booking for residential courses and ongoing management
Ensure CE credits awarded to Learning participants and instructors where applicable
Supporting on projects across the Learning and/or Leadership Development TD team(s) as required
Financial Management
Support the budget, accruals, forecasts, and actual costs of courses/projects you are responsible for.
Support all Finance related activities as per the Deployment model.
Support with monthly/annual finance activities/requests from Enablement/Operations team.
Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain close working relationships with onshore and offshore colleagues.
Build and maintain close working relationships with Deployment Administration team (where relevant).
Coach and support the Deployment Administration team to increase their knowledge, skills and competence within their role along with their understanding of the region, by providing transparent and supportive feedback.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders relevant for courses and client groups to enable the successful deployment. Stakeholders may include Deployment Administration Team, Portfolio Managers, Senior Learning Associates, Learning Associates, Enablement team, Service Line Talent Development Teams, Global Deployment Team, Facilitators, external suppliers.
Measure Learning
Access reports on Learning course L1-L3 evaluation feedback and analyse feedback from course participants to continually improve course offerings.
Accurate reporting and tracking of course consumption and satisfaction reporting.
Continuous Improvement
Document lessons learned and refine deployment processes.
Stay updated on SuccessFactors features and best practices in learning deployment.
Generate new ideas/suggest improvements/possible solutions.
Team
Contribute to other activities or projects across wider Talent Development functions.
Support the induction of new team members.

Strong project management skills to deliver and ensure seamless execution of portfolio tasks.
Proactive problem solver with a solutions mindset, willing to adjust work schedules as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Strong IT skills, particularly in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint. There will be a test to determine your knowledge.
Experience in using Power BI, PowerApps, and an openness to learn and use AI will be preferred.
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
Strong team worker, with enthusiastic, can-do approach, with ability to coordinate and work as one team .
Commercial acumen and business awareness.
Commitment to driving and delivering quality services and products to Talent, ensuring high standards are met.
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly, adapting to changing environments and priorities.
Ability to engage and influence others, demonstrating good change management skills and a desire to drive process improvements.
Experience in curating and maintaining knowledge resources, including documentation and SharePoint sites, to enhance accessibility and usability for participants.
Experience in establishing and managing key stakeholder relationships, including external vendors and key internal stakeholders.
Strong team worker with an enthusiastic, can-do approach, capable of coordinating and working as one team .
AI Skills
Working knowledge of Generative AI tools and effective prompting.
Ability to leverage AI to improve efficiency, automation, reporting, and learner experience.
Experience
Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline; a Human Resources diploma is an advantage.
Experience in learning deployment or programme coordination, or a strong interest in developing a career in learning.
Experience in a professional services or corporate environment and working across international and diverse teams.

Training or certification in producing Microsoft Teams, Zoom or Webex sessions is highly desirable/essential.
Flexibility to work European Time Zone business hours; adjust schedules for peak demand and virtual learning support when required.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Helps drive company values and philosophy and ensures all training and development activities are strategically linked to the organization s mission and vision. Works with property leadership team to identify and address employee and organizational development needs. The position is responsible for ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results. Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills. Conducts needs assessments, designs and develops training programs and facilitates the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs. Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Administering Employee Training Programs
- Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
- Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
- Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.
Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets
- Ensures all training and development activities (department specific and general property training) are strategically linked to the organization s mission and vision.
- Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
- Makes any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Managing Training Budgets
- Participates in the development of the Training budget as required.
- Manages budget in alignment with Human Resources and property ficial goals.
- Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Associate Director
AI Strategy
EY-Parthenon | EY Global Delivery Services (GDS)
Role Overview
EY GDS is seeking a highly experienced Associate Director - AI Strategy to lead the development and execution of AI-led business transformation engagements within EY-Parthenon s global strategy consulting practice.
This role sits at the intersection of strategy, artificial intelligence, generative AI, data analytics, digital transformation and value creation. The Associate Director will partner with global EY-Parthenon leadership and client executives to shape enterprise AI strategies, identify growth and efficiency opportunities, establish AI governance frameworks and deliver large-scale AI transformation programmes.
The individual will play a critical role in building EY-Parthenon s AI Strategy capabilities across GDS while supporting client pursuits, thought leadership, innovation initiatives and high-impact transformation engagements.
Key Responsibilities
AI Strategy Enterprise Transformation
Lead AI strategy engagements for Fortune 500 and private equity-backed organisations across sectors.
Advise C-suite executives on AI-enabled growth, operating model transformation, productivity enhancement and innovation opportunities.
Develop enterprise AI and Generative AI roadmaps aligned to business and value creation objectives.
Conduct AI maturity assessments and identify capability gaps across people, process, technology and governance.
Define target operating models for AI adoption at enterprise scale.
Support post-merger integration and value creation programmes through AI-enabled business transformation.
Generative AI Agentic AI Advisory
Identify, prioritise and evaluate AI, GenAI and Agentic AI use cases.
Design AI-driven value realisation frameworks and business cases.
Advise clients on Large Language Models (LLMs), AI platforms, intelligent automation, digital workers and emerging technologies.
Support enterprise-wide GenAI adoption strategies and scaling approaches.
Collaborate with technology teams to translate strategy into execution roadmaps.
AI Governance, Risk Responsible AI
Design and implement Responsible AI frameworks.
Establish AI governance models, controls, policies and oversight mechanisms.
Assess AI-related risks including data privacy, cybersecurity, model bias, explainability and regulatory compliance.
Support clients in developing Trusted AI and AI assurance programmes.
Advise executive stakeholders on emerging AI regulations and industry best practices.
Private Equity Value Creation Support
Partner with EY-Parthenon value creation teams to identify AI-enabled EBITDA improvement opportunities.
Support commercial due diligence and technology diligence engagements from an AI perspective.
Develop AI-led transformation opportunities for portfolio companies.
Identify opportunities for cost optimisation, process automation and operational efficiency.
Business Development Market Leadership
Lead proposal development and client presentations.
Support account growth and strategic pursuit initiatives.
Build reusable AI strategy methodologies, assets and accelerators.
Publish thought leadership, white papers and market insights.
Represent EY-Parthenon at industry forums and client events.
Leadership People Development
Lead multidisciplinary teams of strategy consultants, data scientists, AI specialists and transformation professionals.
Coach and mentor Managers, Senior Managers and Consultants.
Drive capability development within the AI Strategy practice.
Support recruitment, workforce planning and talent development initiatives.
Foster an innovation-led and collaborative culture across global teams.
Expected Scope of Responsibility
Independently manage multiple large consulting engagements.
Own senior client relationships and executive stakeholder interactions.
Drive complex workstreams with minimal Partner oversight.
Contribute to practice revenue growth.
Build scalable AI consulting capabilities across EY GDS.
Collaborate with global EY-Parthenon, Consulting, Technology, Data Analytics and EY.ai teams.
Preferred Experience
Essential
15+ years of consulting, strategy, technology, analytics or digital transformation experience.
5+ years leading enterprise-scale AI, analytics or transformation programmes.
Demonstrated experience working with C-suite stakeholders.
Strong understanding of strategic planning and business transformation.
Experience leading global delivery and distributed teams.
Preferred
Experience in strategy consulting firms such as EY-Parthenon, EY Consulting, MBB, Big Four, Accenture Strategy, Kearney, Strategy or equivalent.
Experience supporting Private Equity, Corporate Strategy or Value Creation engagements.
Experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models, AI governance, data strategy, advanced analytics, intelligent automation, digital workforce solutions and cloud-based AI platforms.
Qualifications
Education
Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Statistics, Business or a related discipline.
Preferred Qualifications
MBA from a reputed institution.
Master s degree in AI, Data Science, Analytics, Technology Management or a related field.
Professional certifications in AI, Cloud, Analytics or Agile methodologies.
Key Competencies
Capability Area - Expected Competencies
Strategic Leadership - Enterprise strategy development; market assessment and competitive analysis; value creation planning; executive stakeholder management
AI Emerging Technology - AI strategy; Generative AI; AI governance; digital transformation; data and analytics strategy; AI operating models
Consulting Excellence - Structured problem-solving; engagement leadership; workshop facilitation; executive storytelling; financial and business case modelling
Commercial Acumen - Revenue generation; proposal leadership; account management; practice building
Success Measures
Client Outcomes
Successful delivery of AI Strategy engagements
Client satisfaction and relationship growth
Quantifiable business value realised for clients
Commercial Performance
Sales and pipeline contribution
Proposal conversion rate
Account expansion and revenue growth
Practice Development
AI strategy capability development
Thought leadership contributions
Development of reusable methodologies and offerings
People Leadership
Team engagement and retention
Coaching and talent development
Leadership effectiveness

The ideal candidate combines the strategic thinking of an EY-Parthenon consultant with the practical AI transformation experience of a technology leader. They will have a proven track record of shaping AI-enabled business strategies, driving executive alignment, building governance frameworks, developing AI-driven value creation opportunities and leading globally distributed consulting teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.

Description:
Human Resources Coordinator
Create and maintain filing systems.
Create and type office correspondence using a computer.
Distribute and route mail.
Order and track Human Resources office supplies and forms.
Answer phone calls and record messages.
Create new employee personnel file.
Assist walk-in candidates with application procedures.
Maintain space designated for completing applications and ensure it is clean, well maintained, and accessible to individuals with disabilities.
Respond to questions, requests, and concerns from employees and management regarding company and Human Resources programs, policies and guidelines.
Inform Human Resources management of issues related to employee relations within the division or property.
Maintain confidentiality and security of employee and property records, files, and information.
Ensure accurate maintece of all employee records and files (eg, interview documents, I-9s).
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards.
Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
EY- Process & Controls Risk Consulting – Senior - IA Capital Projects
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the team in client engagements related to Risk Consulting, Internal Audit, GRC Consulting for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We’re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Real Estate and Construction sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The role requires supporting and executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate and construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Execute assigned workstreams in client engagements and coordinate effectively with the onsite team across the MENA region.
Interact professionally with client stakeholders and support discussions with senior management.
Perform end-to-end internal audit activities, including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrices and audit work programs, control testing, documentation of findings, and preparation of draft reports.
Apply knowledge of risks, issues, trends, and end-to-end business processes in the Real Estate, Capital Projects, and Construction sectors.
Support reviews of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
Review capital project business cases, including key assumptions, structure, and feasibility.
Perform audit procedures covering engineering, planning, and cost-related areas, including master planning, engineering phases, stage-gate methods, and design maturity.
Apply cost-estimating principles, cost-estimate classifications, LPM build-up techniques, and undertake BoQ analysis and material take-offs.
Review procurement, contract, and commercial practices and apply project-control principles relating to schedule, cost, risk, and reporting.
Analyze the integrity, completeness, and accuracy of project plans, cost estimates, and risk plans, and interpret contracts, reports, and dashboards.
Review resource plans and schedules to assess their alignment with project objectives.
Complete assigned work within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards, and promptly escalate issues to engagement leadership.
Identify process improvement opportunities and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations.
Support business development activities, including research, proposal preparation, and development of marketing collateral.
Comply with the firm’s quality and risk management policies at all times.
Manage multiple assigned tasks and workstreams under the guidance of engagement leadership.
Maintain proactive communication and professional working relationships with clients and team members.
Guide junior team members on assigned tasks and review their work where required.
Support engagement administration, budget monitoring, methodology development, and preparation of new solutions.
Skills and attributes for success
Excellent command of spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at short notice
Strong analytical, organizational, and consulting skills
Ability to manage assigned workstreams, collaborate effectively, and take ownership of deliverables
Ability to multitask and deliver quality work under tight deadlines
Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and commitment to quality
Proficiency in MS Office Suite, data analysis, and validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience in Internal Audit or Risk Management, preferably within the Real Estate, Construction, or Capital Projects sector.
Experience executing or supporting audits involving cost estimation, engineering reviews, procurement, or project controls.
Ability to interpret and assess project documentation, including project charters, schedules, cost plans, and risk assessments.
A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally.

Role title
Job Description
Supervising Associate - Service Excellence
Job Summary
Talent Services act as operational business partners to regional talent teams and global functions, offering dedicated support to candidates and employees. Team provides expert advise and facilitate scalable, high-quality services at an economical cost model. We are a crucial part of the EY global talent operating model, supporting its All In strategy.
Support the analysis, mapping, and re imagining of Talent processes as part of EY GDS Service Excellence and Enablement transformation initiatives, with strong ownership of process artefacts, governance, and documentation quality across the deployment lifecycle.
.
Key Role and Responsibilities
The role supports EY GDS Enablement Services by executing high quality process analysis and documentation for Talent transformation programmes. The Supervising Associate will work closely with Config, Product, Business Analysis, Data, and Change & Integration teams to ensure that current state and future state Talent processes are accurately mapped, validated, governed, and ready for deployment, while embedding Service Excellence, continuous improvement, and change readiness principles.
Process Analysis, Mapping & Documentation Excellence
Document current state (L4) and future state (L5) Talent processes using standard programme templates and EY methodologies.
Develop and maintain L5 blueprints, user journeys (UJs), swimlane diagrams, and process variants, ensuring traceability to design decisions and business outcomes.
Perform structured analysis of process variants, edge cases, handoffs, and dependencies across Talent sub processes.
Update UJs, L4s, and L5s in line with configuration, design, data, and integration decisions.
Support creation of methods documents and process playbooks where required.
Delivery Support, Governance & Execution Discipline
Participate in design workshops, playback sessions, focus groups, and usability testing; take structured, decision oriented notes and translate them into validated artefacts.
Maintain the Process & Enablement (P&E) repository, documentation tracker, and version control logs to ensure audit ready governance.
Ensure timely completion of assigned deliverables with disciplined execution, accuracy, and attention to detail.
Act as a Business Analyst for Talent technology initiatives where process design is tightly coupled with system implementation.
Change, Adoption & Capability Enablement
Provide structured inputs into Change Impact Assessments (CIA) by identifying role level, activity level, and behavioural changes.
Support development of training materials, job aids, and playback decks aligned to future state processes.
Consolidate and synthesize insights from focus groups and usability tests to improve design and adoption readiness.
Support broader continuous improvement and transformation initiatives within Talent and Enablement Services.
Service Excellence & Continuous Improvement Alignment
Contribute to process maturity assessments, KPI definition, and benefits tracking for Talent processes.
Support RCA workshops, issue analysis, and closure tracking where process gaps are identified.
Share best practices, standardization opportunities, and re useable assets across Service Excellence programmes.
Align process deliverables to EY s Service Excellence, Quality, Agile, and Business Excellence frameworks.
Skills & Experience Required
Experience
3-5 years of experience in business analysis, HR operations, Talent processes, or process documentation roles.
Hands on experience supporting process transformation, technology enablement, or large scale deployments.
Prior exposure to global delivery / shared services / consulting environments preferred.
Core Skills
Strong attention to detail, logical structuring, and process thinking.
Proficiency with Visio, Excel, PowerPoint, and structured documentation templates.
Ability to collaborate with Config, Product, BA, Data, and Change & Integration stakeholders to refine artefacts.
Strong written and visual communication skills suitable for senior stakeholder playback.
Foundational understanding of process re engineering, metrics, and quality concepts (Lean / Six Sigma exposure is an advantage).
Comfort working in fast paced transformation programmes with evolving requirements.
We invite you to take on this crucial role to facilitate transformative change and enhance excellence within our Talent service delivery operations. Your leadership and expertise will be essential in achieving our objectives and upholding EY s standard of excellence.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong technical foundation
Process Reengineering and Technology mindset
Disciplined Execution of the tasks.
Global Mindset
Influencing and Negotiation skills
Change Management, Adaptability and Agility
Innovative mindset and ability to relevant models suiting the context
What we look for
A person who has the energy and enthusiasm to initiate change with appropriate intentions. Demonstrates a commitment to positively impacting the overall situation. Focus on finding solutions and is willing to ask questions to develop creative resolutions. Genuine, approachable, and capable of uniting a team to work collaboratively towards a shared vision.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Oracle Fusion - Finance Functional - Manager
Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Finance Functional Manager with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience and strong finance-domain and accounting knowledge. The role requires substantial hands-on implementation and support experience across Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), General Ledger (GL), Oracle Fusion Tax and Subledger Accounting (SLA). The successful candidate will lead functional delivery, solution design, client workshops and project teams while remaining actively involved in configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
Lead end-to-end Oracle Fusion Finance implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
Provide hands-on functional leadership across AP, AR, FA, CM, GL, Fusion Tax and SLA, including configuration, solution validation and issue resolution.
Analyse client finance and accounting requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials processes and controls.
Design enterprise structures, chart of accounts, ledgers, accounting calendars, business units, tax structures, subledger accounting rules and financial transaction flows.
Lead fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design, solution walkthroughs and stakeholder sign-offs.
Prepare and review functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, training materials and operating procedures.
Manage finance integrations with Procurement, SCM, Projects, HCM, banking, tax, reporting and external applications.
Drive CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including reconciliation and defect resolution.
Apply strong accounting knowledge to validate journals, period close, reconciliations, statutory and management reporting, taxation and audit requirements.
Manage scope, estimates, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, governance and stakeholder communication.
Lead, mentor and review the work of functional consultants while collaborating effectively with technical, integration, data and reporting teams.
Support pre-sales, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, demonstrations and internal capability-building initiatives as required.
Experience:
Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in Oracle Financials, with substantial hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials.
Strong real-world implementation and support experience across AP, AR, FA, CM, GL, Fusion Tax and SLA; candidates must be able to configure and troubleshoot these modules independently.
Deep understanding of finance and accounting concepts, including procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, record-to-report, asset accounting, bank reconciliation, taxation, period close and financial reporting.
Experience in at least three full lifecycle Oracle Financials implementations, including at least two Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials implementations.
Proven experience leading finance workstreams, client workshops, solution design, testing, data migration, cutover and post-go-live support.
Experience in client-facing delivery, project planning, effort estimation, team management and senior stakeholder communication.
Experience across major sectors such as government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, and power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills:
Strong leadership, customer handling skills and ability to lead and mentor team members.
Ability to drive projects and teams independently, work under pressure, and meet deadlines.
Effective communication skills and ability to translate requirements into design documents.
Excellent organizational, time management, analytical and critical thinking skills.
Ability to acquire, absorb, and apply complex business knowledge to problems quickly.
Ability to follow well-defined release management processes and stay focused on release priorities.
Must have a valid passport for business traveling, which involves work at client sites. Willing to work in MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Understanding of AI applications in project portfolio management, including predictive analytics, automation tools, and AI-driven insights.
Education:
Mandatory qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA), MBA in Finance, ACCA or CMA from a recognised institution.
Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certification is preferred.

JOB SUMMARY
Manages the daily kitchen utility operations. Areas of responsibilities include dish room operations, night cleaning, back dock cleaning and maintenance, banquet plating and food running. Supervises kitchen associates not actively engaged in cooking (e.g., dishwashers, kitchen helpers, etc.). Strives to continually improve guest and associate satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the procurement, food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the procurement, food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Orders and manages necessary supplies. Ensuring workers have supplies, equipment, tools, and uniforms necessary to do their jobs.
- Schedules events, programs, and activities, as well as the work of others.
- Monitors the inflow of ordered materials and the maintenance of current materials.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Assists with an effective dish room equipment repair and maintenance program.
- Conducts china, glass and silver inventories.
- Control inventories of food, equipment, smallware, and liquor, and report shortages to designated personnel.
- Coordinates banquet plating and food running with Banquet Chef and Banquet Maitred.
- Enforces proper breakdown procedures for banquets, restaurants, room service and associate cafeteria.
- Ensures compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Inspect supplies, equipment, and work areas in order to ensure efficient service and conformance to standards.
- Inspects food holding and transport equipment and maintains in working order.
- Manages all equipment, china, glass and silver and ensures adequate clean supplies of each.
- Operates and maintains all department equipment and reports malfunctions.
- Performs all duties of utility associates as necessary.
- Purchases appropriate supplies and manage inventories according to budget.
- Supervises dish room shift operations.
- Knows and implements brand s Safety Standards.
Providing and Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Attends meetings and communicates with executives and peers as an effort to improve quality of service.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensures the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Empowers associates to provide excellent customer service.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Recruits, interviews, selects, hires, and promotes associates in the organization.
- Brings issues to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources as necessary.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Trains associates in safety procedures and supervises their ability to follow loss prevention policies to prevent accidents and control costs.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for associates to receive the appropriate new hiring training to successfully perform their job.
