And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
As a content management specialist supporting the global content team, the candidate will be required to perform production activities in Adobe Experience Manager. This includes uploading content, choosing the correct modules to achieve marketing purpose, publishing content, and assuring the quality control and visual aesthetics of content, images, videos and other files. The candidate will also be responsible for diagnosing, repairing, maintaining, and upgrading all pages while ensuring its optimal performance.
Your key responsibilities
Create a webpage based on all information provided/ add proper components/modules - as speci ed in the word document received from stakeholder/editor
Upload and publish content on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) for ey.com and related sites
Comfortable in using Content Management System (CMS) - managing, creating, and publishing the pages
Collaborate with stakeholders, designers and approvers to ensure content is published on time
Possess an eye for design and basic knowledge in design software such as Photoshop, Adobe Premiere and MS O ce software
Understand the offerings of AEM CMS to suggest the right templates and modules to the stakeholders for achievement of their marketing purpose
Good with image selection with respective to the content
Must have experience and be comfortable working closely with global teams
Be professional, con dent and enthusiastic; adapt to exible work timings; demonstrate exceptional work ethics and customer focus
Familiar with different content management systems
Possess a basic understanding of HTML
Demonstrate exceptional project coordination skills
Skills and attributes for success
Experience working within a complex web environment with global and local branches
Understands website best practices (image sizing, link placements, responsive design)
Familiar working in content management and digital asset management systems, ideally Adobe Experience Manager
Good with Photoshop and image manipulation
An eye for presentation and attention to detail
Possess a mindset to learn things and undertake add-on responsibilities
To qualify for the role, you must have
Understanding of AEM tool and complete understanding of diagnosing, repairing, maintaining, and upgrading all pages while ensuring its optimal performance
Ideally, you ll also have
Understanding of HTML
Experience with visual asset management
Technologies and Tools
AEM tool
Basic understanding of Sprinklr
Brightcove
Crownpeak
Basic understanding of Analytics
Basic understanding of Flourish
What we look for
Bachelor s or master s degree
Minimum 5 years of work experience in using AEM
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success, as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Role: Workday Financials Delivery Manager
Experience: 10 to 15 years
Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certification: Workday certification (Mandatory)

The Opportunity

As a Workday Financials Delivery Manager at PwC AC, you will lead delivery across Workday Financial Management engagements with a focus on Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and overall delivery coordination.
The role combines strong Workday Financials functional knowledge with delivery leadership. You will coordinate across functional and technical workstreams, manage priorities and dependencies, oversee quality and timelines, and act as a key point of contact for client and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate Workday Financials delivery across R2R and P2P workstreams, ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines and dependencies.
Provide functional oversight across areas such as general accounting, journals, close, supplier accounts, procurement, expenses, payments and settlements.
Work with client stakeholders to understand business priorities, assess requirements and guide solution decisions.
Manage delivery of enhancements, production support, releases and continuous improvement initiatives.
Review solution designs and functional deliverables to ensure quality, scalability and alignment with Workday leading practices.
Coordinate across Financials, Integrations, Reporting, Security and other dependent workstreams to resolve issues and manage end-to-end impacts.
Track delivery risks, issues, dependencies and escalations, and drive them to closure.
Lead planning, prioritization and allocation of work across the team while balancing delivery commitments and capacity.
Provide guidance, coaching and functional oversight to Senior Associates and Associates.
Support stakeholder reporting, governance discussions and overall service delivery performance.
What You Bring
Approximately 810 years of relevant experience, including strong hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management and experience leading delivery or functional workstreams.
Strong functional knowledge of R2R and/or P2P, with good understanding of end-to-end financial business processes.
Experience across key Workday Financials capabilities such as Accounting, Supplier Accounts, Procurement, Expenses, Banking, Settlement and related business processes.
Experience leading or coordinating multiple functional and technical workstreams within Workday implementations, optimization programs or managed-services engagements.
Strong understanding of the Workday delivery lifecycle, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and production support.
Ability to review functional solutions, identify cross-workstream impacts and guide teams toward scalable solutions.
Experience managing client stakeholders, priorities, escalations and competing delivery demands.
Ability to independently manage delivery planning, risks, dependencies and team execution.
Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and providing functional direction.
Experience across both R2R and P2P is preferred; deep expertise in one with good working knowledge of the other is acceptable.
Workday Financial Management certification or relevant accreditation is preferred.
AboutCompany:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Salesforce Revenue Cloud- Sr. Associate, you will engage with clients to deliver innovative Salesforce solutions that drive business transformation. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex business challenges and develop tailored solutions that meet client needs. This role offers the chance to work directly with clients, building meaningful relationships and gaining insights into their business operations.
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on relationship building and managing others. You will navigate complex situations, anticipate client needs, and deliver quality solutions. Your role will involve mentoring junior team members, guiding them through project tasks, and fostering a collaborative environment. You will also have the opportunity to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills, all while contributing to the firm's strategic goals.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be at the forefront of delivering Salesforce consulting services, helping clients optimize their business processes and achieve their objectives. Your contributions will be integral to the success of client engagements and the overall growth of the practice.

Description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
A Day in the Life
The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) business partners with healthcare professionals across India to expand access to therapies that help diagnose and treat cardiac rhythm disorders. This role is part of the downstream marketing function, responsible for developing and executing portfolio strategy, supporting product launches, driving therapy adoption, and enabling commercial success across a diverse healthcare landscape. The position works closely with regional sales teams and cross-functional partners to execute market development initiatives, strengthen customer engagement, and support business growth for the CRM portfolio.
This position can be based in Gurgaon or Mumbai and follows a Flex work model. Travel up to 10% is required to support customer engagement, field collaboration, industry events, and strategic business initiatives across India.
As a Senior Marketing Specialist, you will lead downstream marketing initiatives for the Cardiac Rhythm Management portfolio across India. The role combines strategic planning, commercial execution, market development, and stakeholder engagement to drive portfolio growth. You will collaborate with global and regional teams, translate market insights into actionable strategies, and partner with sales teams to improve customer engagement, therapy adoption, and business performance.
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
Develop and execute portfolio marketing plans, including competitive positioning, pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, budget management, and brand initiatives.
Partner with global marketing teams to adapt regional strategies and implement market-specific growth plans.
Lead product launch activities, including clinical messaging, pricing recommendations, sales enablement, and customer engagement programs.
Manage inventory planning, demand forecasting, and portfolio performance to support business objectives and minimize obsolescence.
Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities, market trends, and customer needs.
Drive market development and patient awareness initiatives through physician engagement, digital campaigns, educational programs, and therapy adoption activities.
Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, healthcare stakeholders, and industry partners to support therapy expansion and portfolio growth.
Collaborate with sales, regulatory, legal, clinical, public relations, and research and development teams to ensure aligned and effective execution of marketing strategies.
Required Qualifications
Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. • 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) and minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 3 years relevant experience.
Experience developing and executing marketing strategies, product launches, and commercial growth initiatives.
Experience in market analysis, forecasting, pricing strategy, and business planning.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing multiple stakeholders.
Experience presenting business insights and recommendations to customers, sales teams, or leadership audiences.
 Preferred Qualifications
Master of Business Administration.
Experience in medical devices, cardiovascular therapies, cardiac rhythm management, or related healthcare markets.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint for business analysis and presentations.
Experience leading physician engagement, therapy awareness, or market development initiatives.
Experience working with global teams and supporting regional portfolio growth strategies.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

About Global Delivery Services:
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity:
As a part of a team, you will act as a Resource Management Hub Deputy Manager who provides consistent, high quality services to key individual stakeholders.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Service Delivery Leadership:
Manage end-to-end resource fulfilment, ensuring alignment with delivery timelines and business priorities.
Oversee billing and finance operations related to resource deployment, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Own headcount planning to support growth and efficiency.
Champion and lead Strategic Experience Management initiatives, aligning resource strategy with long-term business objectives.
Monitor and improve service levels, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Planning & Optimization:
Forecast demand and plan capacity across skill sets.
Maximize bench utilization and redeployment efficiency.
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align hiring plans with pipeline and delivery needs.
Performance Management:
Establish and track KPIs for resource performance, utilization, and productivity.
Conduct regular reviews with delivery leads to assess individual and team performance.
Stakeholder Management:
Act as a strategic partner to delivery, business leaders.
Facilitate governance forums to review resource allocation, pipeline, and performance metrics.
Resolve escalations related to staffing conflicts, skill mismatches, or delivery risks.
Data & Analytics:
Maintain accurate dashboards and reports on resource availability, utilization, and forecasting.
Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making and identify improvement opportunities.
Skills and attributes for success:
Hands on knowledge on End to End Resource management
Be proficient in MS Project/Word/PowerPoint/Excel - working knowledge of MS office
Knowledge in Data Visualisation tools would be an added advantage
Exceptional communication skills - both written and oral
Demonstrate strong organizational skills and structured thinking abilities
Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills
Demonstrate an eye for detail
Be flexible and willing to adjust responsibilities to align with developing business needs
Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Graduate / MBA (HR) with 12-14 years of overall experience with 8+ years of relevant experience in E2E resource management, deployment, forecasting and scheduling concepts.
Exposure of short term and long-term resource planning would be an added advantage.
What we look for:
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help

Job Description
Operating under detailed instructions and review, the purpose of this position is to provide the essential technical knowledge and perform the work listed. This role has the responsibility to promote Fluors competitiveness within the global marketplace by delivering quality services of unmatched value and technical competence. The purpose of this position is to work on drawings of limited to moderate scope to support the Design Area Lead or Lead.
- Prepare intermediate complexity 2D Computer Aided Design (CAD) drawings
- Provide close interface with other discipline functions
- Adhere to industry codes and standards as well as department practices and procedures
- Plan, organize, and carry out assignments as directed
- Other duties as assigned

Diploma/ITI in Structural/Civil Engineering is required.
A combination of education and directly related experience equal to four to eight (4-8) years; some locations may have additional or different qualifications to comply
Modelling of Structural Steel and concrete for pipe racks, process structures, buildings, Industrial shed with & without crane, Foundation, miscellaneous supports, S3D
Modeling of Traffic objects like, handrail, ladders, fireproofing, connection envelopes etc. in SP3D Software.
Steel & Concrete MTO and xml file generation from S3D
Structural drawings (Structural Steel, Concrete, Foundations, Rebar, Paving, etc.) preparation from S3D and in Smart Sketch
Structural Drawing Sketch preparation in AutoCAD and MicroStation.
Able to work in plant coordinates and global coordinates.
Structural Standard Drawings preparation.
Incorporation of comments received from client & other discipline.
Ability to work in a team as well as independently.
Able to export S3D model to Navisworks and review for clashes and other required actions.

Description:
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

Description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring resolution in large-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi-vendor infrastructures.
What you will be doing:
Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
Monitor and support the network health of on-premises and cloud infrastructures.
Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.
What we need to see:
Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem-solving abilities.
Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
Hands-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:
Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

Job Title: Admission Counsellor / Business Development Executive / Senior Learning Consultant EdTech

Job Location: Mumbai / Pune /Chandigarh / Bangalore
Industry: EdTech / Education / Online Learning
Department: Sales, Admissions & Student Counselling
Experience: 1 to 3 Years (Freshers with Excellent Communication Skills are also Welcome)

Job Description

We are looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented professionals to join our growing EdTech team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for counselling prospective students, promoting educational programs, managing leads, and driving admissions and course enrolments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Connect with prospective students through inbound and outbound calls, emails, chats, and online platforms.
- Counsel students regarding online UG/PG programs, management courses, diplomas, certifications, and professional learning programs.
- Understand students' career goals and recommend suitable educational programs.
- Follow up with interested leads and convert enquiries into admissions and enrolments.
- Schedule video counselling sessions, online demos, and program discussions where required.
- Manage the complete sales funnel, from lead engagement to conversion.
- Achieve monthly admission and revenue targets.
- Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and sales reports using CRM tools and Excel.
- Build strong relationships with students and parents while ensuring a positive counselling experience.

Requirements
- Graduate in any discipline.
- Freshers with excellent communication and convincing skills can apply for eligible entry-level roles.
- Experienced candidates with backgrounds in EdTech Sales, B2C Sales, Admission Counselling, Academic Counselling, or Business Development are preferred for experienced positions.
- Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple leads.
- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and dialer operations.
- A customer-focused attitude with a passion for education and career counselling.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary as per experience, skills, and company norms.
- Attractive performance-based incentives.
- Opportunity to work in the growing EdTech and online education sector.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities.

Description:
F&B and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our F&B Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish.
Whether setting tables and event materials communicating with the kitchen, interacting, and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the F&B Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintece needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications.
Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards.
Speak with others using clear and professional language.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Position Title: Area HR Partner- Upper North (Third Party Contractual)

Reports to: Lead HR Retail (North and East)

Note: This role is on one year contract. Based on performance we can convert this role on-rolls, but if not then after one year the contract will terminate after one year

Location: Chandigarh (First two months in Gurgaon office)

Position Summary:
The Retail HR role partners closely with retail operations to support people-related initiatives across stores. The role focuses on driving hiring, employee engagement, capability development, and compliance while building a strong connect with store teams and supporting the overall employee experience in the region

Key Objectives:
Manage the end-to-end employee lifecycle for retail employees including recruitment, onboarding, engagement initiatives, training and development, and exit interviews.
Drive hiring across retail stores by identifying and leveraging both internal and external recruitment sources to ensure timely closure of open positions.
Partner with retail operations stakeholders and store managers to understand manpower requirements and support people-related decisions across stores.
Assess behavioral and capability development needs of store employees and coordinate relevant training programs with internal or external trainers.
Plan and manage the monthly employee engagement calendar across stores to strengthen employee connect and morale.
Coordinate and ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs for retail employees.
Conduct regular store visits to interact with employees, gather feedback, understand on-ground challenges, and support resolution of employee concerns.
Track attrition trends and employee feedback across stores and work with business leaders to drive retention and employee experience initiatives.
Ensure effective implementation of company policies across stores and monitor compliance with statutory requirements, including maintenance of statutory registers and documentation.
Actively participate in various company forums and people initiatives within the organization.

Eligibility Criteria and Functional Competencies Required:
MBA / PGDM students specializing in HR or related fields.
2-4 years of HR experience, preferably in retail, hospitality, or other customer-facing industries.
Prior experience in managing store hiring, employee engagement, and HR operations will be an advantage.
Good communication and coordination skills.

We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV). Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate. Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition.


Qualifications
Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Summary
Provides technical expertise and serves as a primary customer support contact for diagnosing, troubleshooting, and executing complex repairs and maintenance of engine products at customer sites. Applies advanced diagnostic skills, specialized tools, service procedures, and product knowledge to ensure timely and effective resolution of customer issues while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and customer service.
Key Responsibilities
Establishes and maintains productive customer relationships, ensuring prompt, professional, and efficient attention to customer needs.
Diagnoses and completes complex repairs on engine products at customer sites using specialized tools, diagnostic equipment, service publications, and documented procedures.
Performs preventive maintenance activities on engines and related components in accordance with documented schedules, standards, and service requirements.
Troubleshoots mechanical, electrical, electronic, fuel, cooling, exhaust, aftertreatment, driveline, controls, and sensor-related systems to identify root causes and resolve product issues.
Uses electronic service tools, software, and diagnostic equipment to interpret fault information, identify failed components, and determine appropriate repair actions.
Validates completed repairs by confirming that the original customer concern has been resolved and the product is operating as expected.
Escalates unresolved or complex technical issues to product specialists, technical experts, or supervisors, providing complete troubleshooting details and relevant technical information.
Provides technical guidance, coaching, and knowledge transfer to technicians and apprentices; may provide work direction and review repair plans, parts lists, and related technical requirements.
Completes accurate service documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents, customer/equipment information, and technical records through applicable systems or forms.
Identifies additional service and sales opportunities based on customer requirements and product/service needs.
Completes required technical and functional training in line with business and skill requirements and actively develops technical capabilities.
Maintains service vehicles, tools, equipment, and work areas in a clean, safe, and operational condition.
Ensures compliance with all applicable Health, Safety Environmental policies, procedures, standards, and legislation.
Reports safety concerns, incidents, and other HSE issues to site management and the appropriate supervisor.
Supports continuous improvement by sharing technical knowledge, field insights, and opportunities to improve service processes and customer experience.
Key Responsibilities:
Service Delivery Monitoring :
Oversee Service Delivery Process (SDP) at dealerships, conduct audits, identify gaps, and drive improvements for a robust process.
Daily review and closure of critical breakdown and running-with-problem events by coordinating with customers, dealerships, and process owners.
Customer and Dealer Relationship Management :
Build strong relationships with key customers, proactively conduct customer visits, and address their concerns effectively.
Conduct monthly/quarterly meetings with OEMs/GOEMs and document actions for closure.
Performance Management :
Monitor Net Promoter Score (NPS) at dealerships, analyze detractors/passives, and implement improvements.
Review service KPIs, initiatives like SQM, Service Touch, Warranty, CEIT, and customer escalations with stakeholders.
Process Improvement :
Ensure compliance with NEPI BCD requirements and facilitate dealership visits for alignment.
Conduct dealer score audits, share improvement recommendations, and work towards target achievement.
Enhance Preventive Maintenance Compliance of Alternators / NGPI Compliance
Technical Support and Knowledge Sharing :
Investigate product/system problems, identify causes, recommend solutions, and document findings.
Share knowledge via Knowledge Management Systems (KMS), QSOL tickets, and training sessions.
Provide onsite technical expertise as needed and assist in field action campaigns and VPI programs.
Implement proactive and efficient SRN review and monitoring process to minimize downtime of electrical and controls components.
Training and Capability Building :
Identify skill gaps in dealership engineers and collaborate with HODs to enhance technical team capabilities.
Product Quality and Feedback :
Report product quality issues and unusual observations to relevant teams for resolution.
Audit and Compliance :
Conduct FSR/FSPR audits to ensure quality and hygiene, focusing on global failed codes.
Qualifications and Competencies
Competencies:
Field Investigation and Support : Gathers and communicates technical information, both internally and externally, between technical problem solvers and the service channel about product or process-related issues using proven problem-solving techniques.
Product Failure Reporting and Corrective/Preventive Action Systems : Defines and leads a process to record, prioritize, and resolve product failures using cross-functional reviews, rigorous problem-solving methods, failed parts transfer processes, data management tools, and project management practices.
Product Problem Solving : Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.
Technical Customer Management : Represents Cummins to customers by being the interface for all technical aspects; provides engineering data, documentation, and training to customers to support the design and integration of equipment.
Being Resilient : Rebounding from setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations.
Collaborates : Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
Communicates Effectively : Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
Customer Focus : Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
Drives Results : Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
Manages Complexity : Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
Resourcefulness : Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
Diagnostics Application : Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plans; troubleshoots issues following guided workflows, procedures, specialized equipment, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components.
Service Documentation : Creates and verifies customer, equipment, and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system.
Technical Escalation : Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database.
Values Differences : Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
Qualifications:
College, university, or equivalent degree in Engineering, or related field is highly preferred or relevant experience equivalent required.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
Skills and Experience:
Basic to intermediate level of relevant work experience in technical roles is required.
Prior experience in service delivery, technical support, or field engineering is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve technical problems efficiently.
Strong communication, customer relationship, and project management skills
Key Competencies
Customer Focus: Builds strong customer relationships and delivers timely, customer-centric solutions.
Communicates Effectively: Communicates technical information clearly and adapts communication to different audiences.
Diagnostics Troubleshooting: Translates customer complaints into structured troubleshooting plans and applies appropriate diagnostic methods to identify root causes.
Electronic Service Tool Application: Selects and effectively uses appropriate hardware, software, and electronic service tools to diagnose and resolve product issues.
Engine Systems Knowledge: Understands the interaction of mechanical and electrical engine systems, including fuel, cooling, exhaust, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, and related systems.
Product Repair Maintenance: Performs complex repairs, maintenance, disassembly, assembly, inspection, and component replacement in accordance with service guidelines and quality standards.
Technical Escalation: Recognizes issues requiring higher-level expertise and provides complete technical information to enable timely resolution.
Service Documentation: Accurately records customer, equipment, diagnostic, repair, and technical information in the applicable service management systems.
Manages Complexity: Analyzes complex technical information and applies structured problem-solving to resolve issues effectively.
Develops Talent: Coaches and supports technicians and apprentices by sharing technical knowledge and practical experience.
Manages Conflict: Handles customer or workplace conflicts professionally and works toward effective resolution.
Self-Development: Proactively builds technical and professional capabilities through formal and informal learning.
Health Safety: Demonstrates proactive safety behaviors and contributes to a safe and injury-free workplace.
Values Differences: Respects and leverages diverse perspectives, experiences, and cultures.
Qualifications
Vocational diploma/certification from a relevant technical institution in mechanical, electrical, automotive, diesel, or a related technical discipline.
Apprentice-trained Engine Technician qualification is preferred.
Locally valid driving permit/license.
Relevant technical certifications or licenses as required by local regulations and business requirements.
This position may require applicable licensing or compliance with export control and sanctions regulations.
Skills Experience
Significant experience in field service, engine service, or a related technical service environment.
Strong working knowledge and hands-on experience with engine products and related systems.
Demonstrated experience diagnosing and repairing complex mechanical and electrical/electronic engine issues.
Experience using electronic diagnostic tools, service software, and specialized service equipment.
Ability to interpret technical manuals, service publications, wiring diagrams, diagnostic results, and repair procedures.
Experience performing preventive maintenance and complex repairs in a customer-site environment.
Strong customer service and relationship management skills.
Experience providing technical guidance, coaching, or knowledge transfer to junior technicians or apprentices is preferred.
Ability to work independently at customer sites while effectively collaborating with technical experts, supervisors, and other stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
Commitment to Health, Safety Environmental standards and safe working practices.
Willingness and ability to travel to customer locations as required for field service activities.

Description:
Role Overview:
We are looking for a proactive and solution-oriented Last Mile Servicing (LMS) Associate to
lead the Quick-commerce (and E-Commerce) appointment delivery process. You will ensure
seamless customer/consignee experience by resolving queries efficiently, coordinating with
internal teams, and contributing to continuous process improvements. This is an exciting
opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, tech-driven logistics environment.
What Youll Do:
Serve as the primary point of contact for consignees via calls, emails, and chat.
Resolve shipment-related queries, including tracking, delays, lost or damaged
packages.
Conduct RCA for delivery failures along with subsequent actionables.
Collaborate with operations, warehouse, and logistics teams to provide timely
solutions.
Maintain accurate records of customer/consignee interactions and feedback.
Identify recurring issues and work with internal teams to improve processes.
Sending out daily/weekly reports highlighting trends and insights.
Uphold a high standard of professionalism and empathy in all customer/consignee
interactions.
Who You Are:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with prior experience in logistics, e-commerce
operations, or customer service.
Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; regional language skills are a plus
Tech-savvy, adept at MS Excel and CRM tools.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to multitask in a dynamic environment.
Customer-focused, patient, and resilient under pressure
AboutCompany: Delhivery Limited is India's largest and fastest-growing fully-integrated logistics services player by revenue as of Fiscal 2021. Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 23,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands. Description:
Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity: Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to conduct research and interpret information from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong learning mindset, professional attitude, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.


Qualifications
"Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline."


Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity : Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh


GOV
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.


SaT
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.


SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.


Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.


Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a dynamic and target-driven Senior Manager SME Inside Sales to lead a large sales organization and drive revenue growth, customer retention, and account expansion. The role involves managing 2 Assistant Managers and 50–60 associates, building a high-performance culture, and delivering business targets through data-driven sales strategies and effective people leadership.

Key Responsibilities
* Own revenue, growth, retention, and productivity targets for the function.
* Lead and mentor 2 Assistant Managers and drive performance across 50–60 associates.
* Drive account growth through upselling, cross-selling, share-of-wallet gains, and increased order frequency.
* Improve customer retention, reduce churn, and strengthen long-term account relationships.
* Monitor sales funnel performance, conversion rates, revenue per associate, and key business KPIs.
* Drive forecasting, business reviews, performance management, and continuous process improvement.
* Collaborate with Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams to enhance customer experience and business outcomes.
* Leverage customer insights and analytics to identify growth opportunities and improve platform stickiness.
Requirements
* 7+ years of experience in Inside Sales, Key Account Management, Account Management, or Customer Retention.
* Proven experience managing large sales teams and delivering revenue and growth targets.
* Strong expertise in sales funnel management, customer retention, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Excellent leadership, analytical, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.

Description:
ABOUT SAPCON STEELS PRIVATE LIMITED
At Sapcon, we don't just trade steel - we power the backbone of India's industrial growth. As one of the country's leading names in steel and industrial commodities, we've built our reputation on a simple promise: the right material, to the right customer, at the right time, every time.
With 35+ strategically located supply hubs across India and trusted partnerships with industry titans like JSPL, AMNS, SAIL and JSW, we sit at the intersection of scale and agility. From automotive plants and shipyards to solar farms, HVAC manufacturers, and the infrastructure shaping India's skylines, our steel moves industries forward.
Join us, and your work will directly fuel the projects transforming a nation.
Key responsibilities
Administer and configure the CRM: users, roles, permissions, profiles, fields, page layouts, and picklists
Build and maintain automations, including workflows, approval processes, assignment rules, and email templates
Own data quality: run regular de-duplication, imports and exports, validation rules, and data cleanup
Create and maintain reports and dashboards for sales pipeline, lead conversion, forecasting, and team performance
Reconcile CRM data with ERP and finance systems (orders, invoices, collections)
Research and build targeted lead lists by industry, region, company size, and product fit
Enrich leads with company data such as turnover, capacity, products, GST/registration details, and location
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field
2–4 years of hands-on experience administering a CRM such as Salesforce, Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Frappe CRM
Strong grasp of sales processes: lead to order cycle
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 especially Excel, including lookups, pivots, and data cleaning
Experience building reports and dashboards
Nice to have
CRM certification (e.g. Salesforce Certified Administrator, Zoho CRM Certified)
Basic knowledge of AI, SQL, APIs, or low-code automation tools (Zapier, Power Automate)
Detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable managing multiple requests

Job Title

Executive

Position Reports To

Store Manager
Job Location- Chandigarh Delhi

Retail Store

Brief Summary
The Executive at ORRA Fine Jewellery is responsible for providing exceptional customer service, driving sales conversion, and building long-term customer relationships. They inform customers about new designs, schemes, and offers, support local area activities, and assist with the try-at-home scheme. The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in retail sales.

Brief Job Description (just an indicative list and not limited to the following)
1. Attend to customer requirements with a focus on driving sales conversion and delivering excellent customer experiences.
2. Inform customers about new designs, schemes, and offers to promote sales and customer engagement.
3. Support local area activities in collaboration with the Relationship Executive.
4. Assist with the try-at-home scheme based on instructions from the Store Manager.
5. Follow up with potential customers and visit them to close sales.
6. Develop and maintain strong customer relationships.
Desired Skills
1. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in retail sales.
2. Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
3. Proven track record of meeting sales targets.
4. Detail-oriented and organized.
5. Ability to work well in a team.
6. Flexible availability, including weekends and holidays.

Description:
Group Company: AU Small Finance Bank Limited
Designation: Relationship Officer Two Wheeler
Office Location:
Position description: Primary interface of the bank with the customer as well as the channels for business sourcing
Primary Responsibilities:
1. Achieve assigned targets and productivity requirements - meet the threshold targets on monthly basis 2. Generate potential business leads from sourcing channels, follow up and bring it to closure 3. Assess customer profile, visit customer's place, collect necessary documentation and recommend customers to credit for approval 4. Ensure physical delivery of vehicle from the dealer/channel partner - stay vigilant about asset jumping/over pricing etc. 5. Follow up and collect deferrals and post disbursement documents in a timely manner. 6. Ensure only Direct sourcing from authorised dealers and empanelled channels - no third party sourcing, includes employees of other banks and financial institutions. 7. Manage relationship with dealers, Commercial Associates, referrals and other sourcing channels to generate business volumes through these channels. 8. Ensure Asset verification and Non starter-Early default cases and build relationships9. Ensure timely servicing of customer service requests
