Description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development. The role requires a candidate with practical knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic products market and experience in handling channel sales.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers.
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products.
Candidates with experience as Medical Representatives (MRs) may be considered only if their experience includes retail, distributor, dealer, stockist, or channel sales.
Experience in dealer/distributor handling and market development is mandatory.
Experience in local store/pharmacy visits and product promotion will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with B.Pharm / D.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / equivalent qualifications may be preferred, depending on relevant sales experience.
Key Skills
Pharma Sales Business Development
Dealer Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand Product Promotion
Channel Sales Market Development
Sales Target Achievement
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets.
Budget: Maximum 30,000 net per month, depending on experience and suitability.

Description:
A. About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Commercial) to support the execution of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting the Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited in supporting in day to day commercial activities such as monitoring the billing, collections, identification of energy and revenue leakages etc.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on Commercial function. Key responsibilities include:

Business Process Re-engineering
Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.
Prepare a Standard Operating Procedure for reporting of the key parameters along with responsibility matrix.
Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Management Review
Prepare presentation at sub-division level for the review meeting by management highlighting the key parameters along with the diagnostic analysis and suggestions for improvement.
Coordinate with the sub-divisions level officers for the Action Taken Report after each review meeting.

C. Required skill set:
Strong technical and commercial knowledge about the power distribution business.
Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Experience in handling smart meter data
Working knowledge of key regulatory interventions effecting the commercial parameters of DISCOM.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
BE/ B. Tech/ MBA/ M. Tech (Candidates with B. Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of advanced MS Excel and Microsoft Power point is highly preferred.
Atleast 5 Years experience in Commercial Matters of DISCOM or consultancy company.

E. Location:
Shillong, Meghalaya.
The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.
AboutCompany:
Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Since the beginning of its operations in India in 2008, Mercados has been supporting clients across the energy sector value chain. We strive to promote efficient and sustainable energy markets; design effective regulations and assist energy businesses to succeed. Our approach integrates innovative, state-of-the-art techniques with practical, tailor-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurugram, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Lucknow and various Project offices across India.
Mercados has a dedicated team of over 185+ (and counting) professionals and has successfully completed 800+ assignments for its esteemed clients. Mercados operates under two broad verticals, namely Management Consulting and ‘Enterprise SaaS’. While the Management Consulting Vertical provides leading edge Advisory solutions to generation companies with over 42 GWs of conventional and renewable energy-based capacities, distribution companies with over 54 million consumers and large industrial consumers: the Enterprise SaaS Vertical aims at offering tailor-made digital solutions, power portfolio management, generation planning and algorithmic trading solutions – “jouleOS” - to Utilities in India.
Our Consulting portfolio envelopes diverse segments like ‘Strategy and Business Growth’, ‘Policy, Economic Analysis and Regulations’, ‘Planning, Energy Markets & Simulation Models’, ‘Transaction Advisory Services’, ‘Integrated Energy Supply Services’ and ‘Performance Improvement (Utility Management Services)’.

The role involves supporting procurement and tendering activities for utility projects, ensuring compliance with procurement procedures, facilitating bid management, vendor coordination, contract finalization, and monitoring procurement-related project deliverables.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on procurement and tendering functions. Key responsibilities include:

Procurement & Tendering Support
• Provide day-to-day support to MeECL and its subsidiaries on procurement and tendering activities.
• Review the existing Operating Procedure of MeECL for bidding of services and goods.
• Prepare Request for Proposals (RFPs) for procurement of materials and services as per client requirements and in line with the State and Central Procurement Guidelines.
• Coordinate with the State E Procurement management team.
• Advise the client from time to time on updation of the procurement process and digital intervention in the procurement.

Vendor Identification & Bid Management
• Identify and facilitate the selection of suitable vendors in line with MeECL procurement processes.
• Support release of RFPs and tender documents.
• Coordinate pre-bid meetings and manage clarifications with prospective bidders.
• Facilitate all procurement activities through to contract award.

Bid Evaluation
• Review all the technical and commercial bids.
• Find out the deviations in the submitted bids from the conditions in the RfP.
• Prepare comparative statements, bid evaluation reports, and recommendations for tender finalization.
• Support evaluation committees during the bid assessment process.

MIS & Reporting
• Prepare, review, and validate MIS reports, dashboards, progress reports, and periodic submissions.
• Prepare a database for the bids with details of technical requirement, deviations allowed, revisions in the tenders done if any etc.
• Maintain procurement documentation and ensure timely reporting to the Client.
• Ensure quality and accuracy of reports, presentations, and Minutes of Meetings (MoMs).

Stakeholder Coordination
• Coordinate with officials MeECL, contractors, vendors, and internal consulting teams.
• Monitor procurement milestones and facilitate timely resolution of issues.

Additional Responsibilities
• Prepare a Standard Operating Procedures with timelines for each type of procurement and ensure compliance of the approved procedure.
• Support any other procurement and tendering activities assigned by the Client.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives and procurement best practices within the project.

C. Required skill set:
• Strong understanding of procurement and tendering processes in the Power Sector including, distribution, generation and transmission.
• Experience in preparation of RFPs, bid evaluation, vendor selection, and contract award processes.
• Knowledge of public procurement procedures and utility procurement practices.
• Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
• Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
• Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
• BE/ B. Tech or MBA (Candidates with B.Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
• Atleast 5 Years experience in Procurement, Tendering & Contracts Management in a Power Utility / Discom company or Power utility consultancy company.

E. Location:
• Shillong, Meghalaya.
• The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
• We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.

Description:
Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.

Description:
Job description of this profile as follows:
Credit Manager will be responsible for evaluating, underwriting, and managing the credit risk associated with vehicle loans (including new/used CV loans, two-wheelers, 3-Wheelers, Electric vehicles). This role focuses on assessing creditworthiness, ensuring zero fraud, streamlining loan turn-around-time (TAT), maintaining a healthy portfolio quality, and achieving a sustainable balance between business growth and risk mitigation.

Core Responsibilities:
1. Credit Underwriting & Risk Assessment:
Evaluate loan applications for wheels products based on internal credit policies, financial statements, bank statements, Bureau records (e.g., CIBIL), and field verification reports.
Identify potential red flags, financial stress, or fraudulent documentation early in the underwriting lifecycle.
Assess the buyer's repayment capacity, cash flows (especially for self-employed individuals and commercial operators), and the valuation/LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio of the vehicle being financed.

2. Portfolio Quality & Monitoring:
Track early mortality accounts and manage the non-performing asset (NPA) percentages within the assigned geography or product category.
Monitor monthly bounce rates, overdue accounts, and collection trends to proactively alter credit guidelines if specific segments show high risk.
Conduct periodic portfolio reviews and sample audits of disbursed cases to ensure absolute policy compliance.

3. TAT Management:
Ensuring quick Turn-Around-Time (TAT) from application login to final credit sanction without compromising risk standards.

Key Candidate Requirements:
Candidates should have 4-5 years' experience in credit underwriting of Wheels product.
Relevant experience in credit underwriting within an NBFC or bank.
Good understanding of bureau reports, income assessment, banking analysis, credit policies, and lending processes.
Ability to independently evaluate credit proposals and recommend appropriate credit decisions within delegated authority.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound credit judgment.

bout the Role
Are you a strategic recruiter who thrives in high-volume, dynamic environments? We are looking for a Recruitment Lead to drive end-to-end frontline manpower hiring across west region. In this role, you will lead high-impact hiring initiatives, optimize sourcing channels, build grassroots partnerships, and ensure a seamless pipeline from candidate selection to onboarding and training.
If you excel at execution, community outreach, and balancing quality with speed, we want to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities
Direct Recruitment Planning (20%)
Review rolling 3-month hiring targets (location, quantity, skill requirements) and develop actionable recruitment plans.
Optimize sourcing channels, combining walk-ins, mass drives, digital recruitment, and specialized outreach programs (e.g., homecoming drives).
Identify resource requirements for hiring events and gain alignment/sign-off with leadership.
Recruitment Process Execution & Monitoring (80%)
Mobilize recruitment teams and lead execution of scheduled hiring drives and events.
Ensure full compliance with internal company policies, statutory regulations, and labor laws governing recruitment.
Issue Letters of Intent (LOI) to selected candidates and actively follow up to ensure seamless transition to training centers with required documentation.
Coordinate directly with training schools on candidate rosters and arrival schedules.
Track hiring event effectiveness, course-correct plans as needed, and maintain accurate recruitment MIS and reporting.
Stakeholders & Relationships
Internal: Hub & Branch Operations Teams, ISM Officers, Recruitment Lead.
External: Prospective candidates, Government/State agencies, Gram Panchayats, local community authorities, and NGOs.
What We Are Looking For
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Graduate degree or equivalent (minimum required).
Experience: 5-7 years of relevant HR experience with a strong background in managing volume recruitment processes.

Description:
Job Summary
As an App Marketing Specialist, you will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and optimizing mobile app marketing campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram). You will work closely with the design, development, and product teams to increase app installs, improve user acquisition, and maximize return on advertising spend (ROAS).
Key Responsibilities
Paid Advertising Display, Video, and Performance Max.
CPI, CPA, and ROAS.
User Acquisition & Growth Analytics & Performance Tracking Manager, Firebase, Google Analytics, and other attribution tools.
Retention Rate.
Creative Collaboration creatives.
Market Research practices.
Requirements
Good understanding of Google Ads and Meta Ads platforms.
Knowledge of mobile app marketing and user acquisition strategies.
Experience with Google App Campaigns is preferred.
Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads Manager, and Google Analytics.
Basic understanding of Firebase Analytics and app attribution tools is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to interpret campaign data and optimize performance.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for campaign reporting.
Google Ads and Meta Blueprint Certifications are an added advantage.
Freshers with hands-on experience through internships, certifications, or personal projects are encouraged to apply.
Experience promoting Android or iOS mobile applications is preferred.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field (preferred).

About the Role
Secure Meters Limited is looking for a skilled and dedicated Plumber to support the maintenance and smooth operation of the Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) and Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) at our Sanand facility. Monitor and maintain pumps, valves, fittings, and associated equipment.
Support ETP/STP operational teams during maintenance activities.
Ensure proper functioning of water distribution and wastewater systems.
Maintain records of maintenance activities and report abnormalities.
Adhere to all safety, environmental, and company guidelines.
Assist in plant utility maintenance as required.

Qualifications
ITI in Plumbing or equivalent technical qualification preferred.
Basic knowledge of ETP/STP systems and utility maintenance.
Ability to use plumbing tools and maintenance equipment safely.

Experience
1 to 3 years of experience in plumbing maintenance, preferably in industrial plants, ETPs, STPs, or utility operations.

Skills Required
Plumbing installation and maintenance
Pipe fitting and repair
Knowledge of pumps, valves, and water treatment systems
Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Basic understanding of safety practices in industrial environments

Preferred Candidate Profile
Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments.
Willingness to work in shifts if required.
Team player with a proactive approach toward maintenance activities.

Job Description & Candidate Preparation Guide
Career Development Ocer (CDO)
1. About Jaro Education
Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive
and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self-
funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership
Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress.
Jaro Education bridges the gap between top-tier global academic institutions and ambitious
professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C-
Suite roles through strategic aliations with globally renowned universities and business schools,
including:
IIMs: IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli,
IIM Visakhapatnam
IITs and IIT-linked institutions: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, IIT Palakkad, IIT Roorkee,
E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati, IITM Pravartak IIT Madras
Technology Innovation Hub
Other premier Indian institutions: IISc, XLRI, IMT Ghaziabad, Loyola Institute of Business
Administration (LIBA), IFEEL Institute for Future Education, Entrepreneurship and Leadership,
MIT Institute of Design / MIT IDSS, Niranjan Hiranandani School of Real Estate & HSNC University
Indian Universities and Higher Education Partners: Adani Institute of Digital Technology
Management, Amity University, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bharati Vidyapeeth / BVDU,
Chandigarh University, Dayananda Sagar University (Bengaluru), Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth
Centre for Online Learning (DPU-COL, Pune), Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, JAIN
Online, MAHE Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Manipal University
Jaipur, Parul University, Sikkim Manipal University, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) /
SSODL
Global Academic and Executive Education Partners: Deakin University (Australia) & KPMG
in India, Harvard Business Impact, Imperial College Business School Executive Education, Rotman
School of Management (University of Toronto) & IITM Pravartak, Wharton Interactive
Company Vision: To be globally recognized for providing a seamless learning platform for professionals
around the world.
Page 1 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every
student and professional at all stages of their career.
2. Role Overview & Snapshot
The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving
business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them
on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead
generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.
Designation
Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist
Admissions & Executive Education Sales
Department
Target Audience
Working Days
Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers
Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O)
10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Note: Shift may stretch basis business
requirements)
Working Hours
Dress Code
Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals
Primary CRM Tool
LeadSquared
3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations
High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting
¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM
database to build a healthy sales pipeline.
¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport
with high-potential prospects.
Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis
¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career
aspirations.
¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or
certications from Jaros university partners.
¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum
highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes.
Page 2 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment
¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection
handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures.
¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion
rates.
¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue
metrics.
Operations & Data Management
¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment
stages in LeadSquared.
¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a
seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners.
¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor
oerings.
4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites
¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional
communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred.
¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation
capabilities.
¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort
working in target-driven environments.
¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to-
senior working professionals.
¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like
LeadSquared.
5. Career Growth Pathway
¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader,
Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements.
Page 3 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Interview Preparation Kit
Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with
Jaro Education.
A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules
1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate
professionalism.
2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone,
and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings.
3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes
or o-topic details.
4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout
the conversation.
5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when
discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues.
B. Fundamental Concepts to Master
1. What is EdTech?
Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and
hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and
eectiveness.
Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing
working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.
2. What is Consultative Selling?
Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather
than aggressively pushing a product.
Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a
professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic
executive program that aligns with their career growth.
Page 4 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies
Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual
candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example
types to aid your preparation.
¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements."
Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and
everyday responsibilities.
¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?"
Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and
the impact of upskilling working professionals.
¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?"
Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the
prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and
discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support).
¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?"
Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure,
career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry).
¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?"
Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively
(certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities).
D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview
Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and
mission.

Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive,
Harvard Business Impact).

Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech.

Dressed in crisp business formal attire.

All the best for your interview!

extensive field travel.

institution.

Project Role: Assoc Lab Project Svcs Mgr

Work Experience: xp- 5+ yrs , Clinical project management+ client/sponsor direct handling exp, life science background.

Preferred candidate profile
Under general direction, manage all laboratory aspects of assigned clinical trial projects for a Customer or a specific program for a Customer. May have responsibility for a specific Customer, drug program, indication or drug compound. Acts as the main point of contact for the Customer after study award and throughout the entire study lifecycle (startup, maintenance, closeout). Ensures work is conducted in line with standard operating procedures, policies and good practices.
Essential Functions
Study Setup and Planning:
Facilitate seamless study set-up including Protocol and Budget review, leading meetings, develop and implement project plans, milestone, risk, issue and action logs. Partner with Study Setup team to ensure quality database set-up, oversee preparation of protocol specific documentation. Will prepare and present protocol-specific materials at Kick Off and Investigator meetings
May participate in the proposal and business development process including bid defence meetings. Support development of Customer standards
Study Activity Monitoring and Closeout:
Will monitor the Project Management Plan, timelines and deliverables, manage study documentation throughout the Project lifecycle including filing into eTMF, oversee study monitoring and reporting, conduct meetings to meet needs of the Study and Customer requirements
Will manage study scope changes and budget monitor quality of the study and any service-related issues, implementing changes as required. Lessons learnt will be reviewed and shared
Proactive Lines of Communication:
Build and own the Customer relationship, facilitate communication, collaborate with all operational areas within the company
Will serve as an escalation point for study level issues and will coordinate and triage study-specific issues
Coordinates customer survey follow up and ongoing health checks to support Customer relationship building
Meetings, Initiatives and Training Activities:
Will represent the company at Investigator meetings and other internal / external face to face meetings. Will participate in audits and inspections as required
Will provide study training to sites, CRAs and customers
Will establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage on-going project expectations and issues. Will participate in improvement projects as needed
Will assist in training of less experienced staff.
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree Life Sciences and/or related field preferred Req
2-3 years of experience in clinical trials/ hospital-funded research, project management or laboratory environment preferred. . Equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Strong interpersonal and customer management skills.
Working understanding of medical and clinical research terminology.
Working knowledge of Project Management processes, the company laboratory processes, and/or equivalent working knowledge of central laboratory operations (kits/supplies, logistics, laboratory operations, specimen storage, data reporting and transfers, site alerts, etc.) preferred.
Demonstrated computer proficiency with Microsoft Office and the company systems, or equivalent experience with similar Centralized Laboratory systems preferred.
Experience in successfully leading Phase I-IV clinical trials preferred.
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment while possessing strong organizational skills and a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language. In certain geographies where communication in local language is desired (e.g. Japan, China), excellent command of local language with reasonable proficiency in English preferred.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and customers.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced and leadership-driven Team Leader to manage a high-performing field sales team in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 5+ years of experience in CV financing, with at least 3-4 years in a supervisory or team-handling role. This position is responsible for driving the team to achieve collective sales targets for used CVs and all new CV products introduced by the company.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
Drive Team Targets: Manage, mentor, and motivate a team of field executives to consistently achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual disbursement targets for Used CV and auxiliary products.
Market Expansion: Identify new market clusters, dealer networks, and broker hubs to expand the companys footprint in the assigned territory.
On-the-Field Joint Calls: Accompany field staff on high-ticket client meetings, complex dealer negotiations, and critical field visits to close deals.
Portfolio Risk Management: Monitor the team's portfolio health, ensure high-quality sourcing, and maintain a low Non-Performing Asset (NPA) / Delinquency rate through rigorous field checks.
Process Compliance: Ensure the team strictly adheres to company credit policies, document verification guidelines, and KYC compliance norms from login to disbursement.
Performance Reviews: Conduct daily/weekly review meetings, track individual executive productivity, and provide continuous on-the-job training.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: Minimum 5 to 8 years of experience in Commercial Vehicle Finance, with a strong preference for used CV market experience. At least 1–2 years of experience managing a field sales team is mandatory.
Education: Graduate / Post-Graduate in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
Leadership Skills: Proven ability to manage, train, and retain a field-oriented sales force.
Analytical Skills: Strong understanding of local asset valuations, credit risk profiles, and market dynamics.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal vehicle for regular field monitoring and dealer visits.
What We Offer
Competitive fixed CTC with team-performance linked incentives / overrides.
Comprehensive travel allowances.
Opportunities to transition into regional management roles.
Senior Associate :
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities &KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications &Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.
What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

Description:
Wockhardt Hospitals Limited is looking for Critical Care Medicine to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

Patient Assessment : Perform comprehensive assessments of critically ill patients to determine medical conditions and treatment needs. Treatment Planning : Develop and implement individualized treatment plans for patients in the intensive care unit, addressing their specific medical needs. Ventilator Management : Manage and oversee mechanical ventilation for patients requiring respiratory support. Monitoring : Utilize advanced monitoring equipment to assess patients' vital signs and respond promptly to changes in their condition. Diagnostic Procedures : Perform and interpret diagnostic procedures, such as chest X-rays, echocardiograms, and laboratory tests. Collaboration : Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals, including surgeons, nurses, and respiratory therapists, to optimize patient care. Family Communication : Communicate effectively with patients' families, providing updates on the patient's condition, treatment plan, and prognosis. Emergency Response : Respond to medical emergencies within the hospital, particularly in critical care areas. Documentation : Maintain accurate and up-to-date medical records, documenting patient assessments, interventions, and outcomes.

Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we dont just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it s your career and It s yours to build which means potential here is limitless and well provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity
The opportunity: Executive-CHS-Assurance-ASU - Audit - Audit Services - Ahmedabad
CHS
CHS consists of Consumer Products and Healthcare sectors.
Consumer products largely entail, Retail and Agri business. Companies in this sector meet the demands of consumers all around the world, every day; providing everything from agricultural crops to food, clothes, durables and retail experiences. We help clients to capture new sources of profitable growth, rethinking how and where they bring value to consumers, today and into the future. Incumbents need to shift their focus from protecting what they have to creating what they need to become.
The Health Sciences Wellness architecture brings together a worldwide network of professionals to build data-centric approaches to customer engagement and improved outcomes. To retain relevancy in today s digitally focused, data-infused ecosystem, all participants in the sector must rethink their business practices, including capital strategy, partnering and the creation of patient-centric operating models.
ASU - Audit - Audit Services
Assurance s purpose is to inspire confidence and trust to enable a complex world to work. We do so by protecting and serving the public interest, promoting transparency, supporting investor confidence and economic growth and nurturing talent to provide future business leaders. We help clients by :
Ensuring their accounts comply with the requisite audit standards
Providing a robust and clear perspective to audit committees and
Providing critical information for stakeholders.
Our Service Offerings include External Audit, Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) , IFRS US GAAP conversion , IPO and other public offering, Corporate Treasury - IFaccounting implementation support etc.
Your key responsibilities
Demonstrated proficiency in audit accounting principles for planning and executing assurance engagements. Hands-on ability to perform audit procedures such as vouching, reconciliations, and verification of financial statement balances. Working knowledge of auditing standards and methodologies for evaluating internal controls and identifying misstatements. Skilled in preparing accurate audit working papers and supporting documentation that meet engagement quality requirements. Applies structured consulting approaches to execute assurance tasks efficiently and within defined timelines.
To qualify for the role you must have
Chartered Accountants
Experience
Accountant and Auditing (1+Years)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to manage end-to-end recruitment and onboarding activities for our Electrical Electronics Manufacturing organization. The role involves identifying, attracting, assessing, hiring, and onboarding talent across manufacturing, engineering, sales, and corporate functions while ensuring an excellent candidate experience and timely fulfillment of manpower requirements.
Job Details
Designation: Talent Acquisition Specialist
Industry: Electrical Electronics Manufacturing
Experience: 0-2 Years
Location: Surat
Employment Type: Full-Time
Responsibilities
Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from manpower requisition to onboarding.
Coordinate with hiring managers and department heads to understand staffing requirements.
Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media platforms, recruitment agencies, and professional networks.
Conduct headhunting and talent mapping for niche, critical, and hard-to-fill positions.
Perform field hiring and local recruitment drives for shop floor, production, technician, service, and operational roles.
Visit training institutes, colleges, industrial areas, and job fairs for talent acquisition initiatives.
Screen resumes and conduct preliminary interviews to assess candidate suitability.
Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers and technical panels.
Manage offer discussions, salary negotiations, and offer rollouts.
Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs.
Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
Generate recruitment MIS reports and maintain recruitment databases and trackers.
Support employer branding, campus hiring, and recruitment campaigns.
Onboarding / Joining Formalities
Manage end-to-end onboarding activities for all new employees.
Coordinate document collection, background verification, and pre-joining formalities.
Prepare and issue offer letters, appointment letters, and onboarding documentation.
Conduct new employee induction and orientation programs.
Coordinate with IT, Administration, Payroll, and department heads for seamless onboarding.
Ensure timely employee master creation and HRMS updates.
Facilitate a smooth transition from candidate to employee.
Address new joiners queries and provide onboarding support.
Qualifications
Bachelors Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
0-2 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or HR.
Freshers with relevant internship experience may also apply.
Skills Required
Strong sourcing and headhunting capabilities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Good negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
Strong coordination and follow-up abilities.
Knowledge of recruitment portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, etc.
Proficiency in MS Office and HRMS systems.
Ability to manage multiple positions simultaneously.
Willingness to travel for field hiring, recruitment drives, and campus hiring activities.
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Time-to-Fill Positions
Recruitment Closure Rate
Offer Acceptance Ratio
Joining Ratio
Quality of Hire
Candidate Experience Score
New Hire Retention
Field Hiring
Campus Hiring Effectiveness

Description:
Job Title: App Research Development Executive
Responsibilities
Identify new Android and iOS app ideas based on market demand, industry trends, and competitive opportunities.
Research growing and underserved app categories, including AI applications, photo and video editing, productivity, utilities, document management, finance, lifestyle, and other relevant categories.
Identify opportunities to create new applications or enter existing categories with differentiated products.
Analyze whether an app idea has sufficient demand and a realistic opportunity to compete.
Identify market gaps, underserved niches, and opportunities to improve upon existing applications.
Maintain a pipeline of researched app ideas, ranked by opportunity, market demand, competition, and business relevance.
Explain why each app should be considered for development and what makes the opportunity attractive.
Estimate TAM, SAM, SOM for potential app ideas; analyze category size, download volumes, estimated active users, market growth, and revenue trends where reliable data is available.
Research current market demand and identify categories with increasing or declining popularity.
Estimate the potential audience for each application and assess the opportunity to capture a realistic share of the market.
Identify major markets and countries where each app category has significant demand.
Compare global market opportunities with country-specific opportunities.
Research industry reports, app market intelligence platforms, app stores, and other reliable sources.
Document sources, estimation methods, assumptions, and data limitations in every report.
Analyze application demand and estimated download volumes by country; identify the top 10-20 countries for each shortlisted app opportunity, where data is available.
Compare country-wise downloads, category rankings, estimated active users, and market growth.
Identify countries where competitors have strong or weak market penetration.
Evaluate whether an application has global potential or is better suited to specific countries or regions.
Prepare country-wise market comparison tables supported by available data.
Distinguish between actual reported figures, third-party estimates, and calculated projections.
Identify and analyze the top 10-20 direct and indirect competitors for each app idea.
Research competitor applications on Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
Analyze estimated downloads, ratings, review counts, release history, update frequency, and category rankings.
Study competitor features, functionality, supported platforms, user limits, and product positioning.
Compare free features, feature restrictions, and differences between competitor offerings where relevant to product planning.
Identify common competitor strengths, weaknesses, missing capabilities, and opportunities for differentiation.
Analyze negative reviews and feature requests to discover areas where existing products may be inadequate.
Prepare detailed competitor comparison matrices and evidence-based recommendations.
Prepare a comprehensive feature list for each shortlisted application; identify features offered by leading competitors and compare them against the proposed product.
Categorize features into essential MVP features, core competitive features, differentiating features, advanced features for future releases, and optional features that may not justify the implementation effort.
Explain the purpose and expected value of every proposed feature.
Prioritize features based on market demand, competitor gaps, user expectations, business relevance, complexity, and development effort.
Recommend which features should be included in the initial product and which should be postponed.
Identify opportunities to simplify the product without compromising its core value.
Prepare feature comparison sheets and phased product roadmaps based on research findings.
Determine how our proposed application can differ from existing competitors.
Identify features or capabilities that are missing, poorly implemented, or difficult to use in competing products.
Analyze whether an opportunity is genuinely differentiated or merely a copy of an established application.
Recommend unique functionality, product positioning.
App Opportunity Report: App concept, target category, core problem addressed, and reasons to consider building it.
Market Size Report: TAM, SAM, SOM, market growth, and supporting sources.
Country-Wise Analysis: Estimated download volumes, category demand, and leading countries where data is available.
Competitor Analysis: Top 10-20 competitors, their features, ratings, estimated downloads, and market positioning.
Feature Comparison Matrix: Competitor features versus proposed application features.
MVP Feature Plan: Essential launch features, differentiating capabilities, and future feature priorities.
Competitive Differentiation Report: Market gaps and reasons our proposed product could stand out.
Feasibility Assessment: Estimated scope, complexity, dependencies, resource requirements, and key risks.
Opportunity Ranking: Comparison of shortlisted ideas based on demand, market size, competition, differentiation.
Final Recommendation: Build, validate further, postpone, or reject, supported by research and clear reasoning.
Product Differentiation / Competitive Positioning
Mandatory Deliverables
Required Skills Qualifications
2-5 years of experience in market research, product research, competitive intelligence, business analysis, or a related field.
Strong understanding of Android and iOS applications and the mobile app marketplace.
Experience researching app categories, competitors, features, download estimates, and market opportunities.
Understanding of TAM, SAM, SOM, market sizing, industry trends, and competitive positioning.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data analysis and reporting.
Ability to prepare structured research reports, competitor comparison matrices, and presentations.
Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills.
Ability to distinguish verified data from estimates, assumptions, and projections.
Excellent written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to explain why an app opportunity is attractive and identify the evidence that supports the recommendation.
Preferred Tools / Platforms
App market intelligence: Sensor Tower, AppMagic, data.ai, Apptopia, Similarweb.
Market research: Google Trends, industry reports, app store research, and relevant public datasets.
Competitor analysis: Google Play Store, Apple App Store, competitor websites, and app review platforms.
Data analysis: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and basic dashboarding tools.
Documentation: Notion, Microsoft PowerPoint, Google Slides, or equivalent reporting tools.
Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate thinks like a product researcher and business strategist. They can identify attractive opportunities, understand the competitive landscape, estimate market potential, and explain which features matter most.
They do not simply collect competitor screenshots or suggest popular apps. They investigate why an opportunity exists, how large it may be, what competitors already offer, where the gaps are, and whether the company has a credible reason to enter the market.

Job Description
Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance

The Associate Agency Development Manager is responsible for driving business growth through the recruitment, development, and management of a team of insurance agents. This role involves identifying potential agents, conducting training sessions, and providing ongoing support to ensure agents meet their sales targets. The successful candidate will be focused on achieving branch sales goals, enhancing agent performance, and maintaining strong relationships with agents to foster a motivated sales environment. Key responsibilities include developing business plans, analyzing market trends, implementing sales strategies, and ensuring compliance with regulatory guidelines.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and onboard new agents to build a robust sales team.
- Design and implement training programs to enhance agents sales skills and product knowledge.
- Set performance targets for the team and monitor progress, providing feedback and support as needed.
- Foster growth and maintain motivation among agents through consistent communication and mentorship.
- Analyze sales data and market trends to develop effective sales strategies.
- Collaborate with management to align team goals with organizational objectives.
- Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements in the insurance sector.
- Organize performance assessments and identify areas for improvement for agents.

Skills Required:
- Strong leadership and team-building skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to analyze data and market trends effectively.
- Proficient in sales strategies and customer relationship management.
- Strong problem-solving abilities and decision-making skills.
- Proven track record in sales and business development in the insurance sector.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software (e.g., Salesforce, Zoho CRM).
- Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Data analysis tools for sales tracking and performance monitoring.
- Online training platforms for agent development.
- Communication tools (e.g., email, video conferencing software).

A CustomerCare Executive (CCE) at IIFLFinance (Gold Loan division) is responsible for handlingcustomers at the branch, supporting loan processing, and ensuringsmooth service experience .
Insimple terms:
Youare the first point of contact for customers and the support systemfor the branch team.




CoreResponsibilities

1. Customer Handling Service
Welcome and assist walk-in customers
Understand customer requirements (loan, renewal, closure)
Explain:
Gold loan process
Interest rates
Repayment options
Ensure excellent customer experience and quick service




2. Documentation KYC Processing
Collect and verify:
Aadhaar / PAN
Address proof
Photographs
Ensure proper KYC compliance as per RBI norms
Fill and process loan application forms
Maintain accurate customer records




3. Loan Processing Support
Coordinate with:
Gold Appraiser
Branch Manager
Assist in:
Loan entry in system
Documentation completion
Ensure fast turnaround time (TAT) for disbursement




4. Customer Follow-ups Telecalling
Call customers for:
Loan renewals
Interest payments
Overdue reminders
Handle inbound customer queries
Maintain relationship with existing customers




5. Data Entry MIS Management
Enter customer and loan details into company systems
Maintain:
Daily transaction records
Customer database
Generate basic reports for branch operations




6. Cash Handling Support (in some branches)
Assist in:
Cash collection (interest/repayment)
Receipt generation
Ensure proper cash reconciliation at end of day




7. Branch Coordination
Support smooth coordination between:
Customers
Appraisers
Sales staff
Help manage:
Customer queue
Branch workflow




8. Compliance Process Adherence
Follow:
Company policies
RBI guidelines
Ensure error-free documentation
Support audits and verification processes




KeySkills Required

FunctionalSkills
Basic knowledge of:
Banking/NBFC processes
Documentation KYC
Computer skills (MS Excel, data entry systems)


BehavioralSkills
Good communication (Hindi/English + local language)
Customer handling patience
Attention to detail
Multitasking ability




EligibilityCriteria
Graduate (preferred) or 12th pass
03 years of experience in:
Customer service
Banking/NBFC
Retail or telecalling
Freshers are often hired




KPIs(Performance Metrics)
Customer satisfaction levels
Accuracy of documentation
Turnaround time (TAT)
Number of customer interactions handled
Follow-up conversion (renewals, payments)




RealisticNature of the Role
Entry-level role in NBFC structure
Repetitive but fast-paced work
High interaction with customers
Moderate pressure during peak business hours
Important support role but not core decision-making




Day-to-DayWork
Typicalday includes:
Handling walk-in customers
Completing KYC and documentation
Coordinating loan processing
Calling customers for follow-ups
Updating system records




CareerPath
Growthopportunities in **IIFL Finance Gold Loan:
Customer Care Executive
Senior CCE / Operations Executive
Assistant Branch Manager
Branch Manager
Territory Manager

Description:
Functions as the property s strategic ficial business leader.
The position champions, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand s target customer and property employees.
The position provides the ficial expertise to enable the successful implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives while maximizing the return on investment.
In addition, creates and executes a business plan that is aligned with the property and brand s business strategy and focuses on the execution of ficial and accounting activities and the delivery of desirable ficial results.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 4-year bachelors degree in Fice and Accounting or related major; 2 years experience in the fice and accounting or related professional area. OR
- Masters degree in Fice and Accounting or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Engaging in Strategic Planning and Decision Making
- Analyzes ficial data and market trends.
- Analyzes information, forecasts sales against expenses and creates annual budget plans.
- Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.
- Develops means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc
- Analyzes differences between actual budget wages and forecasted wages for more efficient budget planning.
- Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
- Thinks creatively and practically to develop, execute and implement new business plans
- Protects and strengthens our competitive advantage by advocating and supporting sound business and ficial decision making.
- Ensures a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets, improve operations and profitability.
- Implements a system of appropriate controls to manage business risks.
Leading Accounting Teams
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Communicates the strategic goals, the focus and the owner priorities to subordinates in a clear and precise manner.
- Provides excellent leadership by assigning team members and other departments managers clear accountability backed by appropriate authority.
- Holds staff accountable for successful performance.
Developing and Maintaining Fice and Accounting Goals
- Supports property strategy from a fice and accounting perspective
- Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
- Ensures Profits and Losses are documented accurately.
- Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Ensures appropriate corrections are made to audit results if necessary.
- Reviews audit issues to ensure accuracy.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.
- Generates and providing accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc
- Ensures compliance with standard and local operating procedures (SOPs and LSOPs).
- Oversees internal, external and regulatory audit processes.
- Ensures compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
- Ensures that the P&L is accurate (eg, costs are properly matched to revenue, costs are recorded in the proper accounts).
Anticipating and Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders
- Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc).
- Understands the owners perspective and ROI expectations.
- Anticipates and addresses owner needs and involves ownership in key decisions.
- Leverages strong functional leadership and communication skills to influence the executive team, the propertys strategies and to lead own team.
- Advises the GM and executive committee on existing and evolving operating/ficial issues.
- Facilitates critique meetings to review information with management team.
- Attends owners meetings in order to provide context and explanation for ficial results.
- Attends meetings and communicates with the owners, understanding the priorities and strategic focus.
- Demonstrates a commitment to meeting the needs of all key stakeholders.
- Communicates ficial concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand and drives desired behaviors.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Ensures team members are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Ensures new hires participate in the department s orientation program.
- Ensures new hires receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Creates appropriate development plans which develop team members based on their individual strengths, development needs, career aspirations and abilities.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Gurgaon / Chennai / Pune / Noida / Hyderabad
Responsibilities:
Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.

Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, Q&A and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation.
AND/OR
Computer Vision and Audio: Hands-on experience in image classification, object detection, segmentation, image generation, audio, and video analysis.

Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities.
Familiarity with Open-source LLMs, including tools like TensorFlow/Pytorch and huggingface. Techniques such as quantization, LLM finetuning using PEFT, RLHF, data annotation workflow, and GPU utilization.
Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred.
Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, FastAPI/Django/Flask, and Git.

Job Description



Platform Automation Developer - Kubernetes, Python, PowerShell Shell
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Noida / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Platform Automation Developer with strong expertise in Kubernetes, Python, PowerShell, and Shell scripting. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building platform-level automation solutions that enable deployment, configuration, packaging, orchestration, and lifecycle management of applications across Linux, Windows, VM, and containerized environments.


Your Role
As a Platform Automation Developer, you will design and develop automation frameworks, orchestration services, deployment tooling, and platform utilities that improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. You will work closely with DevOps, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Application teams to deliver robust automation solutions.


Key Responsibilities
Develop platform-level automation and orchestration components for deployment, configuration, packaging, and management of application workloads.
Build automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, Bash/Shell, and related technologies.
Automate application installation, configuration, service management, environment setup, and health validation processes.
Develop and maintain container images, Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, and deployment packages.
Create build, release, and packaging automation for Linux and Windows-based applications.
Develop PowerShell automation for Windows workloads and Python/Shell automation for Linux environments.
Integrate automation components with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) frameworks.
Implement logging, monitoring, validation, exception handling, rollback, and retry mechanisms within automation workflows.
Develop APIs, CLI tools, and platform services to support automated provisioning and environment management.
Implement secure handling of credentials, certificates, secrets, and configuration parameters.


Required Skills Experience
6+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Automation Development, DevOps, or Infrastructure Automation.
Strong programming experience in Python.
Hands-on expertise in PowerShell and Bash/Shell scripting.
Strong experience with Kubernetes administration, deployment, and troubleshooting.
Experience creating and maintaining Helm Charts, Kubernetes manifests, and containerized deployments.
Knowledge of Docker containerization and image management.
Experience integrating automation with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code concepts and automation frameworks.
Experience developing APIs, command-line tools, or automation services.


Mandatory Skills
Kubernetes

PowerShell Scripting
Bash/Shell Scripting
Docker
Helm Charts
CI/CD Pipelines
Infrastructure Automation
Linux Administration
Windows Automation

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing robust automated test solutions to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of web and mobile applications.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for web and mobile applications.
Develop and execute automated test scripts using Java, Selenium WebDriver, Appium, and Rest Assured.

Required Skills

5-8 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance and Test Automation.
Strong programming expertise in Java.
Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver for web automation.
Strong experience with Appium for mobile Automation testing (Android/iOS).
Extensive experience in REST API Automation using Rest Assured.
Experience with TestNG/JUnit frameworks.

Experience in defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Strong knowledge of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.
Experience with Git version control.

CI/CD experience using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.
Exposure to Docker and cloud environments.
Experience working with SQL databases and backend validation.
Knowledge of performance testing tools is an added advantage.
Exposure to Banking or Financial Services domain is preferred.
Qualifications

Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

Overview
As one of the world s leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment, we offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world.
As a provider of multi-disciplined technical services to the built environment, Atkins India is committed to design excellence in the delivery of first class solutions which combine innovation, imagination and best practice.
Due to our continuing expansion we currently have an opportunity for a Senior Highways Engineer on multi-disciplinary offshore executed projects from Bangalore office.
Working in a multidisciplinary team of designers and engineers providing a professional design service to our clients, this is an ideal opportunity for individuals looking to develop their international experience with a world renowned consultant.

Your Role

Qualified Degree in Civil Engineering from a reputed College.
Have relevant experience in the region of around 8 to 12 years in consultancy business working on highways and related features.
Experienced user of Civil3D/ Open Roads, MX design, AutoCAD.
Knowledge in highways design codes and standards. (KSA/Qatar/UAE/DMRB/AASHTHO).
Experience implementing quality standards and procedures.
A very good knowledge of working in all applications of MS Office.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Evidence of having successfully delivered highway projects.

About You
Qualifications & Skills

Holds a Masters Degree in a relevant discipline.
Expert in the use of Civil3D ,Open Roads road design software and AutoCAD.
Experience of using AutoDesk Civils 3D for the design of highway schemes.
Experience of the design of grade separated junctions.
Experience of the design of pipe drainage networks.
Working knowledge of KSA/Qatar/UAE/DMRB/AASHTHO.
project based supervision of designers and drafting staff.
maintaining technical quality standards and mentoring junior designers.
delivering projects to time and budget.
liaising with UK based customers in a responsive and client focused manner.
Be highly self-motivated and ambitious.
Have a track record of technical achievement and client satisfaction within the highways and bridges industry.
Be able to work with minimal supervision.
Have the ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers.
Be able to build excellent working relationships with colleagues and clients.
Have the experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
The position is to be based in Bangalore .
Rewards & Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Gurgaon / Chennai / Pune / Noida / Hyderabad
Responsibilities:
Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.
Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrate excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Primary Skills:
Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, Q&A and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation.
AND/OR
Computer Vision and Audio: Hands-on experience in image classification, object detection, segmentation, image generation, audio, and video analysis.
Generative AI:
Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities.
Familiarity with Open-source LLMs, including tools like TensorFlow/Pytorch and huggingface. Techniques such as quantization, LLM finetuning using PEFT, RLHF, data annotation workflow, and GPU utilization.
Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred.
Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, FastAPI/Django/Flask, and Git.
