Description:
Employment Type: Permanent
Job Summary
Provide the software design, development, testing and deployment of feature releases to support the development of new software capability
Who We Are
Telstra is Australia's leading telecommunications and technology company spanning over a century with a footprint in over 20+ countries. In India, we're building a platform for innovative delivery and engagement that will strengthen our position as an industry leader. We've grown quickly since our inception in 2019, now with offices in Pune and Bangalore
Focus of the Role
As a Network Software Engineer, you'll develop, maintain and support telecom service applications and microservices within a cloud-based environment. You'll work across the software delivery lifecycle, from solution development and deployment through to production monitoring, incident resolution and ongoing performance improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain Java-based applications and microservices.
Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable application deployments.
Deploy and support applications across AWS cloud environments.
Monitor production systems and perform log analysis using Splunk.
Troubleshoot production incidents, perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes.
Support application release, change and deployment activities.
Improve system reliability, performance and operational efficiency through automation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum delivery environment.
Maintain appropriate technical documentation and support testing and quality assurance activities.
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience with Java and Microservices development
DevOps engineering and CI/CD pipeline design and management
AWS services including ECS, EC2, S3, Auto Scaling and Parameter Store
Splunk monitoring and log analysis
Production support, troubleshooting and incident management
GitLab and Bamboo
Application deployment and release management
Infrastructure and deployment automation
API integration and service orchestration
Performance monitoring and optimisation
Cloud security and vulnerability management
Essential Skills Experience
Strong experience developing and supporting Java-based microservices in cloud environments.
Hands-on experience managing CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments.
Experience supporting production applications, including incident investigation and root cause analysis.
Good understanding of application reliability, performance monitoring and troubleshooting.
Experience working within Agile/Scrum engineering teams.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work across development and operational activities.
Exposure to testing practices and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
Telecom domain knowledge, particularly Broadband, Voice or Service Provisioning, would be advantageous.
If you are looking to take the next step in your career, we want to hear from you!

Management Level:07 - Manager
Location:Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai, Pune, Hyderabad
Must Have Skills
Strong expertise in B2B Sales process transformation, covering end-to-end Sales process steps such as Lead Management, Lead Qualification, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Account Management, Forecasting, CPQ, Deal Management, Contract Management, Order Management, and Sales Operations.
Proven experience in future-state process design, process transformation, process optimization, and operating model design.
Strong ability to lead client discovery and design workshops, stakeholder interviews, design-thinking sessions, and co-creation workshops.
Experience integrating AI, GenAI, automation, and analytics into business and Sales processes.
Strong understanding of Sales platforms and enterprise applications that enable the B2B Sales lifecycle.
Ability to connect business processes, technology, operating models, and organizational change to develop practical transformation solutions.
Strong team management and people leadership skills, including coaching, mentoring, work allocation, quality assurance, and developing junior practitioners.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present and defend recommendations to senior client leadership.
Good-to-Have Skills
Experience with process mapping, process modeling, and visualization tools, including Microsoft Visio or equivalent applications.
Exposure to process mining, digital twin, process simulation, or other data-driven approaches for process assessment and validation.
Familiarity with AX Design and designing AI-agent experiences within business processes.
Experience supporting Business Development, sales pursuits, RFP/RFI responses, proposal development, solutioning, and client presentations.
Experience conducting change-impact assessments across people, process, technology, data, skills, and operating models.
Knowledge of Sales platforms such as CRM (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), CPQ (Salesforce, Conga, SAP), CLM (Icertis Conga), Sales Planning (Anaplan, Xactly), Forecasting (Clari, Aviso), Incentive Compensation (Varicent, SAP Callidus), Order Management (Salesforce, SAP), and Revenue Management (Salesforce, SAP)
Experience
8 -12 years of experience in management consulting, process transformation, process excellence, Sales Operations, business transformation, or related areas.
Demonstrated experience leading process transformation workstreams and managing client and internal stakeholders.
Experience managing and developing consulting teams
Experience supporting BD, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities is preferred.

Educational Qualification
Bachelor''s Degree or equivalent.
MBA/PGDM (Preferred)
Job Summary
As a Manager - B2B Sales Transformation & Process Excellence, you will lead the design and transformation of end-to-end B2B Sales processes for clients across Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media.
You will own the process transformation design cycle-from understanding the client''s current-state Sales processes and assessing industry, market, technology, and competitive forces, through defining future-state processes and operating models, to developing implementation and adoption approaches. You will bring strong knowledge of key Sales process steps, including Lead-to-Opportunity, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Forecasting, Account Management, CPQ, Deal Management, Contracting, Order Management, and Sales Operations. You will also assess how Sales platforms and applications enable these processes and identify opportunities for platform optimization, digital transformation, automation, and AI/GenAI integration.
The role requires strong consulting leadership, including client workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, executive communication, team management, and delivery ownership. You will lead and coach practitioners, ensure quality of deliverables, and build reusable methodologies and assets. You will also contribute to Business Development and RFP/RFI activities, including opportunity shaping, solution development, proposal responses, process narratives, capability presentations, and client presentations.
As part of AI-led transformation, you will apply AX Design principles to consider the intersection of human, AI agent, and process. Future-state process designs should define where AI agents operate autonomously, where human intervention is required, escalation triggers, controls, and the quality of human-agent handoffs.
Roles & Responsibilities
B2B Sales Process Transformation
Lead end-to-end B2B Sales process transformation initiatives across multiple Sales process steps and functional areas.
Assess current-state processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, control gaps, manual activities, duplication, and opportunities for standardization and automation.
Lead the design of future-state Sales processes and operating models aligned to business objectives and industry leading practices.
Drive transformation across key Sales processes including:
Lead Management & Qualification
Lead-to-Opportunity
Opportunity Management
Pipeline Management
Account Management
Sales Forecasting & Planning
CPQ & Deal Management
Contract Management
Order Management
Sales Operations & Revenue Operations
Connect process design with people, technology, data, governance, and operating model changes.
Develop transformation roadmaps, process specifications, business requirements, operating models, and implementation recommendations.
Sales Platforms & Applications
Assess the role of Sales platforms and applications in enabling end-to-end B2B Sales processes.
Support transformation initiatives involving CRM/Sales Cloud, CPQ, CLM, Sales Planning, Forecasting, Deal Management, Incentive Compensation, Order Management, and Revenue Management platforms.
Identify opportunities to improve platform adoption, integration, automation, data quality, user experience, and process effectiveness.
Lead process visualization and documentation using Microsoft Visio and other process mapping/modeling tools.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate process requirements into platform and solution requirements.
Client Leadership & Workshops
Lead client discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, design-thinking sessions, and co-creation workshops.
Facilitate discussions with Sales, Operations, Technology, Finance, and Business stakeholders.
Present transformation recommendations and future-state designs to senior client leadership.
Manage day-to-day client relationships, stakeholder expectations, risks, dependencies, and issue resolution.
Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and establish credibility through strong Sales domain and consulting expertise.
AI, GenAI & AX Design
Embed AI, GenAI, automation, and analytics into future-state Sales process designs and team ways of working.
Identify high-value opportunities where AI can improve Sales productivity, decision-making, forecasting, customer engagement, and operational efficiency.
Use appropriate AI tools to accelerate research, benchmarking, analysis, process documentation, and deliverable creation.
Apply AX Design principles to future-state process specifications by defining:
AI-agent responsibilities
Autonomy levels
Decision-making boundaries
Escalation triggers
Human intervention points
Human-agent handoff protocols
Quality and governance requirements
Evaluate how AI agents and human users should collaborate across individual Sales process steps.
Process Excellence, Benchmarking & Analytics
Lead process maturity, benchmarking, and performance assessments to identify transformation opportunities.
Assess market and industry trends across Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media.
Leverage AI-assisted analytics and benchmarking tools to develop data-driven insights.
Use process mining, digital twin, and process simulation approaches where appropriate to validate current-state and future-state process designs.
Develop change-impact assessments covering people, process, technology, data, skills, and organizational structures.
Business Development & RFP
Contribute actively to Business Development, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities.
Support opportunity qualification, solution shaping, and development of differentiated value propositions.
Lead or contribute to RFP responses, proposal narratives, solution approaches, process diagrams, operating models, case studies, and capability presentations.
Translate client requirements into practical B2B Sales transformation solutions and roadmaps.
Support client presentations, solution demonstrations, workshops, and pursuit discussions.
Develop reusable Sales transformation assets, accelerators, frameworks, and points of view to support future pursuits.
Team Management & People Leadership
Lead and manage consulting teams across Sales transformation engagements.
Allocate work, establish priorities, monitor delivery quality, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
Coach and mentor junior consultants and practitioners on B2B Sales processes, process redesign, consulting methodologies, analytics, and AI-enabled transformation.
Provide regular feedback and support team members in developing consulting and domain capabilities.
Foster a collaborative, high-performing team environment across onsite, offshore, and distributed teams.
Build team capabilities through knowledge sharing, training, reusable assets, and hands-on coaching.
Ensure appropriate quality reviews and adherence to Accenture delivery and consulting standards.
Professional & Technical Skills
Deep understanding of B2B Sales processes and end-to-end Sales process steps.
Proven experience in process transformation, future-state process design, process excellence, and operating model design.
Strong knowledge of Sales Operations and Sales transformation.
Experience with Sales platforms and applications supporting the B2B Sales lifecycle.
Proficiency or working knowledge of Microsoft Visio and process mapping/modeling tools.
Experience applying AI, GenAI, automation, and AI-assisted analytics to business process transformation.
Strong benchmarking, analytical, problem-solving, and structured-thinking capabilities.
Experience developing executive-level presentations, process specifications, transformation roadmaps, and business cases.
Strong client-facing consulting and stakeholder management skills.
Strong team leadership, coaching, mentoring, and people management capabilities.
Business Development & Consulting Skills
Demonstrated experience contributing to BD, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities.
Ability to develop client-ready solution approaches, proposals, presentations, and supporting artifacts.

Description:
The Assistant Area Manager - Broking at Axis Max Life Insurance will be responsible for managing and overseeing the broking operations for the designated region. The ideal candidate will work closely with the sales team to drive business growth, ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, and enhance relationships with brokers and clients.

Key Responsibilities:

- Support the Area Manager in executing the broking strategy and achieving sales targets.
- Develop and maintain relationships with existing brokers while identifying and onboarding new broker partners.
- Conduct market analysis to identify trends and opportunities in the insurance sector.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure efficient policy issuance and servicing processes.
- Provide training and guidance to brokers to enhance their product knowledge and sales techniques.
- Monitor broker performance and implement strategies to improve productivity.
- Ensure adherence to compliance standards and internal policies.
- Assist in preparing reports and presentations for management reviews.

Skills and Qualifications:

- Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
- Prior experience in insurance sales, broking, or a related industry.
- Strong knowledge of insurance products and regulatory requirements.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to build and maintain relationships with brokers and clients.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Proficient in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and CRM software.

Tools Required:

- CRM software for managing broker relationships and interactions.
- Microsoft Office Suite for reporting and data analysis.
- Insurance industry-specific software for policy management and compliance tracking.

Description:
As a Relationship Manager - CAT - Elite at Axis Max Life Insurance, you will be responsible for managing and enhancing client relationships to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and retention. You will act as the primary point of contact for our elite clientele, providing tailored financial solutions to meet their individual needs. Your role will involve analyzing client requirements, identifying opportunities to cross-sell and upsell insurance products, and maintaining a thorough understanding of the market trends to offer customized advice. You will also work collaboratively with internal teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with assigned clients, ensuring their needs are met and expectations exceeded.
- Conduct regular reviews of client portfolios and provide recommendations for adjustments as needed.
- Engage in proactive communication with clients, providing updates on new products, policies, and relevant market information.
- Identify and pursue new business opportunities with existing clients to maximize revenue and customer loyalty.
- Collaborate with underwriting and claims departments to facilitate smooth client experiences.
- Achieve sales targets and contribute to the overall growth of the organizations insurance portfolio.

Skills and Tools Required:

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with clients and stakeholders.
- Proven sales experience, particularly in the financial services or insurance industry.
- Ability to analyze financial data and market trends to make informed recommendations.
- Proficiency in customer relationship management (CRM) software to track client interactions and performance.
- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to think on your feet to address client issues effectively.
- Knowledge of insurance products, including life insurance, health insurance, and investment options.
- A proactive approach to managing client relationships and identifying growth opportunities.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor s degree in finance, business, or a related field.
- Relevant certifications in insurance or financial planning would be advantageous.
- Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in relationship management or sales within the insurance or financial sector.

At Axis Max Life Insurance, we are passionate about helping our clients achieve their financial goals through personalized insurance solutions. Join our team and contribute to our mission of delivering excellence in customer service and satisfaction.

Description:
Your Role at Baxter
As a Lead, Sales - HST (Care and Connectivity), you take pride in representing Baxter and our products. We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Lead Sales to lead (Individual Contributor) our hospital solutions and Technologies business in the Western regions of India, focusing on the sales of OT equipment and hospital furniture. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding market share, and building and managing the distributor network.
Reporting to: Sr. National Sales Manager (India and neighboring countries)
Base Location: Mumbai or Pune

What you'll be doing
Planning and Leading Sales Actions: Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve business objectives in the assigned regions. Conduct market research, analyze trends, and identify potential opportunities for growth.
Sales Management: Generating the lead funnel, Improving the Healthcare Systems and Therapies product awareness among the channels, users, Bio-medicals and Purchase teams to achieve and exceed sales targets, customer engagement, and product knowledge.
Developing the KOLs Base: Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, including hospitals, healthcare facilities, and other relevant participants. Understand their needs and provide tailored solutions to meet their requirements.
Business Development: Identify new sales channels, partnerships, and distribution networks to expand the company's presence in the South and East India regions.
Competitor Analysis: Stay updated on industry trends, competitors, and their offerings. Develop competitive strategies to maintain a strong market position.
Revenue Growth: Achieve and exceed sales targets by driving revenue growth in the assigned regions. Manage sales budgets and ensure cost-effective utilization of resources.
Training and Development: Conduct regular Product training and Demo for the users to enhance their product knowledge, and customer engagement.
Reporting and Forecasting: Prepare regular sales reports, forecasts, and presentations for reviews monthly. Lead funnel management through SFDC, Regular work reporting on BOOST.
Closely working with the technical, marketing, and clinical teams.

What you'll bring
Master’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Bio-medical engineering or a related field.
10+ years of experience in sales management, preferably in the OT equipment and hospital furniture industry.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Experience in identifying and addressing cybersecurity threats and applying anti-fraud strategies, with a focus on protecting information and systems.
Exposure to AI-enabled tools and willingness to adopt emerging technologies that support process improvement and operational excellence

Description:
Morningstar is looking for an Apprentice, an entry-level opportunity to join our Data and Operations group. This role will help you gain practical experience by working with one of the datasets, including public equity filings, private market transactions, ESG data, Managed Investment Data (Funds), and reference entity data. You'll benefit from structured training to support your growth, setting you up for long-term success.
This position will be based in our Mumbai office. Preference will be given to candidates residing in Mumbai. Candidates in this role may need to work in shifts, including night shifts.
How does a typical day at work look?
Search, collect, and verify data of basic and intermediate levels of complexity.
Attend to internal/client queries and requests to ensure data captured is aligned with data methodologies and policy guidelines.
Quickly learn our research methods and process standards to ensure productivity, quality, and timeliness.
Collaborate with your team, cross-functional teams, and external (if required) parties to resolve data issues.
You might be a good fit if you -
Only candidates graduating in 2026 with a Bachelor's degree as their highest qualification (preferably in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, or related non-engineering disciplines) are eligible to apply. Candidates with a postgraduate or master's degree are not eligible.
Candidates pursuing or holding professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, CMA, CS, ACCA, FRM, or any similar equivalent course are not eligible to apply.
Demonstrate strong English communication skills (written, verbal, and comprehension).
Are proficient in MS Office tools, especially Excel and Word.
Learn quickly and process information with ease.
Possess attention to detail, a proactive mindset, and natural curiosity.
Effectively prioritize tasks and perform well under tight deadlines.
Work Location : Vashi, Navi Mumbai
Apprenticeship Period : 6-12 months
Stipend : 22,000 per month
Willingness to work in shifts
Early Morning Shift (AU): 5:30 AM to 2:30 PM
General Shift: 10 AM to 7 PM
Afternoon Shift (UK): 2.30 PM to 11.30PM
Night Shift (US): 8.30 PM to 5.30 AM
 Working Days: Monday to Friday (5-day work week)
About Morningstar
Morningstar is a global leader in independent investment research, supporting investors in over 32 countries with more than $300 billion in assets under management. Our mission is to empower investor success through data, research, and technology.
We build products and offer services that connect people to the investing information and tools they need. We are built on the principles of independence, transparency, and long-term thinking. By empowering investor success, we are constantly looking for new ways to help people achieve financial security.

About Us

Description:
Job Summary
The Role and Impact As a DFT Design Engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing and delivering high-quality design-for-test (DFT) solutions for cutting-edge semiconductor products. You will focus on logic design, RTL coding, and simulation, while collaborating on architecture and microarchitecture definitions. Your contributions directly impact product quality and manufacturability by optimizing test coverage, debug efficiency, and production ramp-up, ensuring Intel's leadership in advanced SoC designs. Business group The Data Center Group (DCG) drives innovation in data center technologies to empower businesses and industries globally. As part of this high-impact organization, you will contribute to the development of world-class systems and solutions that support Intel's vision to transform data into actionable insights, enabling scalable, efficient, and secure computing.
Key Responsibilities
Develop logic design, RTL coding, and DFT timing closure support for test content generation, including SCAN, MBIST, and BSCAN.
Collaborate on the definition of architecture and microarchitecture features for blocks and subsystems under DFT design.
Create and optimize HVM content for rapid bring-up and production ramp on automatic test equipment (ATE).
Apply strategies, tools, and methods to integrate DFT into RTL and structural code while meeting power, performance, area, and timing goals.
Review verification plans and drive verification of DFT designs to ensure alignment with architecture and microarchitecture specifications.
Resolve RTL test failures and implement corrective measures to ensure design accuracy and feature correctness.
Integrate DFT blocks into functional IP and SoC, supporting SoC customers to ensure seamless integration and high-quality design outcomes.
Collaborate with post-silicon and manufacturing teams to support debug and verification on silicon, documenting learnings for continuous improvement.
Drive high test coverage and develop structural and specific IP tests to achieve quality and defect-per-million (DPM) objectives.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 0-1 years of hands-on experience through internships, academic projects, coursework, or training.
OR a Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with no prior professional experience.
Proficiency in RTL coding and simulation tools (e.g., SystemVerilog, VCS).
Foundational understanding of DFT methodologies such as SCAN, MBIST, and BSCAN.
Preferred Qualifications
Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset.
Familiarity with SoC architecture and microarchitecture features.
Knowledge of test equipment tools and strategies for production ramp-up.
Passion for innovation and commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.

PEPT is a fast-growing fitness studio dedicated to helping people achieve their health and fitness goals through expert coaching and an exceptional member experience. We are looking for an organized, proactive, and customer-focused Studio Administrator to support our day-to-day operations.

Organised and reliable: you keep lists, close loops, and don't need reminders

18,000 25,000 per month, based on experience
Complimentary gym membership
A stable, respected role at the centre of the gym's operations, reporting directly to the owner
Room to grow into a full operations manager position as the gym expands

NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech

all employees.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Summary
Meet the Team
Our outstanding team works in a startup atmosphere within a stable and leading corporate environment, and our design center hosts all silicon Hardware and Software development fields under one roof. Our devices are crafted for universal adaptability, delivering high speed without sacrificing programmability, buffering, power efficiency, scale, or feature flexibility. We enable the use of these innovative products in the fast-paced world of Open Standards, Open Networking, and massively Scalable Cloud Data Centers.
If you want to work with amazing people and innovative customers developing the next generation of world-class products, join us! Our team develops the full software stack enabling the Silicon One network processors. We work with the Open Standards community and our incredible customers to deliver best in class routing and switching platforms. Work also with architecture and design teams to define the next generation of ASIC products being developed.
Your Impact
Responsibilities
As part of Silicon One Software team, you will closely interact with Cisco s Silicon One customers to help with Silicon One product adoption, software development, documentation, technical support, trouble shooting, and maintenance.
You will gather information from customers on their requirements, pain points and help them implement in software to improve software quality and customer experience.
You will gain intimate knowledge of the Silicon One hardware architecture and software programming models, working closely with the architecture, hardware and software teams.
You will develop innovative applications, customizations of Silicon One software to better suit the customer s needs.
You will work with Silicon One Software teams to design and development of software features for both the control plane and data plane on Cisco s Silicon One NPU.
Youll play a critical role in creating software that powers highly scalable, low-power, low-latency, and dense systems, addressing the ever-growing demands of AI/ML workloads, internet users, and modern applications.
You will use modern C++, the Silicon One network processing language, and Python to develop software for the NPU.
You will participate in customer discussions to define requirements, scope features, and drive the development process from start to finish along with lead engineer(s) in the organization.
Youll take full ownership of delivering high-quality software on schedule, additionally, youll gain deep expertise in the Silicon One hardware architecture and programming models, collaborating with architecture and hardware teams to shape the next generation of ASIC products.
You are an experienced software engineer who understands software development methodologies to develop software modules for the networking domain.
Your experience spans multiple areas in networking, where youve worked with other senior engineers/leads to develop and support various Networking Software modules.
Your expertise in control and routing planes, as well as your ability to build large-scale, high-density, and highly redundant systems, is widely recognized.
You are deeply committed to ensuring the quality of the software and systems and supporting Silicon One Software for our customers.
As a member of the Silicon One Customer Engineering team, you bring optimism and a positive outlook to your work.
Driven by self-motivation, you exhibit a strong sense of ownership and a passion for delivering exceptional results.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor of Science EE/CS combined with 0-1 year of related experience or Master of Science EE/CS
Prior expertise in software development and integration while using one or more of the following programming languages: C++, Python.
Prior expertise with networking protocols and technologies (e.g., L2/L3, MPLS, BGP, OSPF).
Prior expertise in analytical reasoning and debugging, with experience using tools such as GDB, PDB, etc.
Prior working experience with algorithms and data structures.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with cloud, data center, or edge networking products.
Experience with SAI, SONiC or other Network OS.
Experience with writing, testing and supporting software for high performing and scalable networking products.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Tax Services Associate Analyst - FTTS
Our National Tax and EY EDGE practice are made up of a team of professionals providing specialized tax technical services to both US and global clients. EDGE stands for Exceptional Delivery and Growth Engine because this team operates in a technical environment with deep process and service delivery experience that distinguishes EY in the marketplace.
The opportunity
When you join EY EDGE, you ll be at the heart of EY s critical mission to build a better working world by applying your knowledge, skills, and experience in assisting clients in meeting their business objectives. You will learn, grow and contribute - building new relationships and discovering the satisfaction that comes with producing high-quality, valued work and advice.
Your key responsibilities
You re likely to spend your time on a diverse array of projects, responsibilities, and tasks, supporting client engagements by participating in day-to-day interactions with team members, providing a quality work product, and driving delivery of services to meet deadlines. You will support the Fiduciary/Trust Tax Services practice with the preparation and delivery of tax information statements, tax returns, and related reporting for agency, custody, and fiduciary accounts for tax compliance engagements with banks, wealth management firms, trust companies, and law firms. You ll be working in a highly collaborative culture, where listening to and sharing information with colleagues is an essential part of the role.
Skills and attributes for success
Timely, efficient, and accurate support of the production of tax information statements, tax returns, and related reporting in a volume-driven environment within deadline-driven time frames established by governmental agencies and as dictated by the performance standards set forth by the practice s clients
Balancing time between multiple projects and responsibilities, working with multiple engagement teams to serve multiple clients
Learning the differences between various trust accounting systems and how to obtain account data, evaluating the accuracy of such data, and applying knowledge of tax laws and regulatory guidance to make recommendations supporting accuracy in tax reporting
Analyzing bridged account data to identify potential errors and omissions and applying knowledge of basic tax concepts to make decisions and take action to modify tax coding or reporting pertaining to assets, transactions, income, expenses, and beneficiary allocations to support accuracy in tax reporting
Support billing for tax compliance and related services
Basic client data review related to account, beneficiary, and transaction data to identify and correct data bridging errors or omissions based upon professional judgment, informed by training, and provided documented guidance
Assist engagement team with reconciliation of client account database and tax filings to ensure complete, accurate, and timely filing of tax returns, identifying and resolving reconciliation discrepancies
Routinely communicating with immediate supervisor and colleagues to obtain guidance and instruction pertaining to the performance of tax compliance activities, provide updates on the status of work, and discuss recommendations concerning correction of client bridged data to support accuracy and consistency in tax reporting
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor degree or equivalent experience (Accounting, Business, Finance or equivalent degree preferred)
Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and ability to learn other software applications
Basic knowledge of tax software applications, tax compliance, and information reporting rules
Ability to work effectively both independently and with a team, assist with a variety of projects of varying degrees of complexity
Leverage knowledge gained through education and on-the-job experience as well internal and external training and coaching to perform essential functions of the job
Excellent organizational and verbal/written communication skills
Ability to follow a standardized process and ask questions when needed
Prioritization of assignments to ensure appropriate workflow and timely production of client deliverables
Commit to periodic travel (5-10%)
Ideally, you ll also have
Experience in a professional services environment
A proven record in fiduciary tax and a thorough understanding of fiduciary tax laws and concepts required to prepare US federal and state returns
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
The ability to adapt your work style to work with both internal and client team members
What we look for
We re interested in tax professionals with a genuine interest in providing outstanding services to some of the world s most influential people. Working with people from all backgrounds, from executives and entrepreneurs to investors and families, you ll use your experience and status as a trusted advisor to maintain and further our reputation for excellence.
We offer a competitive compensation package where you ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. :
Support, coaching, and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Description:
Job Summary

The Pricing Analyst is responsible for analyzing market trends, customer behavior, competitor pricing, and internal cost data to recommend profitable pricing strategies. This role supports cross-functional teams by developing pricing models, monitoring pricing performance, and helping the business remain competitive while protecting margins. Pricing analysts commonly work with sales, finance, marketing, and operations teams and use data analysis, reporting, and financial modeling to support pricing decisions

Key Responsibilities

Analyze market, customer, and competitor pricing data to identify pricing opportunities.
Develop, maintain, and improve pricing models and pricing analysis tools.
Review pricing requests, pricing changes, and margin impacts to support business decisions.
Prepare reports, dashboards, and presentations on pricing performance and trends.
Work with sales, finance, marketing, and product teams to align pricing strategies.
Monitor key performance indicators such as margin, revenue, volume, and win rate.
Research industry trends, promotions, and competitor activity to inform recommendations.
Support the implementation of new pricing strategies, rules, and processes.
Maintain accurate pricing records and ensure consistency across systems.
Provide recommendations that balance profitability, competitiveness, and customer needs.

Qualifications

Bachelors degree in mechanical engineering, or a related field.
0–2 years of experience in pricing, finance, analytics, or a related role preferred.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with large data sets and financial or pricing models.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office; advanced spreadsheet skills are a plus
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Familiarity with SQL, reporting tools, or data visualization tools is a plus
Preferred Skills
Experience in pricing strategy, revenue management, or commercial analytics.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work collaboratively across departments.
Comfortable presenting findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
Knowledge of market research and competitive analysis methods.

Description:
Join JPMorganChase as a Fund Services Associate I and become an integral part of our dynamic team. This role offers a unique opportunity to enhance your career by working closely with operations, financial controllers, and external partners. Youll be at the forefront of ensuring smooth fund servicing operations while contributing to process improvements. Embrace the chance to grow your skills in a supportive environment that values innovation and collaboration.

As a Fund Servicing Associate I within JPMorganChase, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our operational services related to fund accounting and administration. Your work will have a meaningful impact within our department, as you apply your broad knowledge of fund servicing principles and practices to perform diverse activities requiring analysis and judgement. With your advanced emotional intelligence, you will build trusting relationships with peers, managers, and stakeholders, fostering a collaborative environment. Your continuous improvement mindset will drive you to propose and implement improvements to our current working methods, contributing to the efficiency and resilience of our operating platform.

Job responsibilities
Oversee the accurate and timely production of daily and monthly fund accounting activities, including the Net Asset Value (NAV) calculation for funds across various clients.
Review financial statements prior to production and ensure timely and accurate sign-offs are obtained from the relevant stakeholders involved in the valuation process.
Establish and maintain policies, procedures, and guidelines that comply with internal and external controls and continuously strengthen the control environment.
Develop and implement efficient and standardized workflows within the team and across various hand-off points.
Lead, motivate, develop, support, train, and effectively manage the team.
Assess training and development needs and implement appropriate solutions to maintain team capabilities, skill sets, and mobility.
Manage relationships with clients, including JPMorganChase partner locations, through strong service delivery and a proactive approach to client requirements.
Support the resolution of inquiries and act as an escalation point for fund accounting and operational matters.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Bachelor s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline
Strong knowledge of Mutual Funds, Fund Accounting, GAAP Accounting and Account Reconciliation
Knowledge of the Securities industry, including: Dividends Principal and interest Corporate actions and Trading activity
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective prioritization, organizational, and multitasking abilities.
Strong negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

Description:
Bring your creativity to an innovative and dynamic team of digital learning designers at JPMorganChase. Help shape the future of learning in the flow of work by creating engaging digital experiences that strengthen employee skills, knowledge and performance.
You will join a collaborative environment that combines learning design, technology, video, graphics and emerging approaches to create high-impact learning solutions and contribute to our gamified performance support platform.
Job summary
As a Learning Lead in our digital learning organization, you will have the opportunity to create learning solutions that promote learner engagement and improve employee skills, knowledge and job performance.
You will work alongside digital learning designers and technologists to identify, recommend, design and develop digital learning solutions that address critical business needs. As a hands-on designer and developer, you will create high-quality microlearning experiences, videos, graphics and other digital products while partnering with subject matter experts and business stakeholders from concept through launch.
Job responsibilities
Design and develop innovative digital microlearning solutions that improve learning retention, employee performance and measurable business outcomes.
Create high-quality videos, graphics and interactive learning experiences using tools such as Articulate Storyline, Camtasia and Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop and Animate.
Apply design thinking, digital design, adult learning principles and agile development practices to create relevant and engaging learning experiences.
Incorporate modern learner behaviors, digital innovations and social media trends, including video-first approaches inspired by platforms such as YouTube and TikTok.
Partner with subject matter experts, business stakeholders and learning partners to identify performance needs and translate them into effective digital learning solutions.
Manage multiple learning projects through the end-to-end design and development lifecycle, including needs analysis, design, development, quality review, approval, implementation and evaluation.
Monitor project workload, timelines and capacity, proactively communicating progress, risks and blockers to stakeholders and leaders.
Evaluate learning effectiveness and use learner and business insights to continuously improve solutions and key performance indicators.
Collaborate with peers to share feedback, leverage content and design approaches, identify efficiencies and reduce future maintenance requirements.
Explore emerging technologies, including AI-enabled tools, to improve the speed, quality and effectiveness of digital learning production.
Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative team culture by sharing knowledge, supporting newer team members and continuously improving internal design and development practices.
Required qualifications, capabilities and skills
Demonstrated experience designing and developing digital learning, video, graphics or other digital media solutions.
Hands-on experience with digital design, video production or learning-development tools and the ability to quickly build proficiency with new technologies.
Strong understanding of digital design and adult learning principles and the ability to translate complex information into concise, engaging learning experiences.
Strong knowledge of current digital and social media trends, including video-first content approaches.
Strong writing and visual communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling headlines, captions, descriptions and key messages.
Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with subject matter experts, customers and internal stakeholders.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, usability and quality when developing and publishing learning solutions.
Demonstrated analytical and questioning skills, including the ability to synthesize large amounts of information and identify key messages and performance needs.
Demonstrated accountability, adaptability and ability to give and receive constructive feedback.
Portfolio of work demonstrating relevant digital learning, video, graphic design or digital media capabilities.
Preferred qualifications
Bachelor s or master s degree in instructional design, digital design technology, digital marketing or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Certification in digital learning or instructional design from a reputable institution and at least two years of experience in video production, graphic design or digital media solution development.
Hands-on experience with Articulate Storyline, Camtasia and Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop or Animate.

Description:
Step into the role of Trade Lifecycle Associate I at JPMorganChase, where youll be a vital part of managing the pre- and post-trading life cycle. Your expertise in cash movements and funding coordination will be essential in ensuring seamless trade processing and operational excellence.

As a Trade Lifecycle Associate I within JPMorganChase, you will play a pivotal role in managing the operations of the pre- and post-trading life cycle across all asset classes. Your expertise in cash movements, funding, and coordination with other business lines will ensure seamless trade processing on our platforms. You will leverage your broad knowledge of trade lifecycle principles and practices to propose and implement improvements to our current working methods. Your role will involve diverse activities requiring analysis and judgement within defined boundaries, and you will often be responsible for guiding the work of others. Your proficiency in listening and questioning, internal stakeholder management, presentation skills, process improvement, and automation will be key to your success in this role. You will also have the opportunity to develop your data and tech literacy skills while working with us.

Job responsibilities
Knowledge of the technical infrastructure that supports the business & effectively utilizes infrastructure for daily tasks. Ensure all transactions are correctly matched for smooth settlement, Pre-matching and settlement of Fixed Income trades ( including Priority client focus )
Delivery management, cross depot stock movements - identify and instruct Payment processing SBL intraday activity, escalation and resolution of failing trades,
Instruction of bond conversions - both physical and ADRs
Validation of interest claims, Auto-borrow reports, Daily High/Credit Risk reporting.
Resolution of Cash and Stock breaks working closely with Reconciliations team and verification of manual instructions
Continuously participate in projects involving new system implementation, process improvements, etc
Take ownership of work, problems, clarify issues / objections, and ensure data integrity, accuracy and completeness
Working closely with the Business (Desk Heads, Global and Regional Business Managers) to understand their needs / priorities / issues
Work closely with technology partners to design the right solutions and implement requirements for future state, focusing on the priorities and efficiency saves.
Requirements gathering for the build of the future state, clearly documenting workflows, E2E processes, controls along the lifecycle and new roles and responsibilities
Required Qualifications, Skills and Capabilities:
A strong control mindset and adherence to a high degree of business ethics
In-depth experience with Fixed Income products and global markets
Excellent communication skills
Experience in driving global initiatives and affecting change in a large organization
Ability to work in a high-pressure environment with time critical deliveries
Be innovative and suggest system improvement capabilities.
Preferred Qualifications, Skills and Capabilities:
Prior custody/treasury operation services, markets operational experience.
Understanding of SWIFT, Cross Border Payments, Foreign Exchange, Trade life cycle, Reconciliation rules and Global Custody.
Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes

Description:
Ways of Working -

Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.

About the Team -

Swiggy Dineout is building Indias largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!

Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.

Role Summary -

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month.

The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities -

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently. Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned. Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:

Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business. Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc. Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner. Interaction with

Stakeholders:

Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV) Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Understanding of Conversion Funnel -

Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills -

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English

Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

Effective communication skills

Attitude & Aptitude for Sales

Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life. Analytical, good Excel skills.

The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules

Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.

Initiative & Flexibility:

Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.

Creativity & Initiative:

Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Industry: Garment / Apparel Manufacturing
Job Location: Arekere, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru
Experience: 06 months (Freshers are welcome)
Qualification: B.Sc. / Diploma in Fashion Designing
Job Summary
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented CAD Operator to join our Sampling Department in the garment industry. The ideal candidate should have basic knowledge of garment patterns, measurements, and CAD software, with an interest in apparel design and sampling.
Key Responsibilities
Create and modify garment patterns using CAD software.
Assist in pattern development and alterations for sampling.
Work closely with the sampling, pattern-making, and production teams.
Ensure accuracy in garment measurements, pattern grading, and pattern layouts as required.
Make necessary pattern corrections based on sample feedback.
Maintain pattern files and related technical documentation.
Support the team in meeting sampling timelines and quality standards.
Required Skills
Basic knowledge of garment construction, pattern making, and apparel measurements.
Familiarity with garment CAD software is preferred.
Good attention to detail and willingness to learn.
Ability to understand design specifications and follow instructions.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Eligibility
B.Sc. or Diploma in Fashion Designing.
Candidates with 0–6 months of experience are eligible.
Freshers with relevant academic knowledge and an interest in garment CAD are encouraged to apply.

Arekere, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka.

Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.

Description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments is seeking a Layout Engineer. In this role, you will develop and prepare multi-dimensional layouts and detailed drawings of the semiconductor devices from schematics and related geometry provided by design engineering. Work may be completed through use of CAD or other computerized equipment. You may also check dimensions, write specifications, and verify completed drawings, artwork or digitized plots. Additional job functions may involve checking design layouts and detailed drawings, referring to offline layout leveling charts for details on duties. A bachelors degree in engineering is typically required, and in the U.S. this job is restricted to specific job grades.
Candidates are expected to have following skills -
Good floor planning skills.
Block layout closure which meets performance / Area/ quality requirements.
Good ESD knowledge & PAD ring completion with ESD & IO placements
Good EM /IR knowledge + exposed to Volus-Fi / Totem flow.
Good process knowledge & Packaging knowledge.
Good at automation.
Expert in Virtuso XL, Assura/PVS tools.
Minimum requirements:
Minimum education (ie bachelors degree in electrical engineering)
Minimum of 2 years of experience

Preferred qualifications:
Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes
Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
Ability to take the initiative and drive for results
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: QMS Engineer / Quality Management System Engineer
Department: Quality Management
To establish, maintain, and continuously improve the Quality Management System in compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, and internal standards. Support internal audits, process audits, supplier quality management, and continuous improvement activities.
Key Responsibilities
Quality Management System (QMS): Maintain and improve QMS documentation as per IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 requirements.
Monitor compliance with quality procedures, work instructions, and standard operating procedures.
Coordinate management review meetings and track action closures.
Maintain document control and record retention systems.
Plan and conduct Internal System Audits.
Plan and conduct Process Audits (VDA 6.3).
Plan and conduct Layered Process Audits (LPA).
Plan and conduct Product Audits.
Support certification audits conducted by external agencies.
Coordinate customer audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
Track corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) arising from audits.
Monitor manufacturing process compliance and effectiveness.
Analyze quality KPIs and identify improvement opportunities.
Lead root cause analysis using 8D Methodology, 5 Why Analysis, Ishikawa Diagram.
Drive continuous improvement and error-proofing activities.
Support supplier assessments and qualification activities.
Participate in supplier process audits and supplier development programs.
Monitor supplier quality performance: PPM, Delivery Quality, Audit Scores.
Follow up on supplier corrective actions and 8D reports.
Coordinate with purchasing and supplier quality teams for issue resolution.
Support compliance with: IATF 16949, ISO 9001, VDA Standards, Customer Specific Requirements (CSR).
Ensure timely implementation of customer quality requirements.
Facilitate Kaizen and quality improvement projects.
Support lessons learned implementation.
Promote quality awareness across departments.
Your Qualifications
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Industrial, or Automotive Engineering.
3-8 years of experience in Automotive Quality/QMS.
Technical Competencies
IATF 16949
ISO 9001
VDA 6.3 Process Audit
VDA 6.5 Product Audit
APQP
PPAP
FMEA
8D Problem Solving
Six Sigma Green Belt

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Plan, organize, and monitor daily API production activities to achieve production targets as per the approved schedule.
Ensure all manufacturing operations comply with cGMP, approved SOPs, BMRs, regulatory requirements, and EHS standards.
Manage production planning, manpower deployment, shift operations, and optimum utilization of equipment and resources.
Monitor batch processing, process parameters, yield, productivity, and manufacturing costs.
Ensure timely and accurate completion of batch manufacturing records, equipment logs, and other production documentation.
Coordinate with QA, QC, Engineering, Warehouse, and other departments to ensure smooth manufacturing operations.
Review and investigate production deviations, process failures, out-of-specification events, and implement CAPA in coordination with QA.
Ensure equipment cleaning, line clearance, preventive maintenance coordination, and production area readiness.
Drive process optimization, yield improvement, waste reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with safety procedures, chemical handling practices, housekeeping, and 5S standards.
Train, guide, and develop production personnel to improve technical competency, discipline, and performance.
Monitor production KPIs, prepare reports, and provide regular updates to management on production performance and operational issues.

Preferred candidate profile
Qualification & Experience: B.Sc./M.Sc. Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering with 12-15 years of experience in API manufacturing, including production team management.
Technical Knowledge: Strong knowledge of API manufacturing processes, cGMP, regulatory compliance, process validation, BMRs, yield optimization, and deviation/CAPA management.

Key Competencies: Proven leadership, production planning, manpower management, cross-functional coordination with QA/QC and Engineering, and the ability to achieve production targets while ensuring quality, safety, and compliance.
AboutCompany: We are a research-driven pharmaceutical API company dedicated to working at the forefront of chemical & pharmaceutical innovation

Role & Responsibilities Regional Sales Manager (Punjab)
Develop and execute regional sales strategies to drive business growth across Punjab.
Identify and develop new business opportunities through boutiques, multi-brand outlets (MBOs), retailers, resellers and distributors.
Expand the brand's retail and wholesale network across key cities such as Ludhiana, Amritsar, Jalandhar, Patiala, Bathinda and Chandigarh.
Build and maintain strong relationships with boutique owners, fashion retailers, wedding stores and distributors.
Generate B2B, wholesale, bulk, bridal and occasion-wear orders.
Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual regional sales targets.
Identify potential retail partners and negotiate commercial terms, margins and business agreements.
Conduct regular market visits, client meetings, store visits and competitor analysis.
Manage existing accounts, ensure repeat orders and develop long-term business relationships.
Identify local exhibitions, trade fairs, fashion events and networking opportunities to generate business.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing and customer preferences.
Manage and follow up on leads, enquiries, quotations, orders and payments.
Coordinate with the head office, founders and internal teams for smooth order execution and customer satisfaction.
Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports covering revenue, new accounts, leads, orders and market performance.
Take ownership of regional business expansion and brand presence across Punjab


Preferred Candidate Profile
5 + years of experience in Regional Sales, Area Sales, Business Development or B2B Sales.
Experience in fashion, apparel, ethnic wear, women's wear, bridal wear, jewellery or lifestyle brands preferred.
Strong understanding of the Punjab retail and wholesale market.
Existing network of boutiques, multi-brand outlets, retailers, resellers and distributors across Punjab will be an advantage.
Proven track record of achieving sales targets and generating new business.
Experience in wholesale sales, bulk orders, distributor management and retail expansion.
Strong negotiation, client acquisition and relationship management skills.
Ability to independently develop new markets and generate business.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Fluent in Punjabi and Hindi; workable English preferred.
Willingness to travel extensively across Punjab for client meetings and market development.
Self-driven, target-oriented and capable of working independently
Own vehicle preferred.
Candidates based in Punjab or with strong existing Punjab market connections preferred.
AboutCompany: Kasturi Creations is a fast-growing Indian ethnic-wear brand sarees, lehengas, kurta sets, coord sets and more — with 15 retail stores, a central warehouse across NCR, and a scaling online business. We are building our in-house team to support the next phase of growth.

A. Sample Collection & Processing
Collect, receive, label, and process patient samples as per laboratory protocols.
Ensure proper sample identification, handling, storage, and disposal.
Check samples for adequacy and reject unsuitable samples as per SOPs.
Maintain accurate sample records and ensure timely processing.
B. Laboratory Testing & Analysis
Perform routine diagnostic tests as per assigned laboratory section.
Handle and operate laboratory instruments and diagnostic equipment.
Prepare reagents, stains, and other laboratory materials as required.
Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure accurate and reliable test results.
Ensure timely completion of tests and communicate critical issues to the supervisor.
C. Equipment Maintenance
Perform routine cleaning, calibration checks, and maintenance of laboratory instruments.
Monitor equipment performance and report breakdowns or technical issues promptly.
Maintain equipment usage logs and maintenance records.
Ensure proper storage and handling of reagents, kits, and consumables.
D. Quality Control & Compliance
Perform internal quality control (IQC) as per established procedures.
Follow laboratory quality standards, safety guidelines, and applicable SOPs.
Maintain proper documentation for quality control, testing, and equipment maintenance.
Support internal audits and accreditation-related activities, wherever applicable.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Ensure uninterrupted, safe and efficient operation of plant utilities, including boilers, chillers, cooling towers, compressors, nitrogen systems, HVAC and water systems.
Plan and execute preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance to minimize equipment downtime.
Ensure timely availability of steam, chilled water, cooling water, compressed air, nitrogen and other utilities as per production requirements.
Monitor utility consumption, optimize energy efficiency and implement cost-reduction initiatives.
Ensure compliance with cGMP, SOPs, statutory requirements and EHS standards.
Monitor critical operating parameters and equipment performance to ensure system reliability.
Coordinate qualification, calibration, validation and documentation of utility systems.
Manage utility installation, commissioning, capacity enhancement and improvement projects.
Ensure statutory inspections, safety compliance and risk mitigation for utility equipment.
Supervise utility personnel and contractors, ensuring effective deployment and technical competency.
Manage maintenance budgets, spare parts inventory, AMCs and utility-related expenditures.
Coordinate with Production, QA, QC, Engineering and EHS for uninterrupted plant operations.

Preferred candidate profile
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical or Chemical Engineering with 10 12 years of relevant experience in utilities operations and maintenance, preferably in API/pharmaceutical manufacturing.
Strong technical knowledge of boilers, chillers, cooling towers, compressors, HVAC, nitrogen and water systems, with exposure to cGMP, EHS and statutory compliance.
Proven ability in team management, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, energy optimization and ensuring uninterrupted utility availability.

Description:
SUMMARY
Title: Business Development Executive Field sales apprentice role
Location: Patiala / Patran / Jagraun / Ajnala / Batala / Moga / Bathinda
Job Type: Full-Time apprentice role for 12 months
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics / Retail / FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast-paced FMCG environment.

Responsibilities:
Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
Conduct in-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
Support retail partners with business development strategies and on-ground execution
Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass-out)
Freshers are encouraged to apply
Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
Personal two-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
Work Schedule: 6 days a week
Weekly Off: Sunday
Work Type: Retail store-based with regular local market visits


Benefits
Fixed salary:  11,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 inhand)
Daily TA/DA: 200
Attractive performance-based incentives
